characters.description: Another member of Shanghai Talent Limited, and she is also sixteen years old. Ran is very laid-back, sometimes to the point of appearing "out of it". She is not a quick thinker and is very naive and earnest. Her sweet, considerate nature makes Julia fall quickly in love with her. During her interactions with Julia, Ran becomes more enthusiastic and confident in herself, striving to be just as hard-working as her mentor. Much to everyone's bewilderment and Saeki's relief, Ran is completely oblivious to Julia's feelings. Tables are turned when Ran begins to wonder if she's in love with Julia herself, and she ironically agonizes over it much in the way Julia had when she first realized that she loved Ran. She is half foreign and her past is mysterious. Saeki refers to her as an "airhead". Ran however becomes very calm, suave and charming when she&#039

characters.name: Ryouko Saeki
characters.description: Julia's manager. She knows about Julia's romantic feelings toward Ran, and is often less than pleased with the awkward situations that those feelings often cause. She is normally calm, but Julia's outgoing attitude frustrates her to no end. Kaoru is in love with her, but Saeki sees those feelings as a nuisance. She is twenty-seven years old.

characters.name: Kaoru Shinjou
characters.description: The owner of the Picaresque Beauty Salon. Kaoru used to be the hairdresser for the band ZLAY and claimed that she had sexual relations with one of the members, much to Julia's horror. She is a playful person and likes to stir up trouble, often going out of her way to make Julia and Ran upset. She is rather shocked that Ran is dense enough not to have any idea Julia is crazily and intensely in love with her. She seems to have a thing for Saeki, though most of this might just be her teasing. Kaoru often makes advances on Saeki, but is always pushed away. She seems to have some sort of entanglement with one of her customers, Haruna, although she does this to mercilessly tease the younger girl who clearly has a crush on Kaoru. For some reason, both Julia and Ran come to her for advice, though it's never useful and it rarely ever makes them feel better. It seems that Kaoru is amused

characters.name: Haruna Enomoto
characters.description: Another member of Shanghai Talent Limited, and she is a year younger than Julia and Ran. She is in love with Kaoru, but Kaoru prefers just teasing her endlessly. Haruna is easily embarrassed and occasionally becomes jealous of anyone who receives attention from Kaoru.

characters.name: Megumi Sudou
characters.description: Sudou is Saeki's kouhai at work. She sometimes aids Julia if Saeki is unable to be at the young talent's side, such as the instance where Saeki gets sick and is unable to work. Despite her denial of it, she has an intense crush on Saeki and is often in contention for her affections with Kaoru, of whom she is extremely jealous.

characters.name: Ryou
characters.description: The vocalist and leader of the visual band ZLAY. Ryou first appears when Julia is agonising over keeping her feelings for Ran personally and professionally separate. She easily figures out that Julia is in love and in love with a girl. In fact, Ryou prides herself on having excellent gaydar. She is an intense flirt and a self-proclaimed lady killer, as in many flashbacks, she is always surrounded by groupies or fangirls. However, the entire main cast seems immune to her "charms" and mostly find her to be irritating. According to Ryou herself, she has slept with hundreds of women and need to moderate how many she sleeps with since she can't possibly do them all. She is rather blunt, much to the chagrin of Reki, and always thinks that she knows best. She enjoys making songs about women and yuri. Ryou is best known for showing up when she is least expected (and wanted).

characters.name: Rena Souma
characters.description: A model. She is rather rough, curt and hostile, especially to Sera, with whom she has a history. It turns out that Rena is very much in love with Sera but, unable to express herself and unsure what the feeling was, she ended up spurning the photographer and pushing her away. Rena eventually comes to express herself and is seen to still be very forceful and insistent and commanding towards Sera. The two end up getting together and start a relationship.

characters.name: Mutsuki Sera
characters.description: A photographer who works alongside Ran and used to work with Souma Rena. Sera turns out the be Ran's "stalker" but it turns out all she wanted to do was talk to Ran; Julia drop kicks her assuming that she wanted to attack Ran when all Sera was doing was reaching for her business card. She eventually becomes closer to the idols and starts to photograph Ran. Eventually, she and Ran become confidantes. Sera realises that Ran is very much in love with Julia despite the younger girl having no clue. Ironically, she has no idea that her strained relationship with Rena is a result of unspoken their love for one another. Sera eventually ends up dating Rena after they reconcile.

characters.name: Sai
characters.description: A guitarist for the band ZLAY. She seems to be closest with Ritsu, though the nature of their relationship is never made explicit. In a gag, it seems they were talking about their sex life with one another, but it turns out they were talking about making music, not making love. She seems very friendly with the hairdresser and owner of the Picaresque Beauty Salon, Kaoru.

characters.name: Ritsu
characters.description: Another guitarist for the band ZLAY. She is closest with Sai, and it can be assumed that they are lovers, though it is never made clear. She is not as amorous as Ryou but she and Sai seem to have mutual interest in Kaoru, the hairdresser who once worked for them.

characters.name: Reki
characters.description: The least offensive, perverted, or aggressive member of ZLAY. She is the bassist. She has a very deadpan nature and is the only person who Ryou listens to or is afraid of. Reki often has to reprimand Ryou for her careless behaviour. She and Ryou seem to be a couple, but she lets Ryou flirt and fool around with (hundreds of) other women. Reki does not seem to mind this at all.

title: Strike or Gutter
title_original: ストライク・オア・ガター
description: Touka is an ordinary high school girl who loves bowling. Her father runs a bowling alley, she has a crush on her former coach, and she is a pro at the game. The only issue is that if anybody watches her bowl, she becomes extremely conscientious of her body and plays poorly. To ensure this doesn't happen, Touka's best friend tries to help her overcome her shyness while bowling.

title: Himari no Mawari
description: Aizawa Haruki, 16 years old, is in his 2nd year of high school, and likes to live efficiently. One day during summer vacation, a girl, Aizawa Himari, suddenly appears, calling him 'Onii-chan' and claiming that she's his little sister. As it turns out, Haruki's father recently remarried, and his new wife brought a daughter with her. However, since both of their parents are overseas, it'll only be the two of them living under the same roof. And for some reason, Himari seems very obstinate about spending as much time with Haruki as she can. (Source: Japanese Publisher, translated)

characters.name: Himari
characters.description: Himari is a klutz with an energetic personality. She is obsessed with spending time with her new step brother after their parents got remarried. She has admitted that she can get lonely quite easily, thus, she wants to spend a lot of quality time with her new step brother, Haruki, to make lasting memories.

title: Noe Iuseul Saranghara
description: Doyeon can’t sleep at night, and it’s all because of her mysterious neighbor. It’s not just the loan sharks constantly banging on the next door apartment, but it’s the crying that keeps her up at night… Despite knowing she should stay away, Doyeon can’t help but wonder about her lonely neighbor who cries herself to sleep. Then one day, when the loan sharks are just about to kick down her door, an older woman comes running out of there and Doyeon ends up hiding her in her apartment. They say “love thy neighbor,” but they didn’t tell you doing so would come at a price… (Source: Lezhin US)

characters.name: Do-Yeon Pah
characters.description: Pah Do-Yeon is the main protagonist in Love Thy Neighbor. She is a veterinary college student, who grew up on an orphanage and was adopted into a wealthy family and moves to the apartment next door to a sad housewife whose husband left her at the mercy of loan sharks.

characters.name: Geon-U Pyo
characters.description: Doyeon's childhood friend. Has a crush on Doyeon.

title: Sireohae
description: Ban Ji-Un is loved by all. No matter how chilly someone's exterior may seem, she always finds a way to break through. That is, until her classmate Lee Yu-Seon comes along. For some reason, Yu-Seon ignores Ji-Un’s every attempt to win her over. Ji-Un is dumbfounded that, despite her best efforts, she just can’t find a way to weasel her way into the standoffish student’s heart. But when the two have an unexpected encounter, they just might discover that it’s never when a girl is looking for love that she finds it. On the contrary…sometimes it comes from the place she least expects. (Source: Lezhin US, edited) Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title: Shoujo Shuumatsu Ryokou Koushiki Anthology Comic
title_original: 少女終末旅行 公式アンソロジーコミック
description: The Official Anthology of Shoujo Shuumatsu Ryokou. Volume 1 (2017/10/13) Cover illustration: Tsukumizu Color illustrations: Akima (あきま), aoi_zero (aoi_zero), Mochizuki Kei (望月けい), Yoshimura Yoshi, Atto 1. Shokuji Shuumatsu Jijou (食事終末事情, Meals' Last Issue) [Hatopopoko] 2. Majinai (まじない, Charm) [zinbei (zinbei)] 3. At the Ranch [Nannyaka] 4. Washiki (和式, Japanese Style) [Satuyo] 5. Kirin (キリン, Giraffe) [Tabayou] 6. Exploration Day [Natsuno Riku (夏野りく)] 7. Geijutsu (芸術, Art) [Tadano (タダノ)] 8. Sonzai Shoumei Mokushiroku (存在証明黙示録, Post-Apocalyptic Proof of Existence) [Yue Michitaka] 9. View [Asano] 10. Shoujo VS Shokuryouko (少女 VS 食料庫, Girls VS. Food Storage) [Kaneko Masaru] 11. Factory [Kikai] 12. Last Recipe [Soto] 13. Seishun (青春, Youth) [Moyazou (もや造)] 14. Kinenhi (記念碑, Commemorative Monument) [Nakamura Miryuu (中村ミリュウ)] 15. A Chain for Two People [Takanaga Kouhei] 16. Chiyu (治癒, Healing) [Shoukaki] 17. The Bathtub and the Last Engineer's Suffering [Fuufuu (フーフー)] 18. Girls' Last Tour Around the World [Komatsu Shinya] 19. Red and Blue Warning [Yoshida Satoru] 20. Eiga (映画, Movie) [Tsukumizu] Volume 2 (2020/02/28) Cover illustration: Tsukumizu Color illustrations: Amatou, Tadano Nats

characters.name: Chito
characters.description: She travels with [Yuuri](https://anilist.co/character/120890) on their Kettenkrad. She can read and write in the current language, but not in kanji or Latin alphabets, because they became old languages in this world. She loves reading and collecting books she finds during traveling.

characters.name: Yuuri
characters.description: Yuuri is a care-free, fun-loving girl. She is the direct foil and companion of [Chito](https://anilist.co/character/120889). She carries an Arisaka type 38 rifle and loves food more than anything else in the world.

characters.name: Ishii
characters.description: Woman with glasses who repaired Chito's and Yuri's vehicle and asked for help with plane construction in exchange. The last pilot in history. Like Yuuri, Ishii is also left-handed.

title: Kiniro Mosaic
description: Alice has just transferred to a school in Japan from England, and a whole world of adventures await with her new friends Shinobu, Aya, Karen, and Youko. Join the girls' daily school lives as they learn more about Japan's language and culture! (Source: Yen Press)

characters.name: Karen Kujou
characters.description: **Height:** 150 cm A half-British, half-Japanese girl who was Alice's friend back in England. She comes to Japan and enrols in Shinobu's school. Karen is generally a very energetic girl (even more so than Youko). She is very outgoing and not afraid to show her emotions. Karen has mentioned on multiple occasions that she "really really really loves" (大大大好き!) Shinobu, which makes Alice jealous sometimes. She gets along with everybody in her class, even to the point where they would give her lots of food if she ever forgot her lunch. It has been noted that Karen doesn't gain weight despite consuming lots of food. She calls Aya, "Ayaya", because of a small misunderstanding when they first met.

characters.name: Shinobu Oomiya
characters.description: A graceful and air headed 15-year old girl. She previously stayed over at Alice's home in England, although she herself is rather bad at English and has generally bad grades. Shinobu has taken a liking to the English language and often tries to find opportunities to act like an English person. She has tried reading English newspapers (though she doesn't, if not, barely understands any of it) and even tried to listen in on Alice and Karen's conversations when they are speaking in English.

characters.name: Alice Carteret
characters.original: アリス・カータレット
characters.description: An English girl who transfers into Shinobu's school and stays at her house. She loves Japanese culture. Alice is a cute petit girl who is fluent in both English and Japanese (though it is mentioned that during Shinobu's homestay in England, the both of them communicated with each other only using the words, "thank you" and "konnichiwa"). Alice is very close to Shinobu and often tries to catch her attention, even to the point where she would try to one-up herself from Karasuma-sensei so Shinobu could see that Alice's English is better than Karasuma's. Alice is one of the most level headed people in the group, though she often finds herself embarrassed or in strange situations whenever she tries to win over Shinobu's attention. Alice has shown slight jealousy towards Karen and even Karasuma-sensei because Karen often pushes herself onto Shinobu and Shinobu admires Karasuma-sensei. Neverthe

characters.name: Aya Komichi
characters.description: Aya is Shinobu's classmate. She has also been friends with Youko since middle school. Aya is bright and graceful, though at the same time, she is very shy, timid but still occasionally displays tsundere tendencies towards Youko. Aya usually has troubles reading the atmosphere, which often leads to comedic moments in the series, though despite this, she is still one of the most level headed people in the group. ~!Aya often gets teased and complimented by a dense Youko. This always leads to Aya having romantic cliche thoughts and sometimes results in her hitting Youko due to embarrassment.!~

characters.name: Youko Inokuma
characters.description: Youko is Shinobu's classmate and also Aya's friend since middle school. Youko often teases Aya, even going as far as telling the group that Aya would never leave her side in middle school because Aya was too shy to do anything alone (though Aya strongly denies this). While Youko is very energetic, athletic and high spirited, at the same time, she is one of the most level headed people in the group (the other ones being Aya and Alice). She has a few younger siblings that she loves to play with. It has been noted by Aya that Youko's little brother's voice sounds almost exactly like Youko's.

characters.name: Isami Oomiya
characters.description: Shinobu's older sister who is a fashion model.

characters.name: Sakura Karasuma
characters.description: Shinobu's English teacher.

characters.name: Akari Kuzehashi
characters.description: Karen's Home Economics teacher.

characters.name: Karen no Mama Kujou
characters.description: Karen's British mother. She once punished Karen by eating a piece of super yummy cake in front of Karen when she heard a rumor that Karen was causing trouble for her homeroom teacher.

title: Bongchongaksi
description: He bought me for 50 sacks of rice. Soongap is nearly beaten to death by his master when friendly giant Bongchun buys him and saves his life. Bongchun's blind mother is delighted, believing her son has finally brought home a bride. And the more Bongchun treats Soongap like his darling bride, the more things get heated... (Source: Manta) Note: Includes 18 extra chapters.

characters.name: Sun-Gap
characters.description: __Height:__ 170cm __Shoe size:__ 260mm __Favorite food:__ fish, braised food, pickled vegetables, rice Sun-Gap doesn't celebrate his birthday. He would have gotten some extra food from his grandmother back when she was alive, but now birthdays don't matter to him that much. He has a normal tolerance for alcohol and smiles a lot when drunk, but doesn't enjoy drinking much. Sleeps on his side. The quality of his sleep greatly improved after coming to Bong-Chun's house.

characters.name: Bong-Chun
characters.description: __Height:__ 205cm __Shoe size:__ 325mm __Favorite food:__ anything, as long as there's a lot of it Bong-Chun doesn't celebrate his birthday; the only thing he does is give his mother a special meal. He doesn't enjoy drinking, but is still capable of ingesting limitless amounts of alcohol. He's the same as usual when drunk, except that he eats a lot more. He sleeps on his back with his hands folded over his chest. He's a light sleeper and sleeps very quietly for a man of his size. He doesn't snore.

characters.name: Pil-Gyeon
characters.description: __Height:__ 185cm Pil-Gyeon likes alcohol. His face remains pale no matter what, even when he's completely wrecked. He says the same thing over and over when drunk. Sleeps on his belly or rolls around, kicking off the blankets. He falls asleep quickly.

title: Genkai OL to Joshi Daisei ga 〇〇 Suru Hanashi
title_original: 限界OLと女子大生が〇〇する話
description: Segawa-san is the star of the office who everyone depends on. But she's stretched thin, and the state of her apartment has gotten dire. After a fateful encounter, the college girl next door offers to lend a helping hand! Notes: - The chapter count includes one extra story. - Originally self-published on Twitter, it was picked up for commercial publication on 2023-09-23.

title: Nae Jasigui Sasaenghwal
description: A gay son and a lesbian daughter. Jin and Rin are best friends, and they each have a secret - they are both gay. Life turns upside down when both of their households find out about their sexual orientation. How will they survive despite their parents knowing? (Source: Manta)

title: Now Loading...!
description: Takagi Suzu has a lot of ups (and downs) working in the video game industry, but she’s about to level up: Sakurazuki Kaori, a powerful director in the company who made Takagi’s favorite game, has come to guide Takagi on her next mission. Sakurazuki can be a bit harsh, but she’s also an experienced leader who will help Takagi gain advanced skills–and the two women might just unlock a new romance along the way! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Tsukarekitta Onna ga Shinuhodo Iyasareru Tame ni
title_original: 疲れきった女が死ぬほど癒やされるために
description: An angel suddenly descended upon my messy life! Chihiro Sakai, 32, is a novelist in the midst of a slump. Under the terrible pressure from her editor, she hasn't slept for three nights and can't even think straight or move her fingers.... "How am I supposed to write anything?" Chihiro was about to fall over from exhaustion, when she meets a stranger (26 years old) at the pet store and brings her home! It's the start of a life together between two women that will give your weak heart strength.... (Source: Pixiv Comics, translated)

title: Yoiko no Shouzou
description: Hana is a college girl lacking ambition and motivation, when she meets a beautiful woman named Yoiko, who calls her self a "vengeful spirit" and tells Hana, "You have been cursed and you will die." To lift the curse, Hana must investigate the mystery behind this beautiful ghost, and her only clue is a sooty painting. The more Hana looks into Yoiko's background, the more she falls under Yoiko's captivating spell. (Source: Kobunsha, translated)

characters.name: Hana
characters.description: A college student with a poor relationship with her parents.

characters.name: Yoiko
characters.description: A mysterious ghost who seeks the memories of her past.

title: Watashi wa Succubus to Kiss wo Shita
title_original: わたしはサキュバスとキスをした

characters.name: Konomi Nirasaka
characters.description: One succubus girl that had transfered schools recently

characters.name: Yukiko Ootsu
characters.description: A shy succubus.

characters.name: Fuwa Yanigahara
characters.description: Best friend of Yukiko since middle school

characters.name: Mirino Echigo
characters.description: Aki's best friend.

characters.name: Nozomi Ashiyama
characters.description: Works part-time at Yanigahara Fish Garden

title: Endroll no Ato ni wa Saikou no Tabi wo
title_original: エンドロールの後には最高の旅を
title_en: Have a Great Trip After the End Credits
description: Aino the Hero and Iro the Mage. After defeating the Demon King, the two women embark on a journey around the world to fulfill a promise they made long ago. This is their story after the end credits roll—the greatest adventure dedicated to each other. A heartrending, radiant road trip fantasy. (Source: Manga UP!)

title: Boku no Futatsu no Tsubasa
description: Hiromi has a cousin named Mako. When she arrives Hiromi receives a big shock, she clearly remembered her as being a male nine years ago. The female looking hermaphrodite learns about herself and sex through various relationships and the friends she makes. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Makoto Kashiwagi
characters.description: Makoto was raised by her grandfather as a boy because she possessed male genitalia. However, with the onset of puberty, Makoto also started to develop breasts and so learned that she is a fertile and fully functional hermaphrodite. At the start of the manga, Makoto looks, when fully clothed, like a tall, beautiful girl, and she has adopted female mannerisms—although she continues to use boku for "I", which is usually used only by boys and young men. Makoto is unusually strong and athletic, but somewhat naive because of her sheltered upbringing. She is caught unaware when she first develops physical attraction to other people, and her attempts to deal with her sexuality is played for both humor and drama.

characters.name: Hiromi Ishimaru
characters.description: Hiromi is, officially, Makoto's cousin. After her father died, she was adopted by her mother, the daughter of Makoto's grandfather, meaning that she and Makoto are actually not related by blood. Hiromi and Makoto knew each as young children, when Makoto was believed to be a boy, causing Hiromi some surprise when she meets Makoto as a teenager. After Makoto reveals her secret, Hiromi becomes Makoto's protector and tutor. She tries to protect Makoto's secret and steer her away from harm, but inevitably gets caught up in Makoto's entanglements. (source: Wikipedia)

title: Mo Xi Tuo
description: Cool and quirky runway model Simone and her witty lawyer lover Marissa were spotted KISSING on the street! Not only that, the photo is all over the internet and people will NOT stop talking about it!! Now their families, employers, and even the public are pressuring them to call it quits on their relationship. But despite their struggle to gain acceptance, Simone and Marissa are set on showing everyone that love is like a well-mixed drink; the sweeter the taste, the harder it is to put down. (Source: Tapas)

title: Koi ni Koisuru Koibito no Kankei
title_original: 恋に恋するコイビト関係
description: Asako Ichijou, the student council president at a prestigious girls' high school, has been racking her brain about how to discipline the unruly but popular Nagi Tenma. That's the sort of person Asako is, until Nagi discovers Asako has broken school rules, too, by bringing shoujo manga to school... Asako pleads with Nagi to keep it a secret, and Nagi agrees, but with the condition, "Become my lover." (Source: Takeshobo, translated) Note: Includes three extra chapters .

title: Hana to Uso to Makoto
description: Some time before the June of summer. One day, she suddenly died... "I" and the corpse of the girl who should have died, "Makoto", spent those false summer days in that apartment. The relationship between these two sad, distorted people slowly becomes clearer...

title: Daisuki na Shinyuu ga VTuber no Jibun ni Gachi Koishiteta Hanashi
title_original: 大好きな親友がVチューバーの自分にガチ恋してた話
description: Manga artist Oshiga Sukoya is in love with the Vtuber Doujima Taiga and constantly gushes about her to her best friend Hariyama Teruko. Little does Sukoya know that Teruko is A.) the person behind Doujima Taiga, and B.) secretly in love with Sukoya. Note: Originally self-published on Pixiv, it was collected for publication by Futabasha on 2023-09-21.

characters.name: Oshiga Sukoya
characters.description: A mangaka who gains energy from supporting her favorite and watches endless Vtuber streams while drawing. Will die if she stops drawing her favorite.

characters.name: Teruko Hariyama
characters.description: Doujima Taiga's true identity, who is keeping her V-activites a secret. At that age where she can't be honest with herself. Uses a voice changer as she can't stand her own cute voice.

title: "Hitokiri" Shoujo, Koushaku Reijou no Goei ni Naru
title_original: 『人斬り』少女、公爵令嬢の護衛になる
description: Shurine is a girl who has mastered the sword, raised to serve as a bodyguard. However, when she is falsely accused of an assassination attempt, she is forced to go on the lam. Driven into exile, Shurine meets Lutecia, a duke's daughter whose life is in danger, embroiled in a dispute over succession. When Lutecia is attacked by an assassin, Shurine makes her an offer. (Source: Micro Magazine-sha, translated)

characters.name: Lutecia Heilenberg
characters.original: ルーテシア・ハイレンヴェルク

title: Paros no Ken
description: The legends that speak of the Sword of Paros say that it can bestow either prosperity or ruin on its kingdom...depending on the heart of its wielder. The kingdom's current princess, the beautiful yet resentful Elminia, laments being treated as a soulless tool simply for being born in a woman's body. Accompanied by Count Yulias, Elminia rides as far away from the kingdom’s politics as possible. One day, Elminia meets a beautiful young girl named Fiona, and their lives and the kingdom are changed forever. (Source: Manga Mavericks)

characters.name: Fiona
characters.description: A sixteen year old laundry maid. She lives in hope that she may find the prince of her childhood again. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Elminia
characters.description: The princess of Paros, she considers herself to have been "born with both a man's heart and a woman's body." She has just come of age, but she does not want to marry and only find worth in bearing a prince for Paros. She yearns for freedom and adventure.

title: Ane wo Suki na Onee-san to
title_original: 姉を好きなお姉さんと
description: Due to various reasons, Hishiro Kinome is looking for a place to live. To this end, her sister suggests that she lives... with a lady who likes her sister?! Note: Includes three extra chapters.

title: Usotsuki Hanayome to Dousei Kekkonron
title_original: 噓つき花嫁と同性結婚論
title_en: The Lying Bride and the Same-Sex Marriage Debate
description: Shigisawa Rei knows she’s out of step with society. While everyone around her is getting married and having babies, as a gay woman, Rei feels like those things will never happen for her. Instead of looking for romance, she’s thrown herself into her work and is content with that. That is, until she happens to run into Goto Saya, a former colleague. Saya is petite, cute, and has always been popular with men. So it’s no surprise that Rei used to have a crush on her, but she squashed those feelings when Saya got married. Now, however, Saya comes to Rei begging for help, saying she’s had a fight with her husband and has nowhere else to go. Rei quickly agrees to help her out, and soon her crush is back with a vengeance! Rei knows it’s a bad idea to fall for a married woman, but can she possibly resist Saya’s charms?! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Yuzhou Diyi Cu Shen
description: The innocent starlet Xiao Fengyu got the chance to work with the cold-faced superstar He Yunhan in a variety show as mentor and trainee. It seems like a great chance for Fengyu to get in with the goddess, but how come it feels like she's always running into trouble with her?

characters.name: Fengyu Xiao
characters.description: Xiao is a bubbly and innocent 18 years old college student who's working as a trainee in order to become an actress. She has a bright, fun and outgoing personality. She loves eating and her favourite food is buns. Her hometown is Xiawa Village. She has a sister.

characters.name: Yunhan He
characters.description: A cool and collected award-winning star actress. She becomes Xiao's mentor in a reality show. She dislikes milk, sweet food and skewers. She often gets drunk when she drinks. ~!It seems that He doen't have a good relationship with her family, especially her mother.!~

characters.name: Wen Hui
characters.description: Huiwen is Xiao's manager.

characters.name: Juan
characters.description: Juan is Xiao's third roommate. She's older than Xiao.

characters.name: Min Su
characters.description: Su Min is Xiao's second roommate. She's older than Xiao.

characters.name: Xixi Lin
characters.description: Xiao Fengyu's senior. She became famous online because of her single "Qing Qian".

characters.name: Yu Yuan
characters.description: She's the second heiress of Qin Yi Entertainment.

characters.name: Misu
characters.description: Misu is a renowed dancer. She took place of mentor Ke Ermin due to family matters.

characters.name: Qin Su
characters.description: Su Qin is the director of Qinyi Entertainment.

title: Uchi no Maid ga Uzasugiru!
title_original: うちのメイドがウザすぎる！
title_en: UzaMaid: Our Maid is Way Too Annoying!
description: After the tragic loss of her mother, Misha Takanashi had all but shut herself away from the world. Her father desperately tried to hire new maids in order to take care of her and the housework while he’s busy with his own job, but it was to no avail as she manages to run them out of the position — all of them except one. ​Before she knows it, Misha finds herself the center of attention of one Kamoi Tsubame, an eccentric ex-JSDF master sergeant who isn’t fazed in the slightest by Misha’s attempts to drive her away. Enamored by the adorable little girl, Tsubame makes it her personal goal to get Misha to open up her heart to her (and maybe even get her to wear the cute clothes she makes as well.) ​While her intentions are (mostly) good, Tsubame has a habit of taking things to the extreme when it comes getting closer to Misha, leading to all sorts of crazy situations that exasperate her to no end. Now, the pressure is on as Misha tries to find a way to deal with a maid who’s just way too annoying! (Source: Kaiten Books) Note: Includes one extra chapter.

characters.name: Tsubame Kamoi
characters.description: An ex-Air Self-Defense Force soldier who becomes the Takanashi family’s maid. She claims to only be interested in girls who haven’t menstruated yet, forming a particular attachment towards Misha.

characters.name: Misha Takanashi
characters.description: A Russian girl who has become a rebellious recluse following her mother's death. She is fearful of Tsubame's behavior and often tries to find ways to get rid of her. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Yasuhiro Takanashi
characters.description: Misha's father, who becomes over delighted when Misha shows her any kind of interest. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Kumagorou
characters.description: Misha's pet ferret.

title: Teizokurei DAYDREAM
description: Ghost Talker's Daydream tells the story of Misaki Saiki, a young woman with a troubled past, who is a professional dominatrix in one of Tokyo's most exclusive S&M clubs. However, her real money is something she likes even less than being a dominatrix. Ever since childhood, Misaki has had the ability to see and communicate with ghosts, and that talent is put to use by the Livelihood Protection Agency, who pairs Misaki with Souichirou Kadotake, a martial artist who happens to be deathly afraid of ghosts. Using her gifts, Misaki is able to help troubled departed spirits resolve what is troubling them and allow them to move on to the afterlife. If all that isn't odd enough, Misaki is an albino and a virgin. (Source: Dark Horse)

characters.name: Misaki Saiki
characters.description: Misaki Saiki's a very lonely girl. She is hinted to be bisexual. Born as an albino, she was sent over at a young age to live with her father and grandmother. She also had to suffer the taunts of other children because of her unusual appearance. When she got older, she got a job as a dominatrix in one of Tokyo's most notorious S&M clubs. Misaki is used to the various perversions of the male clients she runs into, and is well-trained in how to satisfy their needs. However, this also brings her share of obsessed fans who try to seek her out and stalk her... especially Mitsuru Fujiwara, who constantly sends her text messages on her cell phone. But a lot of the time, people seek Misaki out because of her ability to talk with the dead. She often works with the city as an exorcist, helping out distressed spirits into going on to the afterlife. She often works with Souichiro Kadotake of the

characters.name: Ai Kunugi
characters.description: Ai Kunugi sought out Misaki Saiki's help some time after her sister had committed suicide following the accidental murder of her infant niece. The baby's death was blamed on the mother, but Ai knew it was her sister's boyfriend, a yakuza boss named Kago, who was the one responsible. However, after the incident, Ai soon found out that, like Misaki, she too had the ability to see and communicate with the dead. A very brave girl, Ai often looks up to Misaki, hoping to be as strong as her. Misaki, on the other hand, would rather have the girl ignore the many deceased spirits that Ai often encounters. Ai is also a classmate of Mitsuru Fujiwara, the young boy who is stalking Misaki. (Source: Absolute Anime)

characters.name: Souichiro Kadotake
characters.description: It is any wonder why Souichiro Kadotake would even want to work for the Livelihood Preservation Agency. For a mysteriously heavily-funded agency that specializes in exorcising ghosts, Souichiro has distinguished himself by being absolutely terrified of ghosts. In fact, the medium whose contact he is – Misaki Saiki – has to virtually haul his body inside a supposedly haunted house. And whenever she's in a hurry to get to the S&M club she works at, Misaki sometimes uses Souichiro's car to change into her fetish leathers, often distracting Souichiro while he drives... the end result usually being a minor accident. However, as scared as he is with ghosts, Souichiro is the opposite when facing the living... especially hoods and yakuza punks. Souichiro is an excellent martial artist, and is capable of crippling... or if he wanted to, killing whoever attacks him. He especially f

title: Mononoke◇Sharing
title_original: もののけ◇しぇありんぐ
description: Because of her family's poverty Yata, a high school student, was searching for a really cheap lodging. And she found it in a certain shared-house type apartment. Each of the residents of which happened to be, surprise-surprise, some kind of demon (with big mammaries also)! And so the story of a bit lewd, sometimes bizarre and often noisy cohabitation of Yata and others at human world, receiving those big-breasted demon-girls trying to fit in, is getting started!

characters.name: Youko
characters.description: __Species__: Kitsune Youko is sensual, daring and carefree but in spite of that she proves to be good with her friends and tries to help Yata when necessary.

characters.name: Mizuchi Kujirazuka
characters.description: __Species__: Kappa Mizuchi is the most mature and responsible of the group and is usually the one that keeps the other youkai in check.

characters.name: Yuki Echigo
characters.description: __Species__: Yuki-onna Yuki is incredibly shy, so much so that she feels embarrassed to show her body through revealing clothing by a preference in scant clothing tight to reveal a suggestive figure. Apparently she is very possessive as she gets jealous and angry when someone approaches yata

characters.name: Momi
characters.description: __Species__: Oni Momi is a shut in and rarely interacts with others.

title: Ayame to Amane
description: A short (two-three pages bimonthly) gag manga about two best friends, one of whom (Ayame) is in love with the other (Amane). Each chapter follows the hijinks of Ayame's advances towards Amane, which usually end up in comedic failure. The chapter count includes 16 bonus chapters,1 4-koma extra and a Bonus Epilogue Chapter

title: Idolatry
description: High school girl Junna Harumi's purpose in life is to support the idol Fuwari Tsukishiro! One day, the idol group Fuwari belongs to disbands. In her despair, Junna learns that Fuwari will be trying out for an idol audition program. There will be a total of 100 participants - in order to lead her idol to the top, Junna decides to take part in the audition herself and work behind the scenes. This idol-otaku girl's lifelong "supporting activity" begins now! (Source: Weekly Shounen Magazine, Translated)

title: Seikyouiku 120%
description: ​Naoko Tsuji, an unorthodox health teacher at an all-girls school, doubts whether the sex ed status quo truly teaches young people everything they need to know—so she ramps it up to 120%! Luckily for Tsuji, her class proves to be an almost unflappable group, including a BL fan, a lesbian, and a girl who just really likes her cat! With topics like safe sex for same-gender couples, masturbation positivity, and why sugar gliders have three vaginas, this sex education comedy is more than just dirty jokes. It’s time for class! (Source: Yen Press)

title: Indigo Blue
description: Rutsu, a novelist, finds herself caught between her boyfriend and another woman.

title: Nikaidou Kou Tanpenshuu: Arigatou tte Itte
title_original: 二階堂幸短編集　ありがとうって言って
description: Your first ever girlfriend, the teacher you loved back in school, your friend’s mother whom you’ve always looked up to, the colleague at work that somehow interests you etc... People like us who just started loving someone else, lead such strong, beautiful and refreshing lives. The scenery which you vividly remember will be changed with your aspirations. An omnibus of precious short stories.

title: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni: Meguri
title_original: ひぐらしのなく頃に 巡
description: June 1983...has passed. At long last, through many trials and tribulations, Rika and her friends have finally escaped the tragedy! The gameboard has been cleared, the pieces scattered, and all that remains is the rest of her life. Or so Rika believes, until she gets pulled into yet another fragment... (Source: Yen Press)

characters.name: Rika Furude
characters.description: Rika Furude is one of the younger students in [Keiichi's](https://anilist.co/character/1851/Maebara-Keiichi) school, and is in the same grade level as [Satoko](https://anilist.co/character/1612/Houjou-Satoko). Naturally, she is great friends with her, as they live together in the same house. She is revered by the villagers as the heir of the local shrine, and plays the role of a miko in the annual Watanagashi Festival. She has been the head of the Furude house since her parents died, but rarely attends town meetings due to her young age. While she does not speak a lot, she likes to say nonsense words such as "mi~" and "nipa~" and often ends her sentences with "-nano desu", which inflames [Rena's](https://anilist.co/character/1427/Ryuuguu-Rena) passion for cute things. Despite her young appearance, she is rather calm and reserved-usually serving as the voice of reason amongst the club mem

characters.name: Satoko Houjou
characters.description: Satoko is a younger classmate in [Keiichi](https://anilist.co/character/1851/Maebara-Keiichi)'s school. She has a distinctive style of speech, ending all of her sentences with 'wa' which, at times, is grammatically incorrect. In spite of her young age, she is quite clever in setting up traps, and likes to practice on Keiichi. Despite her extremely energetic and playful disposition she is actually quite the crybaby, which [Mion](https://anilist.co/character/1611/Sonozaki-Mion) and Keiichi often tease her about. Satoko is also very close with [Rika](https://anilist.co/character/1534/Furude-Rika), who she lives with. ~!Although her personality is quite energetic and mischievous during the events of the games, Satoko's past was full of trauma; her parents died in an accident, she was abused by her foster parents (her aunt and uncle), and her beloved brother Satoshi disappeared. However, in M

characters.name: Rena Ryuuguu
characters.description: __Height:__ 158 cm (5'2'') Rena is a girl who returned from Ibaraki to Hinamizawa one year ago and now is in the same grade level as [Keiichi](https://anilist.co/character/1851/Maebara-Keiichi). She is very kind and capable and takes care of Keiichi and her friends whenever possible, but is also naive and is usually subject to light teasing by Keiichi. She is distinguished by her obsession with things she perceives as adorable, calling them kāii (かぁいい), a slurred form of kawaii (かわいい) meaning "cute." Those tend to be moekko characters or items she finds while scouring the local dump, which are not considered cute by others. Despite this disarming trait, Rena is shown to be amazingly observant and perceptive about the things around her.

characters.name: Mion Sonozaki
characters.description: Mion is the oldest kid in [Keiichi Maebara](https://anilist.co/character/1851/Maebara-Keiichi)'s class. As the elder, she is the class president and everyone looks up to her as the leader. She acts like a perverted tomboy and calls herself old man, but has a hidden girlish side. Mion is next in line to be the head of the Sonozaki household, one of the Three Families which holds tremendous influence in Hinamizawa. Often when playing games with her fellow club members she is known for her ruthlessness, often coming up with the most embarrassing penalties for the losers. Mion also serves as the leader of the main characters' gaming club. ~!Mion is more stable than the other club members, and as such has never herself succumbed to Hinamizawa Syndrome!~

characters.name: Keiichi Maebara
characters.description: Keiichi is the son of a famous and extremely wealthy artist and has recently moved to Hinamizawa after an array of unfortunate events in his hometown. His charismatic, lively attitude and talented tongue allow him to quickly fit in the town and make new friends and also win some club activities. Though he can be somewhat shy and is easily spooked at times. ~! In the first couple arcs, paranoia drives him to murder his friends and others, but in the other arcs, he gains inner strength and faith in his friends, enough to change the fate of Hinamizawa, sometimes by remembering the events of Onikakushi-hen.!~ When in need of a weapon, he wields Satoshi's old bat. Keiichi often receives the butt of the jokes in the club's activities from which he was the correct answer to some games they play, to wearing embarrassing costumes whenever he loses punishment games. Keiichi has brown hair with dar

characters.name: Shion Sonozaki
characters.description: Shion is [Mion](https://anilist.co/character/1611/Sonozaki-Mion)'s identical twin sister, who currently resides in Okinomiya. In spite of their different personalities, she and Mion often switch places, and it can be difficult to distinguish between them. ~!Their first switch took place when they were little. Right before tattooing the symbol of an oni, which is reserved for the older sister, she was mistakenly identified as Shion, the younger sister, which means that she was actually born as Mion Sonozaki, the older sister. Since then, she switched her identity of Mion with Shion, the younger sister.!~ She was sent by the Sonozaki family to a private boarding school, but escaped and returned to live near her hometown, where she lives with [Kasai](https://anilist.co/character/14928/Kasai-Tatsuyoshi). In spite of all this, she and Mion maintain a close relationship. In most of the arcs, s

characters.name: Hanyuu Furude
characters.description: Hanyuu is the mysterious "transfer student" in Matsuribayashi-hen. She has a pair of dark colored horns on her head, one of which is chipped slightly (however, no one seems to notice or mention them, with the exception of [Takano](https://anilist.co/character/4934/Takano-Miyo), who calls her a "monster"). In fact, she has appeared to [Rika](https://anilist.co/character/1534/Furude-Rika) all her life, but only in Matsuribayashi-hen and Miotsukushi-hen did she gain the power to interact with others, posing as a distant relative of Rika's and given the name "Hanyuu Furude." Like many of the characters, she can be frightening when angered, and with her spirit-like nature, her appearance can change with her mood until she takes a physical form. She is very meek and often makes the noise "Au au, au au…" when she is nervous or uncomfortable, or sometimes while trying to make a point. She also t

characters.name: Oryou Sonozaki
characters.description: Oryou is the grandmother of Mion and Shion as well as the current head of the Sonozaki family. Although usually harsh and vulgar during her dealings with people, she has a bit of a softer side that she rarely lets out.

characters.name: Kiichirou Kimiyoshi
characters.description: Head of one of the Three Families, and the official village chief of Hinamizawa. He seems to be a kindly old man, but is vehement in his hatred for Hinamizawa's enemies. His position as chief is largely symbolic as Oryou Sonozaki holds power over most of Hinamizawa. ~! As this includes Satoshi and the rest of the Hojo family, he is killed by Shion in Watanagashi-hen and Meakashi-hen. !~ ~!In Tatarigoroshi-hen, it is revealed that he became Rika's legal guardian sometime after her parents' death in 1981.!~

characters.name: Satoshi Houjou
characters.description: Satoshi is the older brother of [Satoko Houjou](https://anilist.co/character/1612/Houjou-Satoko). Although he is currently missing, his past influence is the key to the actions of several characters in Higurashi. Similar to Satoko, he cannot distinguish the difference between cauliflower and broccoli. Because of this, it can be inferred that both Satoshi and Satoko are color-blind. ~!It is revealed in Matsuribayashi-hen (Festival Accompanying Chapter), that Satoshi is in fact alive. [Shion Sonozaki](https://anilist.co/character/1313/Sonozaki-Shion) learned from [Kyosuke Irie](https://anilist.co/character/7445/Irie-Kyousuke), that he has been kept in the underground levels of the Irie Clinic. Satoshi is sedated and restrained, undergoing treatment for Level Five Hinamizawa Syndrome, which surfaced after he had killed his aunt on the night of the Watanagashi.!~

characters.name: Kuraudo Ooishi
characters.description: Kuraudo Oishi is a veteran police investigator at Okinomiya who has vowed to solve the mystery of the Hinamizawa murders before his retirement, due to personal reasons. Due to his uncouth tactics and the lengths that he goes to in order to solve the mystery, he is looked upon as a nuisance by the villagers. ~!He approaches one of the main characters to become his informant in several arcs, and is sometimes unwittingly responsible for triggering their paranoia.!~

characters.name: Miyo Takano
characters.description: Miyo is a nurse at the village clinic who has a keen interest in Hinamizawa's past and culture, recording all her speculation in notebooks. At times, her storytelling can be very mysterious and chilling—she seems to enjoy putting people on edge. ~!In the first six arcs, she consistently disappears on the night of Watanagashi, and an incinerated body thought to be hers is found in the mountains. Later, however, it turns out that she is the mastermind of the events taking place in Hinamizawa who wants to murder [Rika](https://anilist.co/character/1534/Furude-Rika) so she can prove her grandfather's research. Since her will and manipulations are so strong as to affect the people in the village both directly and indirectly, she infact fakes her death through the first six arcs of the story (the corpse in the barrel being a stolen corpse), and murders Rika in three of the arcs which she uses

title: Yueguo Chenshi de Ge
description: During troubled times, Weng Shaoying is one of the most famous singers in Dongping. Many people go to Song of Fairyland just to see her perform. However, under her glamorous facade, she has been controlled for more than 10 years. On the other side of Dongping is Bi Xing Tang, one of the most famous gangs there. After her father’s death, Yanchu became the young female leader of Bi Xing Tang, which caused a lot of rumors to spread. On one inevitably fortuitous night, the two happened to meet. At that time, neither of them knew that they would eventually become the most important person in the other’s life. Starting from that night onwards, the gears in Shaoying and Yanchu’s fate will forever be rotating together. (Source: Bilibili, translated)

title: Kekkon Aite no Jouken ni Pittari datta no wa Shokuba no Kouhai Joshi deshita.
title_original: 結婚相手の条件にピッタリだったのは職場の後輩女子でした。
title_en: Mr. Right Turned Out To Be A Younger Woman!?
description: Still single at age 33, Haruki Shiina is standing at the biggest crossroads of her life. While unlucky in love, she's popular among her female coworkers for her laidback and boyish personality. The only one who gives her the cold shoulder is Risa Takagai, a beautiful and capable new hire who is already climbing her way up the corporate ladder. Haruki sees her as her biggest rival and is sure that the feeling is mutual, but why does Risa always seem to be watching her...? (Source: Renta!)

title: Candy boy
description: Based on the popular yuri ONA series, which is about the relationship between two fraternal twins and their daily life. Yukino and Kanade continue their schooling, and Kanade takes a late night art class in preparation for her future. As before, she usually ends up fooling around and drawing her sister in strange poses before finally getting her work done. Kanade begins to question the feelings she has for Yukino... does she feel a pure sisterly love for her, or are her feelings more perverted? Note: Also includes a seven chapter side story, Candy☆Boy: Young Girls Fall in Love, and two additional bonus chapters.

characters.name: Kanade Sakurai
characters.description: Kanade is a high school student currently sharing a dorm room with her twin sister [Yukino](https://anilist.co/character/7325/Sakurai-Yukino). She is more pragmatic and less easy-going than Yukino and tends to get exasperated a lot, especially when it comes to the advances of her kouhai. She is also somewhat easy to ruffle emotionally. She often worries that Yukino is sacrificing herself for her benefit. Kanade is an artist and wants to pursue art studies, however, she understands that it would be difficult to pursue a career in the field and maintain a close relationship with Yukino. Her little sister [Shizuku](https://anilist.co/character/16153/Sakurai-Shizuku) is closer to her than she is to Yukino, however Kanade is more distant with the younger girl and does not make the same amount of effort as Yukino to be closer to Shizuku.

characters.name: Yukino Sakurai
characters.description: Yukino is the older amongst the two. She's very fond of snacks and Sakuya often trades snacks with Yukino for Kanade's pictures. She is a member of their school's swim team. ~!Later in the series, Yukino decides to work part time in order to be able to pay for Kanade's art cram school. However, Kanade refused at this because she felt that if Yukino started working part time and she attended the art cram school, they will get to spend less time with each other. Yukino insisted and started working anyway which in turn created a strain in their relationship.!~

characters.name: Sakuya Kamiyama
characters.description: A younger girl who is in deeply infatuated with [Kanade](https://anilist.co/character/7324/Sakurai-Kanade) with the point that she is almost stalking her. She is extremely wealthy and often tries to spend her money after the twins. She likes collecting old paraphernalia, junk and pictures that belong to Kanade, most of which goes to her makeshift shrine. Despite her overwhelming presence, the twins seem to like her. [Yukino](https://anilist.co/character/7325/Sakurai-Yukino) is amused by her and Kanade seems more irritated than anything, but they both seem to have some sort of affection for the girl. Initially, her presence was seen as a threat to Kanade as she assumed Sakuya was interested in Yukino. She became aware that Sakuya was madly in love with her when Yukino clears the situation up.

characters.name: Shizuku Sakurai
characters.description: Kanade and Yukino's much younger sister. Shizuku is a lot more level-headed than her sisters. She is deeply affected by the actions of Kanade, who she seems to care about more than Yukino. Unlike her sisters, she buries all her emotions deep down without expressing them but they later resurface in various ways, such as her cutting school. She also appears to be very passive-aggressive. Despite Yukino's attempts to become closer to her, Shizuku clearly spurns the attention of her older sister. This is possibly due to jealousy she feels, as Kanade spends more time with Yukino, and Shizuka would prefer that Kanade pays more attention to her instead. She seems quietly aware of the deeper relationship that her sisters may have.

characters.name: Isako Mikanagi
characters.description: Sakuya's calssmate. Always acts high and mighty; she proclaims herself as Sakuya's rival in conquering their Kanade Sakurai's heart. ~!It is later revealed that she is very poor since the death of her father. While she seemingly competes Sakuya for winning Kanade's heart, it the end it turns out that it is in fact Sakuya that Isako has feelings for.!~

characters.name: Eri Miyagi
characters.description: Sakuya's classmate. She seems to be the most level-headed of the group. She and Masumi are childhood friends. It is hinted that she might have a crush on Masumi.

characters.name: Masumi Kurasuma
characters.description: Sakuya's classmate and Eri's childhood friend. She is energetic and loves her stomach. It is hinted that she might have a crush on Eri.

characters.name: Yuriko Takanashi
characters.description: Kanade's classmate. She seems to be the voice of reason throughout the series, she is the one the sisters are consulting, when they have troubles regarding their relationship.

characters.name: Isako's Mother
characters.description: Isako's mother. She has been raising her daughter alone and has been doing multiple jobs, since Isako's father died.

title: Last Summer Vacation
title_original: ラストサマー・バケーション
description: I saw something in that girl from my class that she "didn't want anyone else to see..." Mizuki is a cute, bright, and popular girl. She is devoted to caring for her sick mother and seems like the perfect "good girl" in every way. Until Unno saw Mizuki in a situation she shouldn't have......? What happens when you try to escape from reality? A road movie about sad girls. (Source: Comic Bridge, translated)

characters.name: Mizuki Otonashi
characters.description: Mizuki is a cute, bright student who's loved by everyone. Outside of school, she spends her days caring for her sick mother.

characters.name: Ayumi Umino
characters.description: Ayumi is a gloomy student who sneaks alcohol into school and skips class. Her classmates all avoid her, except for Mizuki.

title: Uchi no Shishou wa Shippo ga Nai
title_original: うちの師匠はしっぽがない
description: Mameda is a tanuki who was born in the wrong era - all she wants is to trick humans, but that age of tanuki shenanigans is over. But one woman, a rakugo master named Bunko, shows Mameda it's still possible to cast magic on humans...only with words, not illusions. Mameda is determined to become Bunko's apprentice, but can she convince the stoic master to take her on...? (Source: Kodansha USA) Note: Nominated for the Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Manga Category.

title: Iseikai Tensei
description: Noah is a youth that is the final survivor of Earth, sent out by his scientist mother in a spaceship to find a new world. He then encounters a planet where all living creatures have "magic." As he searches this new world, he meets a girl who calls herself, "the daughter of the Demon Lord?!" This is an isekai SF fantasy where a young cyborg travels to a mystery-filled world! (Source: Alpha Manga)

characters.name: Noah Yesterday
characters.description: A young, full-body cyborg who awakens in a new world after being put in stasis by his mother.

characters.name: Eve Yesterday
characters.description: Noah's mother-like creator. A scientist who keeps bringing up "fixing her own mistakes". ~!Capable of posessing others via mysterious means, giving her full control over their body, always indicated by putting on a hair tie.!~ ~!Ultimately revealed to have destroyed the world multiple times before using a program implanted into all demons which activates when civilization progresses too far. She keeps creating cyborgs in hopes one of them will finally defeat her one day and stop her from recreating the world ad infinitum.!~

characters.name: Ellie Claydoll
characters.original: エリー・クレイドール
characters.description: Lord Balor's daughter. An energetic, go-getter demon girl who befriends Noah.

characters.name: Balor Claydoll
characters.original: バロル・クレイドール
characters.description: The current king of demons. Very sentimental and, at times, overprotective of his daughter, Ellie.

characters.name: Kyoukou
characters.description: A mysterious cyborg leader building an army equipped with technologically advanced artifacts to exterminate demons. ~!He was one of Eve Yesterday's acquaintances and the first of her coworkers to witness the horrors of her civilization reset system.!~

characters.name: Anna
characters.description: A powerful psychic, capable of reading others' thoughts and leader of the resistance, aiming to create a society where demons and humans coexist. Claims kissing her target is absolutely necessary whenever she reads women's minds. ~!She's also revealed to be The Pope's daughter.!~

title: Slow Start
description: The story centers around 17-year-old Hana Ichinose, who unbeknownst to her classmates, was a year late in enrolling into high school. Although it may not seem like a big deal, it is a big deal to her. She wants to catch up with everyone else someday. (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Kamuri Sengoku
characters.description: A childlike girl whose physical development greatly lags behind her actual age. She is an old friend of Eiko from elementary school, whom she adores, and becomes timid around others whenever Eiko is absent. Whenever she is addressed with a sensitive topic, she somehow manages to twitch her hair ribbon as an expression of her feelings. Her main hobbies are eating and sleeping (the latter of which is perhaps the primary reason for her belated development), although she is an extremely fast runner at sports. Her name is derived from _kamuriwashi._

characters.name: Tamate Momochi
characters.description: A bubbly, cheerful girl from [Hana](https://anilist.co/character/124746/Ichinose-Hana)'s class who likes to be friends with everyone she meets. She likes to be called "Tama" because she does not like her full name's association with the word _tamatebako._

characters.name: Hana Ichinose
characters.description: The main protagonist of the series, who just recently moved and now attends the Hoshio Private Academy in her first year of high school. Because she caught mumps and thus had to miss out on her high school entry exams, she was forced to repeat her entire final middle school year. As a result, she is very self-conscious about her current standing and that she does not have anyone of her old school friends in her company, and is therefore very glad to build up an immediate friendship with Eiko, Kamuri and Tamate.

characters.name: Eiko Tokura
characters.description: A tall, gentle, and level-headed girl with a natural charisma which has made her very popular with her peers without any effort.

characters.name: Shion Kyouzuka
characters.description: Hana's adult cousin and the landlady of a boarding house, where Hana resides for the duration of her high school period. She is pretty and extremely well-endowed, but behaves more like a teenager than an adult woman. Her favorite hobby is taking a close interest in Hana's private life.

characters.name: Kiyose Enami
characters.description: Hana's homeroom teacher, who summons up very little enthusiasm for her job.

characters.name: Hiroe Hannen
characters.description: A resident of the apartment building Hana and Shion live in. After an experience not dissimilar to Hana's led her to miss her university exams, the guilt of lying to her peers caused her to become a shut-in. She soon starts to become more confident after meeting Hana and is one of the few people who knows about her situation.

moegirl_plot: 一之濑花名，17岁。比大家晚一年升入高中，但这却是不能告诉同学的秘密。也许别人会认为没什么大不了，但对于自己而言却是大问题。希望总有一天能追上大家，晚一步出发者的故事。

title: Baka ni Kokuhaku
description: Ayumu Otsuki is a space lover with an ambitious dream—to meet an alien. Lacking friends or romantic experience, she starts an Astronomy Club by herself, to create a place where she feels she belongs. One day after school, she was putting up a poster to advertise the club when an upperclassman stepped in to help. The upperclassman introduces herself as Hayami, and Ayumu immediately falls in love at first sight with her! Ayumu's mind is now consumed by romance, and she goes all out to share her feelings. However, Senpai seems to already have other interests. She fell for a fitness junkie?! A peculiar girl's straightforward romcom!!

characters.name: Ayumu Otsuki
characters.description: A space lover who dreams to meet an alien. Despite lacking experience with friendship or romance, she falls in love with Hina Hayami after Hina recognized her passion.

characters.name: Hina Hayami
characters.description: A cheerful upperclassman fitness junkie. Despite her not understanding romance, she feels drawn to Ayumu's passion.

title: Nameraretakunai Namekawa-san
title_original: ナメられたくないナメカワさん
description: After putting up with years of bullying in junior high, Namekawa-san decides to make a preemptive strike when she starts high school. Her plan? Become a delinquent! At first, everything seems to be going great–her classmates are terrified. However, the head of the disciplinary committee is unfazed. She’s got her eye on Namekawa-san, and she refuses to look away in this explosive yuri comedy! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment) Note: includes 11 extra chapters

characters.name: Saya Namekawa
characters.description: The main character, a girl that was bullied and tries to act like a delinquent but always fails. Tojo's obsession

characters.name: Sayuri Toujo
characters.description: The disciplinary committee chair, obsessed with Namekawa, always tries to harass her.

title: Shoujo Kakumei Utena: After The Revolution
title_original: 少女革命ウテナ After The Revolution
title_en: Revolutionary Girl Utena: After the Revolution
description: Utena has saved Anthy by defeating Akio in the final duel, but in doing so she has vanished from the world. Now the student council members at Ohtori Academy find themselves in their own revolutions. (Source: VIZ Media)

characters.name: Miki Kaoru
characters.description: __Rose Color:__ Blue Rose Bride: Kozue Kaoru Sword: Épée Drive to Duel: To find "that which shines" Miki is a highly skilled and polite seventh grader who befriends Utena, despite their role as possible opponents in the duels. A piano player par excellence, Miki has fond memories of playing songs with his twin sister Kozue in his childhood, but her refusal to play with him in the present — the symbol of a much deeper rift — gives Miki a sense of loss. His crush on Anthy in the anime (but on Utena in the manga) develops when he realizes that they remind him of his estranged sister. In both adaptions, his drive to duel stems from a desire to find something to replace Kozue in his affections. All the females of the school, even older ones, idolize him, but Kozue threatens any girls who attempt to get too close to him. Likewise he is very protective of her, and so she tries to make him jealo

characters.name: Juri Arisugawa
characters.description: __Rose Color:__ Orange __Rose Bride:__ Ruka Tsuchiya __Sword:__ Rapier __(Anime) Drive to Duel:__ To disprove the power of miracles The captain of the academy's fencing team, Juri is one of Ohtori's most highly respected students, and even the teachers appear to be in awe of her.

characters.name: Touga Kiryuu
characters.description: President of the Student Council, Touga is an arrogant and handsome young man whose desire to be powerful drives him to cruel and unscrupulous deeds. Although he says that he wishes to be noble, he has little empathy towards anyone, and his powers of manipulation are second only to Akio. He also shares his playboy attiude and has many female conquests. He is a childhood friend of Saionji, although their relationship took a turn for the worse at a point in their childhood that is the centerpiece of their respective personal journeys. ~!Toward the end of the series, however, Touga's facade of chivalry is replaced with an apparently truer concern for Utena, to the extent that he very subtly attempts to substitute his head for hers on Akio's chopping block. Arguably, this is also an example of Touga's inability to see Utena as who she really is, rather than in a stereotypical feminine role.

characters.name: Kyouichi Saionji
characters.description: __Sword:__ Sword of Dios, Katana __Drive to Duel:__ To find something eternal, to claim Anthy as his Rose Bride, and to finally defeat Touga (Anime) Vice-president of the Student Council and captain of the kendo team, and is the first duelist Utena fights. He is temperamental, egotistic, prone to angry rages, often cruel, and extremely possessive of Anthy. His belief that they are destined to be together no matter what drive him to be physically violent towards her and continue to pursue her even after their engagement is broken. He and Touga practice kendo together, but Saionji is clearly very resentful of Touga, and especially cannot bear to be humiliated by him (a fact which Touga shamelessly exploits). Saionji is less perceptive, intelligent, and skilled as Touga, and despite his best efforts can never seem to best him. He is regardless affected by this estrangement from his childhoo

characters.name: Utena Tenjou
characters.description: Utena is a tomboyish, courageous and naïve character who lives to emulate the idealized prince figure from her childhood. She is forthright, honest, and friendly, and nearly all the girls in school adore her.

characters.name: Anthy Himemiya
characters.description: __Height:__ 157 cm A mysterious and shy dark-skinned girl whose sometimes vapid expression and superficial politeness seem to mask something deeper. Many people project their wants or desires onto her, and she's often the target of their eventual rage or hate. Her "doormat" behavior belies a far more complex personality. Anthy appears to house the Sword of Dios within her own body. At the beginning of a duel, she slips into a trance and the Sword manifests, protruding from her chest so that her champion may draw it from her. This Sword is said to be a key to reaching the goal of Revolution, and in her position as the Rose Bride Anthy is said to be the key to obtaining it.

characters.name: Akio Ootori
characters.description: Anthy's older brother, the acting chairman of the academy. Although barely present in the first season of the show, he later plays a pivotal role in the second and third seasons. His given name derives from the Japanese name for Venus, the Morning Star, which is identified with Lucifer.

characters.name: Kozue Kaoru
characters.description: She's Miki's twin sister who feels overshadowed by his talent and dirtied by comparison with him. Kozue resents Miki's affection for Anthy Himemiya and is prone to acting out to grab her brother's attention, most notably by exercising loose sexual morals. Like Nanami, Kozue also seems to have an extreme brother complex. She is very protective of Miki and is the reason that he does not have a girlfriend (despite the affection of many of his schoolmates). Kozue considers herself a "wild animal," wanting to be freed from adult rules and restrictions (in reality, she is resentful of her father remarrying). ~!In Adolescence of Utena she is shown as being very possessive of Miki, even holding a razor to his throat and calling him a traitor when he refuses to divulge details of his personal affairs to her. A car with Kozue's name is also seen briefly, though the director merely states

characters.name: Ruka Tsuchiya
characters.description: A master swordsman, Ruka is former captain of the fencing team and occasional member of the Student Council. He considers Juri to be the most talented member of the club and considers himself her mentor. ~! * Rose: Blue * Rose Bride: Shiori Takatsuki * Sword: Rapier * (Anime) Drive to Duel: To give Juri, the one he loves, the power of miracles. In the manga, Anthy served as Ruka's Rose Bride on several occasions before he left the school due to an unknown illness. He reappears at the school after a prolonged absence, claiming that he has recovered, though still not well enough to duel. He pushes Juri to duel Utena once again, but she throws the match after overhearing what she thinks is Ruka discussing with Touga how he's manipulating her. When she refuses to duel, Ruka himself is forced to duel Utena, and the strain causes a relapse of his illness. As he lies on the dueling fi

characters.name: Shiori Takatsuki
characters.description: __Height:__ 163.5 cm ~!__Sword:__ Juri's Rapier __Drive to Duel:__ To gain superiority over Juri.!~ Juri's childhood friend. ~!Shiori left the school after stealing the man she believed to be Juri's boyfriend in order to feel more powerful than her, leaving Juri devastated (contrary to Shiori's initial beliefs, however, Juri is hurt because of her love for Shiori). Shiori is in many ways an innocent character, in denial of her true feelings of admiration for Juri. Due to her inferiority complex, her attitude towards Juri is often downright sadistic (as her schemes are often designed to hurt Juri for no reason other than to see her suffer) and at the same time masochistic (as Shiori hurts herself every time she hurts Juri). Upon discovering Juri's love for her, Shiori becomes a Black Rose Duellist and pulls her duelling sword from Juri. In the movie her role as an anta

title: Angae Bada Wiui Sherbet
title_en: Sherbet Above the Sea of Fog
description: Sherbet knows she might run into pirates or sea monsters on her voyage, but what spooks her most is the ghost ship rumored to kidnap people. Although she’s relieved to hear that it only takes them for a special reason, she soon wakes up on the infamous vessel without any clue why! Despite her initial despair, however, Sherbet is delighted to find the grumpy but hot pirate, Granita, on board with her. On the other hand, Granita finds hell in the form of the bubbly little terror who can't seem to keep her hands and innuendos to herself... (Source: Tappytoon)

characters.name: Sherbet
characters.description: Sherbet is a young woman from a wealthy family. She’s bubbly, kindhearted, emotional, and often flirty towards women (especially [Granita](https://anilist.co/character/337789/Granita)). While on her way to meet her fiancé, Sherbet suddenly finds herself trapped on a ghost ship. Despite life on the ship being difficult and perilous, she actually enjoys her days there with Granita and the others, and seems to dread the idea of leaving. All her life, Sherbet has struggled with social interaction, especially with other women. She has trouble understanding social cues, reading other people’s emotions, and has a habit of taking things too literally. Because of this (and her tendency to flirt with girls), she’s seen as an outcast in high society: she is shunned, avoided, and called names. Although men are always flocking to her on account of her looks—something Sherbet hates, since she’s only i

title: Egao no Taenai Shokuba Desu.
title_original: 笑顔のたえない職場です。
description: New shoujo manga artist Nana Futami works hard every day while being supported by Kaede Satou, her female editor who is older than her, and Mizuki Hazama, her assistant. According to the girl herself, she sometimes drums up intense daydream delusions of occupational illness! A working girls comedy set in the entertainment industry, brought to you by an author who always draws various girls.

characters.name: Nana Futami
characters.description: A woman who writes a serialized manga about shogi (Japanese chess) in a girl's manga magazine. She is a rookie manga artist whose current work is her first serialization, and was Takizawa's assistant until the serialization was decided. She is shy and paranoid, and often receives various criticisms from her assistant Mizuki Hazama. She is trusted by Kaede Satou, the editor in charge of the series, because she always manages to produce work of a certain quality or higher even when the schedule is tight. She is also known as a "genius" among her collaborators such as Satou and Hazama, but she evaluates herself as "less than ordinary".

characters.name: Kaede Satou
characters.description: [Nana Futami's](https://anilist.co/character/298294/Nana-Futami) editor. She appreciates Futami's talent, but is shy and doesn't praise her much. Although she seems to be the one to lead, she often forgets to tell Futami important things, causing her trouble.

characters.name: Mizuki Hazama
characters.description: A talented assistant to [Nana Futami](https://anilist.co/character/298294/Nana-Futami). Although she has been the talk of the town on social media many times, she has given up on the idea of ​​being a manga artist and continues to work as an assistant. Futami calls her "Ha-san."

characters.name: Arisa Nashida
characters.description: Manga artist. Serialized a romantic comedy manga in a boys' magazine. A senior from [Nana Futami's](https://anilist.co/character/298294/Nana-Futami) assistant days who somehow ended up hanging around Futami's house constantly... Loves alcohol.

characters.name: Touko Kakunodate
characters.description: A female shogi player who supervises the shogi sections in [Nana Futami's](https://anilist.co/character/298294/Nana-Futami) manga. While she's good at giving compliments and is a people-pleaser, she sometimes worries about the world of shogi, which is her main job.

characters.name: Nekonote
characters.description: [Futami's](https://anilist.co/character/298294/Nana-Futami) assistant. A serious person who lives in Aomori and aims to become a manga artist. Her editor is [Satou](https://anilist.co/character/356303/Kaede-Satou).

title: Rakuen no Jouken
description: Collection of the following stories: 1. Rakuen no Jouken (The Conditions for Paradise) Two adult women figuring out the boundaries in their relationship--is too much freedom a bad thing? 2. Hoshi no Mukougawa (Beyond the Stars) Chapter 1 prequel. It's about how Sarina and Sumi first became more than friends. 3. Bathed in Sunlight Filtering Through the Trees A continuation of Sarina and Sumi's relationship. 4. 20-Musumex30-Otome About an art prep school teacher who feels like she can't compare to her new 20-year-old girlfriend. 5. The Opposite of "Seme" is "Protector" Chapter 4 sequel. Keiko wants to take things further. There are two more stories in this series in the Lapis Lazuli Dream collection. 6. We're Aiming For Love Now It's about two women who love each other just as they are. 7. Momo no Aji (Peach Taste) A girl struggles to convince the object of her affections to take her seriously. 8. Sakurahime Hanafubuki (Princess Sakura, Showered With Blossoms ) A story set in Japan's past about a cherry blossom that falls in love with a girl. The cherry blossom is granted a human body with the condition that if she nor the girl she loves are able to sacrifice everything for their lov

title: Naraku no Hanazono
description: Meari, a girl who moved from Tokyo to the countryside, meets the mysterious girl Colin in a "secret garden" up in the mountains. With nowhere to go, they share a "secret" in the garden that they can't tell anyone. They didn't realize the consequences of what they did....... (Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Gal to Bocchi
description: "I don't need any friends." That was what the loner Hina told the gyaru Hayashibara, the only girl in class who would talk to Hina. In spite of that, Hayashibara persistently spent more time with her, and Hina's lonely school life gradually changes.

title: Osananajimi no Ijou Kawaii Imouto-chan
title_original: 幼馴染の異常可愛い妹ちゃん
description: Yanagi, a second-year high school student, has a faint crush on Mizuki, the younger sister of her childhood friend Momo. One day, while rummaging through Mizuki's personal belongings in her room, Yanagi discovers the truth about Mizuki...?

title: Blood: The Last Vampire (2002)
title_original: ブラッド ザ・ラストヴァンパイア 2000
description: Blood: The Last Vampire 2002 is a powerfully drawn original graphic novel narrative based on characters and situations from the 2001 anime Blood: The Last Vampire, once the fastest-selling title in the history of Manga Entertainment. Taken from a concept developed by Ghost in the Shell's Mamoru Oshii, one of the 21st century's hottest young comics artists, the violent, erotic Benkyo Tamaoki, updates the Vietnam War-era anime story to present-day, 2002 Japan. The immortal Saya returns - a generation later, but still clad in her trademark sailor suit and armed with ancient samurai sword - continuing her unholy war against the vampiric Chiropterans. Infiltrating a gang-ridden high school, Saya more than suspects the brutal set known as "ORGE" is just the latest mask of her blood-thirsty prey. (Source: VIZ Media)

characters.name: Saya
characters.description: She hunts chiropterans using a katana. It is implied that she is the last remaining vampire and is called "the only remaining original." Saya has no weakness to sunlight but it is unknown if she has any of the other vulnerabilities of normal vampires. However, she becomes distressed when she encounters religious people and angry when people mention God in her presence. Saya displays superhuman senses and strength, as well as cunning, resourcefulness, and skill. The manga series suggests she was a human-vampire hybrid.

title: Spica wo Tsukamaete
description: Nekozuka Serina is a serious third-year high school student who’s studying hard to qualify for a scholarship.
