description: 郁娇女鬼恐怖游戏。要好的灵研社三人娘，深夜聚在一起，享受着讲鬼故事的乐趣。然而他们还不知道，专挑女生下手的「勒喉女」，即将现身…… 特征 恐怖故事・揭露真相 一则则恐怖故事，将越来越与三人娘切身相关。 故事列表： 1. 百合街的噩梦 2. 死怪谈之会 3. 假想朋友 4. ？ ？ ？ ？ ？ 增添悬疑感的剪影立绘 三人娘说故事时，剧中剧立绘将采复古的剪影，以酝酿不安的气氛。 「鬼就在我们之中……」 人会说鬼故事，但说鬼故事的不一定是人，或许有「某种存在」已混入三人娘……

title: 真爱的百合被染成红色
title_original: 真愛の百合は赤く染まる
description: 新しい町に引っ越してきた「真奈美」。 彼女はレズビアンであり、同じクラスの「愛実」に想いを寄せてしまう。 最初はそれを隠していたが、 すぐに見抜かれてしまい、衝撃的な言葉を聞かされる。 「私もね……女の子が好きなの」 互いの想いを通じ合わせることができるようになった２人。 しかしその関係は、徐々にいびつなものへと変化していく。 「まなみ」の愛に「まなみ」はどこまで応じることができるのか。 やがて、真奈美と愛実以外の人間達も巻き込んで、 物語は大きく歪んでいく……。

characters.name: 本庄真奈美
characters.summary: 町内の学校に転校してきた普通の女子学生。 引っ越したばかりで何も分からないため、「愛実」から様々なことを教えてもらっている。 あまり自己主張しない性格でクラスでは目立たないようにしている。 実はレズビアンで、同じクラスの愛実に心惹かれているが、告白するような勇気はないため普通の友達として接している。

characters.name: 神崎愛実
characters.summary: 町内の学校に通っている女子学生。 勉強も運動もできる優秀な生徒。全てのことをそつなくこなす。 特に親しい友人もおらず、周囲には少し近寄りがたい雰囲気を放っている。 隣の席に転校してきた「真奈美」には、自ら言葉をかけ学校生活を手助けしようとしている。

characters.name: 優子
characters.summary: 「愛実」と何かしらの関係がある人物。 常にゴスロリ調の服を着ており、「真奈美」にも友好的に接してくる。

title: 血百合：杀人魔别夹在百合间

description: B级恐怖片风悬疑喜剧ADV。琍琍暗恋着闺蜜小涵，他邀小涵去旅行，想借机告白，万万没想到，会有杀人魔接连来袭。琍琍愤而向他们宣战──「不要夹在小涵跟我之间！」 特征 2.5D运镜・临场感十足 采用2.5D运镜，使探索更有临场感。 搜集线索・揭露秘密 借调查物件、与NPC对话来推进剧情，以揭露真相。 多重结局・由你决定 琍琍与小涵将面临什么样的命运，取决于你的选择。 部分改编自TRPG跑团纪录 本作第1章是基于开发者与朋友跑TRPG团的纪录，大幅改编而成的；原始的TRPG剧本是マリコロ（Marikoro）所撰写，改编已征得其同意。

description: 初次见面便是吻——。 高一的初夏，紺野芙紗邂逅了自由散漫的家里蹲少女·芹。 一本正经的芙紗虽被芹耍得团团转，但不知不觉间，她的心逐渐向对方敞开。 相拥、十指交缠、彼此凝视。 两名少女第一次体会到，与喜欢的人触碰是如此令人心安。 她们渴望更加深入地了解彼此。

characters.name: 紺野芙紗
characters.description: 真面目でちょっと繊細な女の子。 頼まれると断れない性格を直したいと思っているが……。 今回も結局、担任から頼まれるまま饗庭家に届け物をすることに。 強がりはするけど寂しがりやです。

title: 百合二重奏
description: 《百合二重奏》（日语：ソルフェージュ）是日本工画堂工作室所发行的音乐冒险游戏。 《百合二重奏》的Windows版于2007年12月21日在日本地区贩售，另一名称为﹝音感训练~甜蜜和声~﹞，PlayStation Portable版由GungHo Works所发行，并命名为《百合二重奏 ～Sweet harmony～》（ソルフェージュ 〜Sweet harmony〜），于2008年12月18日贩售。台湾地区的繁体中文版由松岗科技代理，于2009年7月24日贩售，香港地区的繁体中文版由光谱资讯代理，将于2009年暑假贩售。 2009年11月5日发售 Fan Disk《百合二重奏 ～La finale～ 》（ソルフェージュ～La finale～） 木漏れ日のような柔らかな日々―― 女の子同士の友情を描いた工画堂スタジオの新作ミュージックアクションADVが登場。 舞台となるのは、古くからある名門女子校の『桜立舎学苑』。主人公たちは、この学校の音楽科に属する生徒。 誰もが憧れる素敵な先輩。想いを秘め、あくまでも友達として接する女の子。どこか憂いのある謎めいた先輩。 そんな少女達が織り成す物語をキャラクターデザイン『椋本夏夜』が描き、『榊原ゆい』が歌う！

characters.name: 宮藤かぐら
characters.description: 本作品の主人公。 ちょっぴり大人しいけど、誰にでも好かれる女の子。 頼まれたら嫌といえない性質で、いつの間にか他人のことまでやっていたりする。 良くも悪くもお人よし。 歌が好き。 幼なじみでふたつ年上の高屋すくねに憧れているが・・・

characters.name: 高屋すくね
characters.description: 学園の生徒会長で、生徒たちの憧れの的。 容姿端麗、才色兼備、資産家の娘で将来も有望。さらに性格までも非の打ち所がないというまさにパーフェクト。 弾き手を選ぶ特殊な楽器『フォルテール』の奏者だが、なぜかフォルテールを遠ざけている。 幼なじみのかぐらは、完璧過ぎるすくねに対してどこか違和感があるようだ。

characters.name: 幸村ちほ
characters.description: 主人公である宮藤かぐらの親友で幼なじみ。明るくて、いつも周囲を笑顔にする日向のようで、クラスのムードメーカー的な存在の元気な女の子。いつもドタバタと賑やかなので、遠くからでも良く目立つ。父親はバイオリニスト、母親が声楽家という音楽一家に生まれたため音楽家になることを期待されているが、本人は動物が好きなこともあり、獣医を目指したいと思っている。

characters.name: 天野まり
characters.description: 生徒会のメンバーの1人で、役職は書記。フォルテール奏者の1人でもあり、校内でも5本の指に入る程の実力を持っている。すくねに憧れているのだが、すくねに気に入られているかぐらに嫉妬し、かぐらに対して高圧的な態度で接してくる。だが対称的に琴美のことを妹のように大切に想っており、彼女に対してだけは一転してとても優しい態度になる。

characters.name: 垣之内雅
characters.description: 生徒会のメンバーで会計をしている。従順でおとなしそうな感じの女の子なのだが、内心はプライドが高くて意地悪。いつもは良い生徒を演じている。演技力は高く、周囲の人間を見事に欺いている。日本人とギリシャ人とのハーフ。

title: 百合ねいと！
description: 『百合×おしっこ=百合ねいと!』 おしっこ×百合! 禁断の組み合わせが今!! (ああ、目の前で……彼女が笑っている……) いつもの教室のいつもの休み時間。 最近ちょくちょく話をするようになった、隣の席でクラス委員の『猫柳雪』さん。 友達も多くなくて一人で居ることがほとんどの私『雪ノ下春』を気遣ってか、表情をころころと転がしながらおしゃべりをしてくれる。 そんな彼女の声が、笑顔が、視線が、全てが私に向いている瞬間。 朝、学校に到着してから今までトイレに行かなかったのは、今のこの瞬間のため。 彼女の声に、笑顔に、視線に、いつもなら感じないゾクゾクが身体の奥から――膀胱の奥から響いてくる。 もう、我慢なんて出来ないし、したくない。 想像しただけで口角が上がってしまう。 彼女の全部を感じながら、教室の中で、クラスメイトの居る前で。彼女の目の前で。 そして私は、おしっこを我慢することを、やめた。 (猫柳さん……私のおしっこしてるところ……全部、見ててね……) ■キャスト 雪ノ下春 :大山チロル 猫柳雪 :紗藤ましろ 白居茉莉花:霜月優 エキストラ:亜久城皐月、佐月ユーリ

title: 百合色少女
description: 『聖クリスティーナ女子学園』で教鞭を執ることとなった主人公。 学園一の人気者「沙耶香」ちゃんを、百合の花園から守りきることはできるのか。 主人公「木村 健」は、ある日、欠員の出た全寮制ミッションスクール 『聖クリスティーナ女子学園』で教鞭をとることになった。その初日、 健は大勢の学園生の中に、かつて家庭教師をしていた『沙耶香』ちゃん を見つける。 『おにいちゃん・・・？』 そう呼ばれた瞬間、何故か周りの皆の視線が健に集中した。可愛らしい沙耶香ちゃんは学園生達の人気者。親友は勿論、華麗な先輩、シスターである素敵な先生までが彼女を猫可愛がりしている・・・・。 彼女達は健を沙耶香ちゃんに近付けまいと、あの手この手で邪魔をしたり、純真無垢な沙耶香を香り立つ百合の世界へと誘おうとするのであった。 秘密の花園に入り込んでしまった健は、百合の香りに巻かれつつも沙耶香ちゃんの純潔を守れるのか？

title: 百合の花探求クラブ 禁断のトライアングル
title_original: 百合の花探求クラブ 禁断のトライアングル
description: 女の子による女の子だけの、快楽から始まるラブストーリー！ 『百合の花探求クラブ』 は栗谷女学園の一年生・芽衣と麻衣が設立した “女の子が、女の子のために、女の子を知る研究” を実践するためのクラブ。 だが若さゆえの情熱でやり過ぎてしまったせいか、 二人だけでの活動に倦怠感が漂い始めていた。 そんな折、純粋培養された超お嬢様として有名な 穂奈美が入会を申し込んできた。 自分の家柄の卑賤さを気にかける芽衣は、 穂奈美を性ドレイへと堕してやろうと画策するが、 性の好奇心に目覚めた穂奈美はエスカレートし始め、 芽衣も舌を巻く淫乱少女へと成長していってしまう。 Hな素質を開花させつつ、なお純粋に二人を慕う穂奈美の存在 はやがて芽衣と麻衣の関係にも変化をもたらして……

characters.name: 田上芽衣
characters.summary: 『百合の花探求クラブ』 設立者の一人。 家の事情でこの名門学園に通っているためなのか、学内ではちょっと浮いた存在。 Hなこと大好きで、日夜麻衣と共に女の子のための性の探求に明け暮れている。 「見たでしょ、彼女、なんにも知らないのよ。そんな人に、いきなりレズの道だなんて……」 栗谷女学園OBで女子大生。 海辺のペンションにアルバイトで来ている。 性格的には在学中よりも少々大人びた感はあるものの、 ざっくばらんないい加減さはそのままに、床上手に磨きがかかっている。

characters.name: 姫野麻衣
characters.summary: 芽衣と共に 『百合の花探求クラブ』 を設立した一人。 幼い身体つきの少女でまだまだ発育途中。 小悪魔的サド気質だが、怖がりなところもある。 「ふふっ……電車内でイくなんて…………たいしたお嬢様ね」

characters.name: 藤堂穂奈美
characters.summary: 学園の経営にも影響を持つ、由緒正しい家柄の出。 性に関しては、全くと言えるほど知識が無い。 芽衣＆麻衣とのクラブ活動によって、その淫らな本性に目覚めてゆく。 （い……いや、どうして？ 身体、さっきから変なの……っ！ それに息が荒くなって……お二人に聞こえちゃう……）

title: 百合が咲いた海
description: ――夏×海×百合の青春ストーリー！ 島で主人公を含めた女の子たちは、海で遊んだり浜辺でいちゃいちゃしたりします。 分岐なしのendは一つだけになります。 ・キャラ紹介 ★モモ 活発な猫耳の女の子。魚よりも肉が好き。天然さとがさつが入り混じったハイブリット系。 ★テトロ 真面目な科学者。敬語で話す。ただ、何一つとして役に立つ発明をしたことはない。 使用した素材など（敬称略） ・表紙デザイン 古條 凜 ・キャラクターイラスト azu ・BGM DOVA-SYNDROME ・UIデザイン 空想曲線

title: 百合に割り込むストーカー
title_original: 百合に割り込むストーカー
description: コンカフェ・あにまるぽっぴーで働く主人公のももちには、にゅうちゃんという可愛い年上の恋人が居た。 ハッピーラブラブライフを送っていた二人だったが、ある日、突然にゅうちゃんが誘拐されてしまった！！ ももちは愛しのにゅうちゃんを助け出す為、敵(ストーカー陰キャ)のアジトに乗り込むのだった。 ――ハッピークソギャグカオス百合ゲーム、ここに爆誕！？
summary: コンカフェ・あにまるぽっぴーで働く主人公のももちには、にゅうちゃんという可愛い年上の恋人が居た。 ハッピーラブラブライフを送っていた二人だったが、ある日、突然にゅうちゃんが誘拐されてしまった！！ ももちは愛しのにゅうちゃんを助け出す為、敵(ストーカー陰キャ)のアジトに乗り込むのだった。 ――ハッピークソギャグカオス百合ゲーム、ここに爆誕！？

title: 百禾梦境漫游
description: 这是一部关于浪漫童话、奇幻电波、百合的剧情向视觉小说。 “你在寻找什么？” 一觉醒来，她闯入了光怪陆离的童话世界。 化身为童话里的爱丽丝，遇到各种各样匪夷所思的人。 互相抢夺对方名字的派系、没有身体的魔女、种植着童话里能够毁灭星球的植物的园艺师、把收集名字当成乐趣的孤独者、喜欢喝酒并且只有奉上酒才愿意对话的管理者…… 爱丽丝感到一切既熟悉又陌生，童话世界里的人事物都是违背常识的东西。 “爱丽丝，我会一直陪在你身边，只要是你的愿望，我都会为你实现。” 一头紫色长发，自称紫萱的女孩一直默默陪在她身边，让她鼓起勇气面对这个异常的世界。 为了回到现实世界，两个人互相支持、互相努力。 她们在这个世界会遇到什么？ 童话和现实的夹缝里，有什么等着她们？ “爱丽丝，请记住，游走在光怪陆离的童话世界，千万不要怀疑自己的常识，一旦陷入自我怀疑，就回不到现实世界了。” 一直陪在身边的女孩，给予爱丽丝最大的忠告。

title: 百英雄传
description: 《百英雄传》的设计初衷是以现代风格向玩家再现经典的 JRPG 游戏。准备好带领 100 多个可玩英雄，穿越至一个饱受战争摧残的世界，成为唯一的救世主。 我们的故事始于 Allraan 的一个角落，这是一片由具有不同文化和价值观的国家群所组成的富饶土地。人类、兽人、精灵以及沙漠住民都围绕着剑和一件名为 " 符文镜片 " 的神器和剑不停上演着联盟与征战。 Galdean帝国掌握了可以放大神器魔力的技术，从而在实力上压制了其他王国。 现在，帝国正在这片大陆上搜寻可以进一步扩大其势力的神器。正是在这样的一次远征中，年轻而有才华的帝国军官Seign Kesling 和来自偏远村庄的男孩 Nowa 相识并成为朋友。 然而，命运的波折很快将他们拖入战火，并迫使他们重新审视他们曾经认为正确和真实的一切。 在社区的大力支持下，《百英雄传》成为 2020 年在 Kickstarter上最成功的电子游戏众筹项目。505 Games 非常荣幸能够发行《百英雄传》并与 Rabbit & Bear 合作，为粉丝提供难忘的游戏体验。Rabbit & Bear 和 505 Games 的目标是确保《百英雄传》发挥其真正的潜力，并为社区带去一款让玩家沉浸其中的JRPG 游戏。。

characters.name: ノア
characters.description: 诺瓦（玩家名，可自行更改） 投身战争的鲁莽卫兵 配音：梶原岳人 看看多管闲事的我落了个什么下场。 名前：ノア （プレイヤーキャラ、名前変更可能） 性別：男、年齢：17歳 出自：諸国連合の辺境の村出身、好きな食べ物：肉料理ならなんでも プロフィール： 辺境の村から武者修行の一つとして諸国連合が募集していた帝国との共同ミッションに参加する。そこで遺物クラスの魔導レンズを見つけることになる。 だが、それがやがて帝国と諸国連合の戦争の切っ掛けとなる事を彼は知らなかった。 その後も諸国連合にて警備部隊に所属する事となる。 行動的で考えるより先に身体が動いてしまうタイプ。時に損得を関係なく行動してしまい仲間にはお節介焼きと言われるも仲間達はそんな彼を好意的にとらえている。 なぜなら仲間達はもし自分が苦境に立たされた時もまた彼は助けようとするだろう事を知っているから。 台詞： 「リーンにもよく言われていたけど お節介焼きはやっぱり直らない病気みたいだ。 助けに行く。できるかどうかわからないけど、何もしないとか無理だよ」

characters.name: セイ・ケースリング
characters.description: 塞因 追寻理想的帝国军官 配音：赤羽根健治 愿它成为帝国与联盟的纽带。 名前：セイ・ケースリング 性別：男、年齢：18歳 出自：帝国貴族出身、好きな食べ物：ポーチドエッグ プロフィール： 帝国貴族ケースリング家の次男。長男は戦死。 才能溢れる青年で士官学校でも抜群の成績を見せ、古代の魔導レンズ探索ミッションで学生を中心とした一中隊を任される。そのミッション中に主人公と知り合い、共に苦境を脱することで打ち解け、それぞれの志を知る事になる。 戦略家であり物事を広い視野で捉えているが、時にその冷静な判断は冷たいと取られがちだが、その胸の内には自らの理想への情熱を秘めている。 長男が辺境での反乱騒動で戦死しており、それを通じて戦う事の意味について強く意識するようになる。 台詞： 「想いの力だけで全てを変えられるほど この世界は優しくは出来ていない。 だから自分は、自分の理想のため 時にその理想を捨て去ることさえ臆さないと誓おう」

characters.name: メリサ
characters.description: 名前：メリサ 性別：女、年齢：16歳 出自：森林を守るガーディアン 出身、好きな食べ物：ハーブチキン プロフィール： 森林を守るガーディアンの家系に生まれ、幼い頃からその使命を教え込まれて育ってきた少女。人なつっこい笑顔を見せる女の子だが、戦いにおいては戦士としての表情を見せる。 ガーディアンは森とともに生きる集団ながら外の世界の文化、技術も尊重し良いものは取り入れ独自の発展をしている。中でも彼女は進歩的な考えをしており、新しいもの、そしてカワイイもの好き。 ガーディアンは魔導レンズを扱う特別な技術を受け継いでおり、帝国、そして主人公ノアの同盟軍の両方から自陣営へと誘われその選択は歴史の大きな転換点となる。 台詞： 「ははは、森の事ならわたしに任せておきなって。 どこに湧き水があって、どこに兎の穴があって、どこに敵が隠れたがるか 全部知ってるんだから」

characters.name: マールリッジ
characters.description: 名前：マールリッジ 性別：男、年齢：27歳 出自：博物学者、好きな食べ物：鴨のスープ プロフィール： 博物学を専門とする学者の青年。この世界に存在する物全てになぜそこに存在するのか、を知りたいという興味を持っている。 天才的な戦略眼の持ち主で、それにより主人公たちを助ける事になる。 しかし、戦いを人の営みの中で最も無意味な行為だと考えており、そのための才能などというものには価値を見いだしていない。 台詞： 「そうですね、ではここで降伏するというのはどうですか？ 一番確実ですよ？ それは嫌……ですか。 仕方ないです、なら次善として勝つための策を説明します」

characters.name: ガオウ
characters.description: 名前：ガオウ 性別：男、年齢：32歳 出自：傭兵部族の戦士、好きな食べ物：クリームたっぷりのパンケーキ プロフィール： 多くの戦いに傭兵として参加し生計を立てている獣人部族の出身でベテランの戦士。 生活の一部として常に戦いがある環境で生まれ育ち、戦場で生まれ戦場で死ぬのが人生であると考えている。 獣人部族は戦いでも最も凶暴な部隊として戦うため大きな戦いになると多くの勢力から契約を持ちかけられる。 契約は個人単位で行うため、同じ部族出身者が敵味方に分かれ、お互いに戦うこともしばしばである。 台詞： 「リーダーが真っ先に危険に飛び込んでいくなんてバカな話だ。 損得勘定の得意なヤツならそれを笑うだろうよ。 だが、それが間違いだと言うならオレは間違いの側でいいさ。 たいして長くもない人生、損得だけで生きるなんてつまらんだろ？」

characters.name: リャン
characters.description: 名前：リャン 性別：女、年齢：16歳 出自：格闘道場の娘、好きな食べ物：激辛ラーメン プロフィール： 帝国の諸国連合領への侵攻に怒りを感じて家を飛び出すも飛び出した後はどうするか考えてなかった。 とりあえず大きな街へ行けばなんとかなると思って全力で駆けだして幸運にも主人公たちと出会う。 格闘技道場の家に生まれて子供の頃から父親から格闘技を教え込まれる。本人いわく歩けるようになる前に回し蹴りができたとの事。 台詞： 「うーん、難しい事はわかんないだけどさぁ ウチらの故郷に急に知らんヤツがやってきてさぁ 我が物顔で歩き回るなんて、やっぱ許せないでしょ、うん」

characters.name: ミオ
characters.description: 名前：ミオ 性別：女、年齢：27歳 出自：東方出身、好きな食べ物：笹団子 プロフィール： 剣の道を究めるために武者修行の旅を続けてる女剣士。ストイックな性格で、普段は無口だが腕が立つ相手を見ると勝負を挑もうとする。 普段は喋らないが、時々ふっと含蓄ある鋭い発言をするため仲間からは先生と呼ばれている。時々、天然系の事を言ったりもする。 台詞： 「お前の歩む道は一つだが、 その行き先は無数にあり、お前が決める事ができる」

characters.name: ヒルディ
characters.description: 年齢 21歳 出自 軍人一家の生まれ 好きな食べ物 シュガートースト プロフィール [セイ]の副官になる女性。きめ細かい気配りのできる有能な人物で時には命令を受ける前に準備を整えてしまってる事さえある。有名な軍人一家に生まれたが、父親が引き起こしたとされる不名誉な事件の汚名を晴らしたいと考えている。 掃除、整理整頓が趣味でイライラする事があると兵舎から兵士を追い出して徹底的な掃除を始め兵士の私物も含め全てを整理整頓するため、兵士たちに副官の機嫌だけは損ねるなと恐れられている。 台詞 「はい、準備は全て整っています。それがわたしの職務ですから、当たり前の事です」

title: 百英雄传：崛起
description: 《Eiyuden Chronicle: Rising》将带领玩家穿越至远古废墟，在惊险刺激的冒险之旅中，帮助一座城镇从灰烬中重生。 我们的英雄被附近符文遗迹（Runebarrow）中的透镜和其他宝藏吸引，当得知这座城镇正在努力进行震后重建时，他们决定提供帮助。当地人认为不应该打破遗迹（Barrow）的宁静，但英雄们会解决热情冒险者与保守当地人之间的争端。几位英雄会了解彼此寻找宝藏的原因，不断加深彼此的感情和纽带。 符文遗迹（Runebarrow）中隐藏着一个巨大的秘密，与其中一位角色的命运息息相关。一开始简单的寻宝活动逐渐变成了会撼动世界的黑暗阴谋，这也为《百英雄传》的主线故事埋下了伏笔。 这款游戏将会结合惊险刺激的动作元素和引人入胜的城镇建设元素，并跟从原创故事线，向玩家们介绍一部分将会在《Eiyuden Chronicle》中登场的角色们。 玩家还能获得一些能继承到《百英雄传》中的小福利。

characters.name: CJ
characters.description: CJ 高尚的寻宝探险家 CJ是众多寻宝探险家中最年轻的一位，正在寻找终极宝物 3人の主人公のひとりCJ。先祖代々、スカベンジャー（遺跡漁り）を生業としてきた一族の少女。ニューネヴァーへは、古代遺跡に眠るお宝、そして一族に伝わる“成人の儀”を成し遂げるために訪れた。年齢は16歳。まだ幼さも感じられる一方で、スカベンジャーらしい豪快な一面も持つ。

characters.name: イーシャ
characters.description: 伊夏 天才魔法师 伊夏是天才魔法师，正在找寻有关她失踪父亲的真相 在她的父亲失踪后，伊夏接管了代理镇长的职位，负责向冒险者开放采石场，并对他们的特权课税。 イーシャは、町長であった父親が行方不明となったため、父に代わりニューネヴァーの町長代行を務める。CJと同じく16歳。古代遺跡の採掘権を利用することで収入が得られることを思いつき、街に多数の冒険者を集めた。

characters.name: ガルー
characters.description: 格鲁 流浪佣兵 格鲁是个希望能一夜暴富的流浪佣兵 ガルー 古代遺跡の宝を目当てに街へやって来た 元傭兵の冒険者 己の腕一本で数多の修羅場をくぐり抜けて きた猛者だが、金にがめつい カンガルーの獣人ガルーは、CJと同じく古代遺跡のお宝を目当てに街へやって来た、元傭兵の冒険者。己の腕一本で数多の修羅場をくぐり抜けてきた、腕の立つ猛者だが、お金に目がない。CJやイーシャと手を組み、協力しながら、古代遺跡の探索を行う。

summary: 《Eiyuden Chronicle: Rising》将带领玩家穿越至远古废墟，在惊险刺激的冒险之旅中，帮助一座城镇从灰烬中重生。 我们的英雄被附近符文遗迹（Runebarrow）中的透镜和其他宝藏吸引，当得知这座城镇正在努力进行震后重建时，他们决定提供帮助。当地人认为不应该打破遗迹（Barrow）的宁静，但英雄们会解决热情冒险者与保守当地人之间的争端。几位英雄会了解彼此寻找宝藏的原因，不断加深彼此的感情和纽带。 符文遗迹（Runebarrow）中隐藏着一个巨大的秘密，与其中一位角色的命运息息相关。一开始简单的寻宝活动逐渐变成了会撼动世界的黑暗阴谋，这也为《百英雄传》的主线故事埋下了伏笔。 这款游戏将会结合惊险刺激的动作元素和引人入胜的城镇建设元素，并跟从原创故事线，向玩家们介绍一部分将会在《Eiyuden Chronicle》中登场的角色们。 玩家还能获得一些能继承到《百英雄传》中的小福利。

title: 百鬼夜行 剑姫无惨
title_original: 百鬼夜行 剣姫無慘

title: 百曲
description: 故事发生在古都南京。春末入夏之时， 去看望生病父亲的魏楸梧， 偶然在医院里邂逅了一位演奏六角风琴的少女——李佳蕴。 不觉中， 这对略显奇特的组合渐渐成为了对方生活的一部分。 加上经常来探望佳蕴的女孩贺佳与负责照看佳蕴的护士杨琴。 围绕在李佳蕴身边的愉快日常，就此开始了。 熟识后，贺佳带着李佳蕴和魏楸梧四处游玩， 遇见了形形色色的人、林林总总的事。 魏楸梧与李佳蕴间变得无话不说； 贺佳与李佳蕴也形同姐妹，日渐亲密。 而就在一切看来都美好而幸福之时， 杨琴向魏楸梧揭露了这虚幻日常后的真相……

characters.name: 李佳蕴
characters.description: 魏楸梧在医院邂逅的少女，自幼体弱多病，常常住院。 性格文静，会演奏六角手风琴。

characters.name: 贺佳
characters.description: 常常在医院陪着佳蕴的不可思议的少女。 性格开朗，十分关心佳蕴。 是一个不折不扣的吃货。

characters.name: 杨琴
characters.description: 医院里负责照顾佳蕴的护士。 办事干练，是一名非常有经验的护士。

characters.name: 贺黛
characters.description: 贺家二姐。在家里照顾家务，在学校是学生会长。看起来十分能干，实际上，是个内向的女孩。与妹妹贺佳拌嘴吵架的时候总是落下风。对大姐贺珏十分尊敬。可面对大姐对贺佳的溺爱时，往往显得有些无奈。

characters.name: 贺珏
characters.description: 贺家大姐。看起来很有气势的女人，实际上身体一直不太好，即使身体不好，却不妨碍她成为一个了不起的社会活动家。看起来年纪不大，在所有人眼中却又像个长辈，对两个妹妹都很溺爱。

characters.name: 夏初荷
characters.description: 来自34中学高二，与贺佳姐妹很是熟悉。

characters.name: 李秋澄
characters.description: 来自34中学高二，与贺佳姐妹很是熟悉。

characters.name: 叶丝砚
characters.description: 被称为小黑，或者笨兔子。 总的来说就是……宠物？

characters.name: 谷梁老师
characters.description: 贺佳的班主任老师，教授语文和历史。大体上是个古雅的女人，与贺佳关系很好。班里的大事小事都拜托贺佳处理。贺佳的行动力和威望可能得益于她的懒散和宽容。

characters.name: 龚彦彦
characters.description: 金陵女子学院附中学生，也是花房的管理人。与李佳蕴有一面之缘。

title: 百花缭乱
description: ある日、主人公・来生一馬は授業中に居眠りしていたはずなのに、 目を覚ますとそこは見知らぬ風景が広がっていた。 途方に暮れる一馬の前に現れた1人の少女・・・。 「俺、戦国時代にタイムスリップしちゃった !?」 一馬は元の世界へ戻る為、どんな願いも叶うと言われる 「夢成の勾玉」を集める為、戦国の世を旅することに。 時に戦国大名を打倒し、 時に戦国大名と力を合わせ来生一馬は戦国の世を満喫するのであった。
summary: ある日、主人公・来生一馬は授業中に居眠りしていたはずなのに、 目を覚ますとそこは見知らぬ風景が広がっていた。 途方に暮れる一馬の前に現れた1人の少女・・・。 「俺、戦国時代にタイムスリップしちゃった !?」 一馬は元の世界へ戻る為、どんな願いも叶うと言われる 「夢成の勾玉」を集める為、戦国の世を旅することに。 時に戦国大名を打倒し、 時に戦国大名と力を合わせ来生一馬は戦国の世を満喫するのであった。

title: 合金弹头：觉醒
description: 街机神作，重制觉醒！合金弹头：觉醒是一款由SNK正版授权，全新研发的横版动作射击手游。经典关卡复刻，原汁原味还原街机神作！超高品质升级，全新画面极致呈现；海量武器、百变战场、花样载具，带来前所未有的通关体验。Mission Start！就在《合金弹头：觉醒》！

characters.name: 草薙京
characters.description: とにかく餓狼伝説、龍虎の拳の主人公に負けないようなカッコいいキャラクターを…ということで、デザインに時間のかかったキャラクターです。性格の設定も、ゲーム開発後半になるまで、完全には決定しませんでした。開発初期の段階で、彼は「霧島 翔」という名前でしたが、こちらも開発後半でデザイナーから「草薙 京」にしたいと提案があり急遽変更になりました。京の先祖が八又のオロチを倒したという「オロチ編」に通じる設定もこのとき誕生しました。 KOF15 先祖代々受け継いできた草薙流古武術の伝承者。 三種の神器の一角である草薙一族の末裔で、草薙の炎を自在に操る。八神庵とは因縁のライバルだが、今大会ではオロチの封印を守るため渋々チームを組むことに。

characters.name: 不知火舞
characters.description: 继承不知火流忍术的女忍者，爱上了在其祖父不知火半蔵门下修行的安迪·柏格而在追踪他时投入了战斗中。 是为春丽之后第二位对战型格斗游戏中可使用的女性角色。（在《饿狼传说2》前，King也在《龙虎之拳》中作为对战角色登场，但是不可使用。）

characters.name: マルコ・ロッシ
characters.description: 本名、マルクリウス・デニス・ロッシ。PF隊第1中隊隊長で正規軍少佐（『初代』では少尉）。アイダホ州出身のイタリア系アメリカ人。25歳、身長180cm。

characters.name: ターマ・ロビング
characters.description: 本名、ターマイクル・ロビング3世。PF隊第1中隊副長で正規軍大尉（『初代』では少尉）。北海道出身の日系人。26歳（『初代』では23歳）、身長174cm。マルコの親友

characters.name: エリ・カサモト
characters.description: 日本人。『2』から参入したメンバー。本名、笠本英里。スパローズ所属の二等軍曹（『2』では軍曹）。広島県出身。21歳、身長168cm。「メンフィスの爆弾娘」の異名をとる爆発物のスペシャリストで、『6』『7』ではその設定を生かし手榴弾の所有数および補給量が倍になり、上下方向への投擲やより遠くへの高速遠投が可能。『4』では使用できないが一部シーンで登場。口癖は「人間はみんなひとりぼっち」。

characters.name: フィオ・ジェルミ
characters.description: イタリア人。『2』から参入したメンバー。本名、フィオリーナ・ジェルミ。スパローズ所属の上級曹長（『2』では一等軍曹）。ジェノヴァ出身（『4』ではフィレンツェ出身となっている）。23歳、身長158cm。富豪の軍人の家系の一人娘なため、親の工作で無理矢理スパローズに所属されており、本来はそこまでの兵士ではない（ゲーム内ではハンデ無し）。

characters.name: レオナ・ハイデルン
characters.description: 哈迪兰的養女，現正是哈迪兰領軍的"怒"隊其中一名軍人，拉魯夫和克拉克是其長官。 父親為"ガイデル"；原大蛇八傑集的其中一員，能操控大蛇之力中的第五種力量「牙」之力。 多年前因莉安娜一家被高尼茨襲擊，除了莉安娜外她的其餘親人全部喪生。 (一家慘殺案的捏他)其實傑尼茲沒有對莉安娜的親人動武，但卻引發了莉安娜的大蛇力量令她失控變成"覺醒莉安娜"；莉安娜的親人都是在她失控時親手殺死，但她毫不知情。但歸根究底罪魁禍首也是傑尼茲。 开场对决陈国汉敬礼的演出为KOF98的bug,后被作为官方设定(對陈国汉的怪力表示敬意)

characters.name: 一文字百太郎
characters.description: 正規軍少尉（『セカンドミッション』では大魔王）。捕虜に見えるが実際はわざと捕まった潜入工作員であり、特殊部隊の凄腕。アイテムを出さない代わりに、気弾を放つ能力と、接近戦では華麗なる旋風脚でマルコたちを援護する。プレイヤーであるマルコ達が死亡すると敬礼して去っていく。『ネオジオバトルコロシアム』にも登場。

characters.name: 马可波罗
characters.description: 旅行者，冒险家，语言天才……人们这样称呼他，马可·波罗。他的家族曾富甲一方，父亲和叔叔都执掌着庞大的商队，生意从大陆的最西面一直延伸到中部的古道诸国。可惜的是，整个家族人丁凋零。马可·波罗尚未成年，父亲就已经去世了。他由叔叔马泰奥抚养长大。 马泰奥视他如同亲子，为侄儿提供了最好的教育条件。整个家就像庞大的图书馆，堆满了父亲和叔父从各地带回的珍贵典籍和手抄本，还有各种各样的罕见的机关和古董。马可·波罗喜欢听叔父讲他们年轻时的旅途故事，从地图上搜寻父亲的足迹所踏过的土地。当他年长一些后，开始热衷于拆装那些古怪的机关，精密的调试它们，并向大师芬奇求学，请教深奥而奇妙的机关知识。 从大师口中，他听说了关于“死海文书”的故事。从古老的废墟中挖掘出的经卷，由商人高价收购带回，轰动了西方的土地，里面记载着闻所未闻的知识和机关。东方人似乎叫它“天书”。作为机关的权威，大师亲自鉴定了这珍贵的古籍，认为“死海文书”正是通往传说中知识根源的钥匙，并期待着它能被运用于机关制造。可惜事与愿违，文书不久后下落不明。 马可·波罗如同遭到雷霆直击。他直觉收购并带回文书的商人就是自己的父亲。自己却对父亲过去的经历一无所知。他匆匆辞别大师，回到家里四处搜寻，什么都没有找到。沮丧的马可波罗第一千零一次摆弄着望远镜睡去。他梦见了父亲远去的身影，还有报告父亲失踪的信使……忽然，他惊醒过来。信使从未报告过父亲的死亡，他只是一去不回。他突然记起那小小的玩具，父亲最后出门前塞到手心中的碎片：一片古老的，镌刻在石板上的铭文。 马可·波罗找出铭文，用精密的机关仪器来观察它。当阴影被投射到穹顶上，他看到了什么？一封信。许多年前，父亲留给独子的信。 “儿子：当你看到这些文字时，我已经不存在于王者大陆。不要伤心，这是每个知识的寻求者都会坦然接受的宿命。但不得不与你分离，也是令我追悔莫及的痛苦。请记住我爱你，我会永远在知识根源的另一端看着你。” 总督府的布告栏前，人头耸动。那里张贴着招募的告示，聘请勇敢无畏的冒险者前往遥远的东方大陆。接到手下报告的马泰奥匆匆赶来，目瞪口呆的看着侄儿一把撕下告示。他突然发现马可·波罗长成了风度翩翩

characters.name: 孙尚香
characters.description: 富庶的江南地区时常引来海盗和掠夺者的觊觎，甚至还有来自遥远扶桑的浪人骚扰。 江郡建立后，孙策将军派出得力干将，人称“铁血都督”的周瑜以强力手段扫荡不法之徒。作为最富天分的王室一员，孙尚香请缨同行，开始自己武道修行之旅。 很快，精力过剩的小公主和她那把经过特殊改装的巨大枪炮就扬名沿海。有时候是趾高气扬的“海盗公主”，有时候是端正社会法律的“风纪委员”，有时候是惩恶扬善的“怪盗女郎”……一时间，关于破坏力强大的神秘少女的身份传闻得沸沸扬扬。每当发生不妙事件时，就有无聊人士开出赌局，竞猜她将会以什么样的形象登场。连以冷酷著称的监护人周瑜时常都被气得怪笑连连。 旅途中，香香与名门乔氏被放逐的女儿小乔成为无话不谈的好闺蜜。她们甚至亲密的分享彼此嗜好的言情小说，当然还有对男生的喜好。 快乐的日子没有持续太久。孙策将军遇刺身亡。遗嘱公布时，王室沸腾了：他竟然选择香香作为继承者！周瑜连夜带香香赶回王宫，香香断然拒绝接受： “王位什么的，才没有兴趣！本小姐更适合用炮火来开路……找出要让吴地成为一个怎样的国家！” 最终，另一位兄长孙权继承了王位。香香扛着她巨大的枪炮伙伴，依旧雷厉风行的活跃在各个区域。 不过，这也让同样痛爱妹妹的孙权陷入为香香终身大事担忧的焦虑中。这方面，连足智多谋的大都督都表示无能为力。 没过多久，江郡向整个大陆张榜公告：“征集英才！军队统领，地方首脑，政府智囊，以上职位任君选择。条件：同意终身接受麻烦公主一名。” “大小姐驾到！统统闪开”

characters.name: Donald Morden
characters.description: 号称“Devil Rebirth”的男人，具有压倒性的魅力，让人自然而然想要追随他。出身中产家庭，擅长射击，在世界级运动会上曾连续两届获得金牌。以特等生待遇毕业于军事研究生院，在平息各地的纷争和反恐中做出了辉煌的功绩。 私下里的他，是一个非常细腻、周到的人，拥有一个羡煞旁人的三口之家，视家人为不可触碰的底线。耀眼的军功与强大的人格魅力，让莫丁深得部下们的崇拜与信赖。他改变了世界政局的混乱局面，让未来呈现出来一片和平态势。而这一切，都在中央百货店的爆炸声中，戛然而止。 这是一次本可以避免的恐怖袭击，却因为所谓的“政治博弈”，让无辜之人沦为恐怖势力宣泄怒火的牺牲品，其中便包括莫丁的妻女。失去亲人莫丁一度疯狂地挖掘事件的真相，而离真相越近，他愈发觉得上层的麻木与天才是一切罪恶的来源。前半生的信仰已近崩溃，但他是伯纳德。莫丁，他的存在本身就是许多人的信仰。 在多次抨击揭露政府与军队上层的罪行无果后，某个迷雾深重的暗夜，他带领着他的追随者们，走上了那条不归之路。

characters.name: Trevor Spacey
characters.description: 特雷弗在三岁的时候收到了父母送给他的第一台电脑，七岁的时候就完全懂得了二进制代码和计算机语言，暑假期间，他的家庭作业是为学校创造杀毒安全程序。出色的计算能力也使他早早地被正规军情报部门所关注。 特雷弗长相英俊，外形出众，很受异性欢迎，但他只对电脑程序感兴趣。因为崇拜同为电脑天才的马可，他报名加入了游隼小队，成为了一名中士。

characters.name: Nadia Cassel
characters.description: 纳迪亚的目标是成为一名超模，她也确实有这个才能——只要能控制住食欲。管不住嘴的纳迪亚被正规军严格的训练和健康的食谱吸引，竟然为了减肥从军！ 作为一名正规军战士的好处之一是运动量大到纳迪亚吃再多也不会发胖，但她更看重的是拯救和保护，那是纳迪亚留下的真正原因。

summary: 街机神作，重制觉醒！合金弹头：觉醒是一款由SNK正版授权，全新研发的横版动作射击手游。经典关卡复刻，原汁原味还原街机神作！超高品质升级，全新画面极致呈现；海量武器、百变战场、花样载具，带来前所未有的通关体验。Mission Start！就在《合金弹头：觉醒》！

title: 百合二重奏：La finale
description: PSP版ソルフェージュ(ソルフェージュPC版+PSP版追加シナリオ)をPC用のシステムに乗せ、更に新規シナリオと新曲3曲を追加したパワーアップ版です。 同梱特典としてゆうな(CV:たかはし智秋)、幸村ちほ(CV:伊月ゆい)、天野まり(CV:今井麻美)の新規角色ソング3曲を収録したボーカルCDを収録! 其他、ミニ冒险游戏『Milk Tea』(ANGEL ASSORT5収録)、富士見書房『ドラゴンマガジン』にて連載したイラスト小说、ソルフェージュ~~Overture~~に掲載した椋本夏夜による描き下ろし漫画、各角色を演じる人気声優のシステムボイス等を収録しています。

characters.name: 宮藤かぐら
characters.description: 本作品の主人公。 ちょっぴり大人しいけど、誰にでも好かれる女の子。 頼まれたら嫌といえない性質で、いつの間にか他人のことまでやっていたりする。 良くも悪くもお人よし。 歌が好き。 幼なじみでふたつ年上の高屋すくねに憧れているが・・・

characters.name: 高屋すくね
characters.description: 学園の生徒会長で、生徒たちの憧れの的。 容姿端麗、才色兼備、資産家の娘で将来も有望。さらに性格までも非の打ち所がないというまさにパーフェクト。 弾き手を選ぶ特殊な楽器『フォルテール』の奏者だが、なぜかフォルテールを遠ざけている。 幼なじみのかぐらは、完璧過ぎるすくねに対してどこか違和感があるようだ。

characters.name: 幸村ちほ
characters.description: 主人公である宮藤かぐらの親友で幼なじみ。明るくて、いつも周囲を笑顔にする日向のようで、クラスのムードメーカー的な存在の元気な女の子。いつもドタバタと賑やかなので、遠くからでも良く目立つ。父親はバイオリニスト、母親が声楽家という音楽一家に生まれたため音楽家になることを期待されているが、本人は動物が好きなこともあり、獣医を目指したいと思っている。

characters.name: 天野まり
characters.description: 生徒会のメンバーの1人で、役職は書記。フォルテール奏者の1人でもあり、校内でも5本の指に入る程の実力を持っている。すくねに憧れているのだが、すくねに気に入られているかぐらに嫉妬し、かぐらに対して高圧的な態度で接してくる。だが対称的に琴美のことを妹のように大切に想っており、彼女に対してだけは一転してとても優しい態度になる。

characters.name: 二条院琴美
characters.description: ツインテールが特徴の女の子で、生徒会のメンバーの1人。物静かであまり喋らないが、それでも性格自体は明るく芯はとても強い。ちほとは寮の同じ部屋に住むルームメイト。料理が得意で、毎日ちほの為にお菓子を作ってあげている。 過去にフォルテールの英才教育を受けていたことがあるのだが小さい音しか出せずに伸び悩み、声楽に転向したという経歴を持っている。これはPSP版で攻略可能キャラに昇格した際に、新たに付け加えられた設定である。

characters.name: 上月未羽
characters.description: PSP版の新キャラクター。かぐらの1年後輩で、織歌の友人。底抜けに明るい性格をしている。フォルテールは弾けないが歌うことが大好きで、携帯電話をマイク代わりにして歌っている。路上で偶然聴いたかぐらのフォルテールの演奏に感動し、かぐらに憧れて桜立舎学苑に入学した。

characters.name: 二波織歌
characters.description: 桜立舎学苑に入学してきた1年生(もしくは編入してきた2年生)。フォルテール奏者として天才の域に達しており、桜立舎学苑の特別待遇生。約1年前にかぐらのストリートライブを見て、かぐらが生まれて初めて気になる存在として脳裏に残り戸惑う。他人にあまり興味がなく基本的に無口。

characters.name: 垣之内雅
characters.description: 生徒会のメンバーで会計をしている。従順でおとなしそうな感じの女の子なのだが、内心はプライドが高くて意地悪。いつもは良い生徒を演じている。演技力は高く、周囲の人間を見事に欺いている。日本人とギリシャ人とのハーフ。

title: Utakata no Hana ga Chiru
description: Karen, head of the Literature Club, accompanied her childhood friend Himawari, from the Photography Club, to attend the drama club's training camp as a photographer. At the training camp, twins Asagao and Yuugao asked Himawari to participate with them. After greeting each club member and being shown around the mansion, Karen and the others participate in the rehearsal as photographers. The next day, a corpse is found in the mansion's greenhouse. Is this an accident or an incident? [Translated from official website]

characters.name: Ayanokouji Karen
characters.description: President (and the only active member) of the book club. She's a bit on the lazy side and kind of aloof, but she's also reliable, caring and protective when it comes to her loved ones.

characters.name: Kiriyama Yuugao
characters.description: Himawari's classmate who invited her to the drama club's outing. Asagao's identical twin sister. Jealous of Ayame.

characters.name: Kiriyama Asagao
characters.description: Himawari's classmate who invited her to the drama club's outing. Yuugao's identical twin sister. She idolizes Ayame and joined the drama club to be closer to her.

characters.name: Shiranui Ayame
characters.description: The main star of the drama club. A quiet and pious girl.

characters.name: Agatsuma Nobara
characters.description: Ayame's childhood friend. A big sister type of girl. She's the vice president of the drama club, and she does the majority of the heavy lifting in place of Ayame.

characters.name: Kooriyama Kikuka
characters.description: Scenario writer of the drama club. Detached and abrasive, she always has her nose in a book.

characters.name: Shirakawa Rindou
characters.description: Former president of the drama club and Ayame's girlfriend. She died in a tragic accident a year before the events of the story.

characters.name: Kadena Himawari
characters.description: Karen's childhood friend, neighbor and kouhai at school. She uses fake Kansai accent despite never having set foot in the Kansai region. Himawari tends to be shy around new people and relies a lot on Karen, who treats her like a younger sister. Being the only active member of the photography club she got roped into joining the drama club's field trip and decided to bring Karen along as moral support.

title: Penthouse Slaughterhouse
description: "So, why the hell are we having a party in a killer's penthouse?!" Lydia is a young woman who, infatuated with the rumor of a mysterious killer, takes this fictional man's place and becomes the Phantom Killer of the Penthouse. No matter how many warning signs she paints on the outside, people cannot stop breaking into her home for the thrill of meeting a masked murderer. One day, a group of girls attempts to break in to set up a party. Lydia, both curious as to where the night can go and somewhat in love with these girls, pretends to be another party-goer and lets them take up space in her penthouse. How will she charm one of these girls while killing off their friends? [From Itch.io]

title: Red Lilies
description: Irene is a young woman who is sent far away from her London home to attend Lady Lilianne’s Academy in the countryside. This school is lovely and has everything a young woman about to enter society could ask for: a strong emphasis on etiquette, her every need attended to by maids, gardens for fresh air and peaceful walks, other beautiful young women to be her bosom buddy as they brave the unknown together… [i][b]And it’s far out into the countryside, away from the smoke and fog, far away from the cities. When a horrific tragedy strikes the school just a day after Irene’s arrival, she and her new friends are terrified of who will be next. Because others [i]will be next. And with the headmistress not believing them, the doors locked at night, and no one around to help for miles, the girls are on their own… [From itch.io]

title: Useless Demon Lord
description: Lucille is an unemployed single woman living alone in her apartment, stewing in feelings of anxiety and inadequacy... but then without warning and due to a rather strange magical mix-up, she is summoned to be the new Demon Lord in another world! The demons aren't doing so well lately, and they're now relying on their new boss to return them to their glory days. Will Lucille be able to take this as an opportunity for a fresh start and thrive even in a world that wants her dead, or will she crumble under the pressure and return to her old shut-in ways? [From itch.io]

title: Faceless Date
description: Suzanne is a 20-year-old stylist and her life cannot be more perfect by fulfilling her childhood dream of working backstage at Tantalus Theatre. But one thing she misses out on is finding lasting love. She's still young, yet she can't resist the thought that her opportunities are already running out in the already limited dating pool of women of her age. Then she received a DM in the dating app from the mysterious Evelyn. Yes, there are many red flags, like how Evelyn doesn't have any photos of her face. However, she seems to be a lovely person from the conversations they had and there's always that secret ability Suzanne can rely on, so what can go wrong? [From Itch.io]

title: House Of Chavez
description: Take on the role of Adriana, a twenty-one-year-old Texan grappling with the recent loss of her mother. Accompanied by her brother Bruno, they embark on a journey to Europe to explore the house they inherited from their grandmother, Maria Chavez. Located in a quaint tourist town in Spain, near the border with France, the logical choice would be to sell the property. However, Adriana and Bruno feel a lingering curiosity, wondering why their mother kept them away from the house all these years. It's as if she had a hidden motive for shielding them from its secrets. Upon their arrival, Adriana encounters Silke, a former caregiver of Maria Chavez who now works as a waitress in a local pub. Silke holds intimate knowledge of the house, having spent time with their grandmother during her final moments. The house is dusty and shrouded in mystery, and Adriana will gradually begin to uncover its secrets from years ago. And maybe, she'll even discover what's happening there in the present. What lies in store for Adriana as she navigates this enigmatic journey? Will her encounter with Silke blossom into a friendship or something more? Can she unravel the mysteries entwined within the House of Chavez? [From Steam]

Okay, so actually you're more like an underpaid janitor, but you still get to be on a luxury cruise in the sky, right? In a world reborn under the influence of ancient deities, the Egyptian Orthodox Church emerges, a devout order striving to honor and sustain this divine resurgence. Wendy, a blue-haired Demigoddess is selected to act as the Vanguard for the Church. Alongside her stands a silver-haired sister of faith, named Hibiki. title: Christine's Care
description: A slice-of-life yuri visual novel set in early 2000s Canada. After a painful breakup with her boyfriend, Christine moves to a big city and takes on a new role as a nurse. She is assigned to care for Hannah, a woman her own age who is paralyzed from the waist down. Christine is immediately struck by Hannah’s complexity—intelligent, beautiful, yet deeply bitter about her condition. As the story unfolds, the two women grow closer, forging a connection that might transform both of their lives. Will Christine be the one to help Hannah find new hope, or will Hannah end up changing Christine in ways she never expected? Meanwhile, Christine encounters an unusual couple: Marlon, a muscular Latina with a commanding presence, and Liz, a delicate, half-Asian woman in a submissive role. Their dominant/submissive relationship is unlike anything Christine has experienced, but she quickly becomes fascinated by their dynamic. One day, Marlon invites her to take control and dominate Liz, an offer that Christine unexpectedly enjoys. Last but not least, Donna, Christine's boss, is grappling with marital troubles. Suspecting her husband of infidelity, she finds herself on shaky ground. Will Christine step in to support her, offering a helping hand—and perhaps a shoulder to lean on when she needs it most? [From Steam]

title: Flying High
description: It's the year 2039, and Neo Astra's at the cutting edge of tech. We've got AI that's like talking to a real person, smart buildings that touch the clouds, and cars that don't need roads. People's lives are easier, faster, more connected. But with all this tech comes questions. Big corporations, the ones behind these innovations, they're making life better, sure. But at what cost? They're everywhere, in everything, watching, controlling everything you do. Flying High is a behind the scenes look at our revered superheroes Solar and Eclipse, who despite insurmountable obstacles have a habit of coming out on top… of each other. title: a dialect for two
description: "The footage depicts two women. They eat together. If it's dessert, they will share the spoon back and forth. One eats, the other waits politely for their turn. When they're down to the last mouthful, the one whose turn it is will halve it and pass it back. They have mastered handholding in all its forms, but their favourites are to intertwine fingers, and to clasp their little fingers together. Most recently, they began to finish each other's sentences. As we understand it, the two are "lovers". They document their lives in film, as follows." [From itch.io]

title: My Darling Dark Elf
description: Nienke is a dark elf who lives in the small, sleepy village of Alpenrose. Though beautiful, Alpenrose is secluded, and it boasts exactly one family of dark elves: Nienke's. Nienke was singled out and teased for most of her childhood owing to her unusual appearance, and it doesn't help that a nasty childhood illness left her shorter and slighter than the rest of her peers. Nienke was always an outcast, but she never minded it - or, at least, she tried not to. She had her best friend Cornelia, and she wasn't lonely... Until Cornelia leaves Alpenrose to attend university, leaving Nienke behind. Nienke would love to attend university herself, but her overprotective parents don't want to let her stray too far afield owing to her delicate health. description: "You have to say the words. I can't say them for you." In a sleepy coastal town, Cait watches whales. It's her job, and she might even say she's good at it. But there's more to life than whales, and Cait is on a mission to find out exactly what that means. Her sights are set on Molly, a coworker and friend, or maybe something more. Cait is never really sure where things stand. There's only one way to know for certain. "Mhm. We're all unremarkable. What else?" Step into the shoes of Cait and experience a day of monotony, yearning, subtle glances, absurd conversations, self-loathing, binge-drinking, pub food, and so much more. "We were put on this earth to suffer, but we weren't meant to suffer alone." Littered throughout Cait's life are people with struggles of their own. Each has a story to tell, and Cait is always more than willing to listen. She'll take all the life advice she can get. From the Steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4200450/Calamity_Cait/

tags: Protagonist's Childhood Friend as a Heroine
description: Based on the manga and anime series by Satoru Akahori of the same name. The game's story begins on the outset of summer vacation. Hazumu's homeroom teacher Namiko Tsuki suggests Hazumu and her friends take a one-week trip to a small mountain village with a hot spring resort. Hazumu's grandparents reside in this town, and are two new characters introduced to the story. Three other female characters are introduced as possible love interests for Hazumu; two are the same age as her, and the third is the older landlady of the resort. The goal of the game is to pair Hazumu up with one of the five female cast of characters. The gameplay's main system comes from Hazumu's indecisive personality. If the player shows more interest in a particular character, the other characters get annoyed that Hazumu is ignoring them, which is displayed in a tension meter. The more Hazumu ignores a particular character, the higher the tension between that character becomes. This ensures Hazumu stays good friends with the possible love interests. In order to view the ending of a particular character, a certain amount of tension will have to be between the other characters, but this cannot be too great or the ending will not show. [Edited from Wikipedia]

characters.description: Osaragi Hazumu is a student, born male, at Kashima high school in the fictional setting of Kashima ward in Tokyo, and is the main character in the series. Hazumu is very selfless, thinking of others before herself and worries about her friends greatly. One day Hazumu is pressured by his friends Tomari and Asuta to confess to Yasuna. She rejects him, which hurts Hazumu heavily. He goes up to Mt. Kashima, but while up there an alien spacecraft crash-lands on him, seriously injuring him. In order to rectify this mishap, and in accordance with his own laws, the alien resurrects Hazumu, but in the process unexpectedly changes his sex to be completely female, right down to the DNA level. Shortly after Hazumu's transformation, she is unsure on how to live life as a girl and is initially very clueless about typical female matters. Despite Hazumu's physical change, there is not much change in her

characters.name: Kamiizumi Yasuna
characters.description: Kamiizumi Yasuna is a student at Kashima high school and has been Hazumu's classmate since their first year of high school. [spoiler]Ever since she was born, Yasuna has had a unique affliction which makes her incapable of seeing males, and instead to her males are covered in a gray, hazy blur, which makes it extremely difficult for her to tell one male apart from another except through the sound of their voice. Due to this, she was never able to get along well with others; on top of not being able to see the boys in her class at school, the girls who would normally interact with them were different compared to Yasuna, which built up a divide between her and everyone else. She ended up staying alone for years, and she thought she did not mind it; she did not intend to befriend anyone anyway. However, when she stumbled across Hazumu one day in her first year of high school, she was shocked

characters.name: Kurusu Tomari
characters.description: Kurusu Tomari is a student at Kashima high school and is a classmate of Hazumu's in their second year. Tomari is also Hazumu's childhood friend. Hazumu would often get bullied as a child, and Tomari would have to come to his rescue, saying that she would protect him forever. Tomari is very athletic and competitive, so in high school she joined the track and field club. In contrast to Hazumu and Yasuna who are not athletes and rather feminine, Tomari is a tomboy who does not often partake in traditionally feminine things such as clothing, shopping, or cosmetics. At least two of Tomari's female friends on the track team consider her very masculine, and like her cool character; one of these friends even says that if Tomari were a boy that she would have a huge crush on her. [From Wikipedia.]

characters.name: Mari Ayuki
characters.description: Mari Ayuki is a student at Kashima high school and is a classmate of Hazumu's in their second year. As a child, she used to love watching caterpillars leave their chrysalises and turn into butterflies. However, she never once thought that she herself would want to be in a similar position—changing into something else—so she merely just enjoyed watching the transformation before her. That by itself is enough for her, she recounts to Hazumu. Using this as a metaphor, Ayuki tries to explain to Hazumu that watching her loved one from afar is its own variety of love, though Ayuki never explicitly states just who she admires from a distance. Ayuki is good friends with Tomari, and Ayuki will often give her, and others, advice and help in regards to relationships. Keeping with her stance on watching from afar, Ayuki continuously observes the ongoing development of the love triangle between Hazum

characters.name: Jan Pu
characters.description: Jan Pu is an artificial intelligence owned by Hitoshi Sora as the automatic pilot of his spaceship. [spoiler]Her first appearance has her in disembodied form as the navigator of Hitoshi's ship and she is responsible for the crash landing on Earth and for nearly killing Hazumu. When Hitoshi comes to Earth to live in Hazumu's house, he constructs a gynoid modeled after Hazumu's own new female body, so Jan Pu looks about the same age as Hazumu, and their faces bear a striking resemblance. Jan Pu has the unique ability of levitation, and is able to bend light around her so others cannot see her. Other than technically being an artificial being, she generally acts like a human child due to being enthusiastic about meeting new people and possessing little to no social skills for a girl who looks to be the age of seventeen. At home, Hazumu and Jan Pu have been known to take baths together and t

characters.description: Hazumu's mother.

characters.name: Tsuki Namiko
characters.description: Tsuki Namiko is an English teacher at Kashima high school, and is the homeroom teacher of Hazumu's class. As she often proclaims, she has lived for thirty-five years and has never had a single boyfriend. This has enabled her to devote most of her time and energy into her students at school, but she is still lonely. When Hitoshi starts to work as her coworker at school, she becomes instantly infatuated by him, and goes to extreme lengths to show her devotion and mania towards her precious Hitoshi Sora. Namiko's attraction towards Hitoshi borders on obsession as she hangs large pictures of him on her walls at her home, and constantly is thinking or dreaming about him. However, since Hitoshi's species cannot express emotions, the attraction is entirely one-sided. [From Wikipedia.]

characters.name: Soro Asuta
characters.description: Asuta Soro is a student at Kashima high school and is a classmate of Hazumu's in their second year. Asuta and Hazumu consider each other best friends, and Asuta is one of his friends that pressures him into confessing his love for Yasuna. After Hazumu's transformation into a girl, Asuta suddenly finds his good friend Hazumu very attractive, and cannot help himself when he starts thinking about Hazumu in a sexual way. [From Wikipedia.]

characters.name: Sora Hitoshi
characters.description: Sora Hitoshi is the space alien responsible for transforming Hazumu from male to female. He arrived to Earth via his spaceship run by an artificial intelligence named Jan Pu, but crash lands on the surface [spoiler] where Hazumu is, killing him instantly. Hitoshi rectifies this by regenerating Hazumu, but unexpectedly changes his physical sex in the process. This is a mystery to Hitoshi for some time until he is finally able to confirm that Hazumu's "life grain" count is slowly dissipating, and by the time Hitoshi confirms this, Hazumu only has one month left to live. Hitoshi originally came to Earth as a cultural anthropologist and to study the emotions of the human race since his species has long-since given up any emotion at all. title: Euphoric Create ~Stairs of Affection~
description: Set in the far, far future-- Due to the development of a drug that makes one's fantasies materialize called "DesireIn", the people of the world live their lives soaked in these fantasies, and the concept of social links between people has been lost. Paying attention only to their fantasies, being totally apathetic to others and living a solitary life has become the common sense of the world. The main character, Nadeshiko, is a government worker living in such a world. Unlike the government workers of past times, in this world they act as emotionless machines, caring only for the mechanical means of continuing society. People have no dreams for their lives; and would hardly even notice if they were to die. Nadeshiko lives her life in this world passively, without holding any great dissatisfaction. However, she did nonetheless hold a certain, if only latent, feeling of gloom every now and then. If only to have a certain sense of "living"-- Unconsciously thinking this, she goes through a process of trial and error every day. Eventually, this feeling, this excitement, she begins to feel to some small degree when the numbers of "Insane" people increase rapidly, and they are culled for the good of the state. Then on one such day, Nadeshiko meets a girl named Momo. Momo lives in a way totally idiosyncratic enough to be wholly contrary to this society; pushing through life with a vivacity and earnestness wholly her own. Almost the moment they meet, she gives Nadeshiko a confession of love. Being in contact with Momo to some extent feels like a bother to her; but she also gains a sense of living that far outshines the culling or anything else she knows. However, after this she also comes to that Momo holds a certain deep "darkness" inside of her -- which causes an even greater attraction towards her.

title: Flowers Of Starlight
description: Aster's a simple girl, at her core. All she really wants to do is enjoy her new life at uni, join a club, and spend every possible waking moment playing Magica Fantasia Online (she's not addicted) with her online crush Starsiren. She's gonna tell her, OK? Just... when they meet up for MagiCon. Honest. However, a teeny tiny complication arises on her first day at uni, when Aster just so happens to bump into Maristela, the single prettiest girl she's ever seen in her entire life. And she's not just pretty. Mari's smart, she's funny, and Aster would happily listen to her ramble for hours about whatever the heck she wants to, if only she had a little more courage to do so. Torn between the friend she's loved forever, and the new girl who it feels like she's always known, Aster faces the toughest decision imaginable, and she's not even been here for a week! A game about love, new experiences, and the fact that nerdy neurodivergent girls are cute and you should date them. [From Itch.io]

title: Pillow talk at the end of all things.
description: A calm and quiet night in Rio de Janeiro. That is until you hear a shot. And another. And yet another one. The timing gets faster, with more shots, shots with different sounds. You wake up and realize something is happening in the favela nearby. Either gang violence or state violence, you never really know. That's the same situation where Lenon finds herself for the first time, and now it's up for her "friend" Graves to help her not to panic. It's just another night in Rio, and you know things will move on as always after that. Pillow Talk at the end of all things is a small yuri visual novel about trying to get calm during a time when violence is commonplace, and expected. Follow Lenon and Graves during what is just another night in the Cidade Maravilhosa. [From Itch.io]

title: Where the Anemones Bloom
description: Cordelia leads a life that most mermaids would envy. She has close friends and is part of a prominent pod, her future is all planned out. But Cordelia isn’t most mermaids. When her pod moves to the coast, she’s warned about the forbidden shallows and the dangers that lurk beyond. She’s heard all the rumours of course, but none of her friends will go near it. Curiosity gets the better of Cordelia, and she soon finds herself trembling at the fearful lights and hum of this strange city. However, something - someone actually - has also caught her eye. What starts as mere curiosity blossoms into something far more interesting. Soon Cordelia questions who she really is, and what she really wants. As she ventures further into uncharted territory, she gets closer to love but further from who she is and what she knows. Will she risk it all for a taste of the forbidden? [From Itch.io]

She’s easy to talk to and has a friendly casual nature that puts anyone at ease. Cordelia is frequently chosen for special tasks as she’s thought to embody a mermaids’ best qualities. She’s well liked within the pod, and that suits her perfectly for her role as a Revelier taking care of special events and social occasions. She loves pitching in to help out her pod. Yet while Cordelia is thought to embody core mermaid virtues, the truth is a little more complex. Cordelia’s curiosity and natural enthusiasm are part of a character trait that’s not so typical of mermaids: curiosity. This inquisitiveness has gotten her into trouble before. characters.name: Dunia
characters.description: Those that get to know Dunia find her very down-to-earth. She likes to take care of herself and surroundings, that includes cultivating friendships with people who share her interests. She’s open and honest with those that she cares about, and expects the same in return. She doesn’t have time for drama or people she doesn’t feel are being genuine with her - and she won’t hesitate to cut them out of her life. In terms of herself and her surroundings, she's generally neat, tidy, and well groomed. She's very environmentally conscious and likes natural materials. She also enjoys crafts, and even makes her own jewelry when the mood suits her. In her spare time she enjoys reading and practices meditation. characters.description: Cordelia's oldest friend. She's one of the lifekeepers in the pod of the Estides, the sixth biggest known pod in the ocean. On any other day, she's be tending to the greenery or teaching the small tails.

characters.name: Halora
characters.description: Cordelia's second oldest friend.

full_description: Cordelia leads a life that most mermaids would envy. She has close friends and is part of a prominent pod, her future is all planned out. But Cordelia isn’t most mermaids. When her pod moves to the coast, she’s warned about the forbidden shallows and the dangers that lurk beyond. She’s heard all the rumours of course, but none of her friends will go near it. Curiosity gets the better of Cordelia, and she soon finds herself trembling at the fearful lights and hum of this strange city. However, something - someone actually - has also caught her eye. What starts as mere curiosity blossoms into something far more interesting. Soon Cordelia questions who she really is, and what she really wants. As she ventures further into uncharted territory, she gets closer to love but further from who she is and what she knows. Will she risk it all for a taste of the forbidden? [From Itch.io]

title: Left Hand Magic
description: A talented Battlemage, you are struggling to find work for your type of magic in a post-industrial (Magitek/Magic Punk) world that no longer has much need for battle magic. To be fair, you were warned about this. Your parents, your friends, even your instructors at university all pointed out that Battle Magic, once the most important of all fields, has long lost its purpose. The monsters are all dead or uplifted to being civilized. Dungeons all long since discovered, looted, and destroyed. Even warfare is now dominated by magitek warmachines and tools, all the products of artificers and enchanters. But...battle magic was what you were good at, a prodigy by any measure. And you had a passion for wielding the elements in destructive ways anyway. Who doesn't want to light things of fire or fry bad guys with lightning?! You ignored them all and mastered your area of expertise, graduating from the most prestigious magical academy on the continent! Too bad that no one needs you now... Down on your luck, skipping from menial job to menial job, you're unexpectedly recruited by Left Hand Solutions, a company that's made up of similar people, each trying to find positive uses for their particular types of magic in the modern world. Given that those include Blood Magic, Necromancy, and Summoning...you wonder if they aren't just a little bit insane. Even so, the pay is good and the staff are all friendly...and female. Maybe this won't be so bad? [From Patreon]

Giuliana and Chanel are two VIP air hostesses working on a private jet. They ensure that their passengers receive a premium, 5-star service on every trip. After a demanding day of serving celebrities, royals, self-made entrepreneurs and oligarchs, the women realize that they have the whole plane just for themselves. The two start to fool around, being firmly convinced that no one will catch them. title: Hey, Girlie!
description: "Hey, Girlie!" is a free visual novel dating sim released on May 17, 2025 for International Day Against Homophobia, Transphobia and Biphobia. Play as chosen cleric Kristen Applebees and attempt to romance favorite sapphic characters from Fantasy High, including Tracker, Gertie, Kipperlilly, Fig, Lucy, and Naradriel.

characters.name: Kristen Applebees
characters.description: Kristen Applebees thought her senior year at the Aguefort Adventuring Academy was going perfectly. As senior class president, she just pulled off the best Valentine's Day dance the school has ever seen! But her high spirits are quickly brought down by none other than Principal Arthur Aguefort, who reveals to her that his contract with the celestial plane requires that he kill any clerics who fail to represent their god with a date at the Spring Fling. As it happens, Kristen is the only follower of Cassandra, so that responsibility rests solely on her.

characters.name: Figueroth Faeth
characters.description: Fig Faeth — well, Fig's fine with Kristen actually. Not only are they close friends in the same adventuring party living in the same house, Fig is the paladin for Kristen's deity's wife. Cassandra's only cleric and Ankarna's only paladin sounds like a match made in hell, except things are totally platonic between Fig and Kristen. Besides, Fig has Ayda!

characters.name: Tracker O'Shaughnessey
characters.description: Tracker O'Shaughnessey is Kristen's ex. Enough said. She's moving back into Mordred Manor and returning to her routine of being a regular at the Aguefort gym, so that will be... awkward to say the least.

characters.name: Naradriel
characters.description: Princess Naradriel of Fallinel is Tracker's ex. Enough said. And she just happens to be leaving Fallinel for Solace at the same time as Tracker. Something about learning Solesian customs from Elmville residents to improve Fallinelven-Solesian relations?

characters.name: Kipperlilly Copperkettle
characters.description: If Kristen calling Kipperlilly Copperkettle "four different dogs" the moment they met wasn't bad enough, Kristen's adventuring party also killed Kipperlilly and chose to leave her in hell. Rumor has it that Kipperlilly has been stuck doing community service since her return to the mortal plane.

characters.name: Lucy Frostblade
characters.description: Lucy Frostblade didn't have enough screentime for us to assume she and Kristen have bad blood, but surely she wouldn't be happy with someone whose adventuring party killed her adventuring party, even if her own adventuring party killed her first, right? Maybe they can make small talk about that in cleric class.

characters.name: Gertie Bladeshield
characters.description: Gertie Bladeshield was Kristen's rebound. Kristen left her heartbroken, so Gertie declared Kristen her nemesis. Enough said. Maybe Kristen can make amends at the Apiarists' Society after school, but that might not be the safest option.

full_description: "Hey, Girlie!" is a free visual novel dating sim released on May 17, 2025 for International Day Against Homophobia, Transphobia and Biphobia. Play as chosen cleric Kristen Applebees and attempt to romance favorite sapphic characters from Fantasy High, including Tracker, Gertie, Kipperlilly, Fig, Lucy, and Naradriel.

title: Paris no Sakura
description: Maeda Sakura, a columnist living in Tokyo, has just been dumped by her girlfriend of two years, Megumi, who claims that Sakura has problems committing. Realising that Megumi might have a point, Sakura meditates on this and concludes that her father abandoning her and her mother when she was a young child may have led to Sakura’s problems committing. A few days later, she helps her mother move from her home to an apartment and discovers a box labelled “Jean-Luc Dupont”. Inside the box she finds a photo of Jean-Luc, Sakura, and her mother from a few years back. Realising that Jean-Luc is her father and seeing that the box has plenty of clues that indicate that Luc moved back to Paris, she goes on a trip of a lifetime to Paris to confront her father. Along the way, she meets some beautiful women in Paris and perhaps she might even fall in love with one of them. [Edited from Steam]

title: Tales From The Under-Realm: Lilith
description: This dark fantasy yuri visual novel is the third and last game in the Tales From The Under-Realms trilogy. While there are a few references to the other two games, it can be enjoyed as a stand-alone story. In this installment, the enigmatic Nameless God tracks the odyssey of three heroines: Lilith, the half-demoness; Odette, a devout warrior-monk of the Goddess of Truth, Irijo; and Evelyn, a formidable half-elf pyromancer and familiar face from TFTU: After Midnight. As the tale unfolds, our trio finds themselves in dire straits, ensnared by ‘The Seven’—a cabal of sorcerers who have seized control of Grimoire and exert their will over much of the fantastical realm of Aravorn. Despite the grim outset, the combined valor and cunning of the heroines fuel a daring escape from Grimoire, toppling a swath of the wizardry dominion in their wake. Now fugitives, their sole beacon of hope lies in reaching Shacklesplit, a haven nestled across the ocean on the shores of Zoltar. The story will follow the adventures of Lilith, Odette and Evelyn, as they navigate through numerous challenges to achieve different potential outcomes. Set in a dark fantasy world, this game intensifies the tone established by its predecessors, offering a blend of joyous, sorrowful, and bittersweet moments and endings. [From Steam]

It's not long before she finds herself in deep over her head, trying to comprehend the mysterious power this new color holds over the women, and the power that they in turn seem to hold over her. She used to have an easy-going respectable life, full of doting lovers, where she never would have thought of stepping into a cockpit. Now, her towering steel body is her only refuge from a lonely existence of dwindling control in the face of ever-surmounting disability challenges and medical needs. Soon, however, the new riders she has been instructed to train—rejects from a secretive program which seems to have cost them their reason and moral faculties—begin to foster in her a new envy. The spectacle of their sadistic sweetings upon each other reach into the heights of agony and ecstacy, while pushing the envelope of what's even survivable. She can't bring herself to care they live as societal refuse, not when every embrace of theirs suffused with amor fati abundant curses her to be reminded of all she has lost. So why then, is a face that looks like hers staring back at her from their past photos? Who is this unsightly doppelganger of hers that they called their former ace, and how is this spectre from the past so possessed the confidence and connection she lacks that it feels as though it's taunting her? Who is this loathsome black mirror called Nisha Delacroix? [From itch.io]

A found footage-inspired Appalchian horror yuri visual novel about girls hunting a cryptid deep in the woods of Pennsyltucky, and the haunting cosmic tragedy unraveled by their search. [Edited from itch.io]

title: Tortoise Love Story
description: Tortoise Tortoisson isn't just a lesbian, she's also trying to become a human. On a fateful morning, she falls head over shell for former squirrel Shelly Custard. The road to Tortoise's humanity and her love for Shelly will take courage, fear, and the resolve to change. Will Tortoise make her dreams come true?! [From itch.io]

title: Paraphrase
description: It’s been a year since Erin has gone to work. She barely leaves her apartment, and when she does, it’s for quick errands at most. The apartment itself is a mess, dishes piled in the sink and trash bags on the floor by her bed. She’s haunted by dreams of Gwen, her wife of 14 years, almost every night; around the apartment, she talks to herself out loud. It’s as though she can hear Gwen responding, saying all of the things she most fears Gwen would say to her. In a word, she’s stuck. She can barely take care of herself. Erin isn’t completely alone, however. She has a frequent visitor: Viv, a woman much younger than her. Viv helps Erin out around the house, picks up her medications, brings her food. If Viv weren’t here to help, things would surely be much worse for Erin. But Erin and Viv aren’t exactly friends. It’s only because of Gwen that they know each other at all. Their relationship goes back more than a decade, and for many of those years it was distant or strained. The terms of that relationship are more unstable than ever. If it changed, it’s not clear what it would change into — or whether that change would be good for the two of them at all. [From itch.io]

title: Strawberries for Salad
description: Naomi lives alone in an apartment in an old Victorian near the local university. She is preparing a salad in which strawberries are an important ingredient. To prepare the salad, they must be cut into thin slices of about equal size before being tossed with the rest of the salad. There’s an art to this: her babysitter taught her, when she was a kid. That’s why preparing this salad is special — a yearly ritual for when strawberries are back in season. Naomi did not always live in an old Victorian near the local university. She’s lived in many different houses and apartments since she came to town. She hadn’t even really wanted to move here, as best as she remembers. It’s just that things had been so difficult with her ex-girlfriend Faith, by the end, and before that… Well, maybe it would just be better to start from the beginning, to really get everything straight. [From itch.io]

description: Dear Mom: My Letter to You is a journey of loss, acceptance, and the bonds made along the way. The story stars high school student Ayame Kawasaki who blames herself for her mother's suicide. Having closed off her connections with her friends for a whole year, Ayame is finally restarting her life, repeating her second year at Yamada Hoshi High School. It's up to Ayame to build and maintain her relationships, new and old, while coming to terms with the reality of her mother's death. [From Steam]

characters.name: Ayame Kawasaki
characters.description: Likes: Drawing, Manga, Math, Curry Dislikes: Being alone, Rumors, Ghosts Quote: "Back into the Abyss..." Ayame has a big heart and loves food and manga almost as much as she loves her friends and family. However, her quirky and spontaneous personality has always made her an easy target for bullies. Ayame's depression and anxiety take a turn for the worse following her mother's suicide. After taking a year off, Ayame is finally ready to confront reality— for better or worse. [From Steam]

characters.name: Miamo Shirogane
characters.description: Likes: Singing, Crochetting, Cats Dislikes: Gossip, Snakes Quote: "You incurable idiot!" Miamo is the confident, charismatic, and high-achieving Student Council President of Yamada Hoshi High. Her reputation as a model student has led her to develop an ego and demanding lifestyle that often strains her relationships. A certain incident resulted in her falling out with Ayame, who once saw her as a dependable older sister figure. [From Steam]

characters.name: Perrine Finch
characters.description: Likes: Playing Guitar, Nature Walks Dislikes: People Bullying Ayame, Fighting Quote: "I'm so glad you're okay!" Perrine is Ayame and Miamo's childhood friend. She’s generally shy and reserved, but very energetic and lively around close friends. She believes in the goodness of others and can be too trusting of them. She finds herself in a new crowd after Ayame's year off from school, but Ayame still holds a special place in her heart. [From Steam]

characters.name: Miso Shizuki
characters.description: Likes: Cooking, Blogging, Taking Naps Dislikes: Ungrateful People, Cockroaches Quote: "Jeez, you're so weird..." Miso is Ayame's classmate and first friend after she returns to school. She’s a fun-loving, caring, and playful girl with zero tolerance for nonsense. She brings out the best in others and puts smiles on people's faces. Cooking is her life passion, and she loves sharing her food with others. She volunteers in her free time to help the poor. [From Steam]

characters.name: Chip Mizuhara
characters.description: Likes: Girls, Romance Visual Novels Dislikes: Being Single, Big Cwords Quote: "I'm really sorry!!!" Chip is Ayame's shy classmate who often isn't taken seriously by others. He's equally as sweet as he is awkward and is sensitive towards the feelings of others. There's just one problem— he's an absolute nervous wreck when it comes to girls. Luckily for him, an awkward encounter with Ayame may give him a chance to solve his "girl" problem. [From Steam]

characters.name: Ginta Kawasaki
characters.description: Ayame's older brother. Having a great sense of humor, he always teases his sister, whether it's making up stories or using a bucket load of memes.

characters.name: Akio Kawasaki
characters.description: Father of Ayame and Ginta. He's a hard-working individual in the mangaka industry. He tries to balance his time to better support his family.

characters.name: Nao Kawasaki
characters.description: Late mother of Ayame and Ginta, and wife of Akio. She had a warm and caring personality, as well as a knack for making funny (and most time non-sensical) jokes with her family.

But maybe it’s time to switch things up and cross a few things off your bucket list? After all, there’s more to life than straight As, and maybe old and new friendships can blossom into something more. [From itch.io]

It feels so nice, and so you crave that. You crave them. This is what love feel like, right? Play as a love-stuck romantic who is trying to understand these complicated feelings all while taking down the competition! Urgh, there's so much to do but so little time to do it as prom is in three days! Stalk your crush? Eliminate a rival? Or, perhaps make a new friend along the way? Just go win love — no matter what, no matter how! [From Itch.io]

characters.description: Rosalie, born as a commoner, has become the popular 'saintess' and beloved idol of the public because of her soft personality. Even though she took Lucena's place, she secretly idolises Lucena. Now, she's only a budding spring flower in the court of Iriyn, but time will reveal her potential. [From Steam]

Depending on your choices, she could become a formidable ally or fatal enemy, or something in between? [From Steam]

description: Airi is a university student. She enjoys her school life, but she has something else in mind. Yes, she wants to be a manga artist. Ryou, her old friend, knows it and tells her to go for it. Airi makes up her mind and starts working as an assistant to a famous manga artist. However, her parents learn about it and they are opposed to it. So Airi starts living with Ryou's friends at Ryou's house... [From Himeyashop]

characters.name: Kurihara Airi
characters.description: 2nd year university student. It's been her dream since a child to become a great manga artist.

characters.name: Adachi Ryou
characters.description: Favorite Color: Blue/Black Special Skills: Cooking/Housework/Making Candy Hobby: Writing Feelings Toward the Protagonist: Childhood Friend/If I'm not with her it's no good 3rd year university student. His father owns a large confectionery company and despite his own wishes he is supposed to inherit it. He's in charge of his parents vacation house and rents rooms out to his friends.

characters.name: Todoroki Keigo
characters.description: Favorite Color: White Special Skills: Having Strange Dreams/Eating Heavenly Hobby: Searching for Data/Napping Feelings Toward the Protagonist: An Important Pupil/I have to properly take care of her! A featured manga artist for a big publishing company. The protagonist is his assistant. He's a relative of Ryou's.

characters.name: Hattori Hibiki
characters.description: Favorite Color: Primary Colors Special Skills: Copying/His Secret Way to Draw Designs and Pictures Hobby: Buying Brand Name Stuff/Dates Feelings Toward the Protagonist: A Cute Manga Friend/I want to get to know her better 3rd year university student. He's been good at drawing since a young age, currently he draws fan works not because he is passionate about it but becuase it makes him money. An old classmate of Ryou's since high school, He's currently renting a room at his house.

characters.name: Castis Kyouichi
characters.description: Favorite Color: Purple Special Skills: Singing/Imitation Hobby: Reading Manga Feelings Toward the Protagonist: Fellow Newbie/A friend to encourage A newly debuted entertainer and voice actor. He's half American half Japanese. He rose to popularity recently after doing a commercial for the company Ryou's father owns.

characters.name: Kanzaki Kojirou
characters.description: Favorite Color: Black Special Skills: Pretending to Listen Hobby: Sweating at the Gym Feelings Toward the Protagonist: Useless Newbie/It would be good if she listened to what I say An editor at the publishing company Keigo is employed by. A cool and composed guy who reads trends and makes important decisions about what to publish.

characters.name: Suzuoka Ren
characters.description: Favorite Color: Any Refined Color Combination Special Skills: Traditional Japanese Dance Hobby: Teasing the Protagonist Feelings Toward the Protagonist: And Important Friend/I won't forgive anyone that would make her cry 2nd year university student. title: Sumire no Tsubomi Fan Disc ~Wedding Daisakusen~
title_original: すみれの蕾 fan disc～ウェディング大作戦～
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: A fandisc of Sumire no Tsubomi. Wedding Daisakusen features slice-of-life scenearios of your time together with the hero of your choosing. Unlike the original, instead of making selections to end up with the desired hero, players are able to choose which character stories they would like to view in a categorised list. Previously support-only characters have been given their own scenarios.

characters.name: Hayasaka Satsuki
characters.description: Satsuki is an unconfident, shy third-year high schooler afraid to fall in love (and of men to a small extent). Satsuki's negative attitude to romance was born from an event 5 years ago, during junior high school. She decided to pluck up her courage and confess her feelings to her first love and childhood friend, Kanade. However, she overhears Kanade saying to his classmate that he has no interest whatsoever in "a girl like her". To make matters worse, just before he was bound for Austria, Kanade told her that she was ugly and that she should keep her glasses on to hide her hideous face. In spite of her plain appearance, Satsuki has a great love for sewing and clothes. After seeing a Takarazuka (a Japanese musical where female actresses take on roles as male characters) performance, Satsuki is greatly moved by the show, and by Jun Hikari, whom acted as the male hero. Now an enthusiastic f

characters.name: Suzushiro Kanade
characters.description: The blunt and stand-offish childhood friend of Satsuki. The root of her aversion to romance, Kanade frequently called her ugly, and is the reason why she rarely removes her glasses. A gifted pianist, Kanade trained in Europe to further his skills. Out of the blue, he returns to Japan to perform in a concert, and seems to have changed very little, personality-wise. [Spoiler]After high school, he travels to Europe again to continue his musical studies. He becomes a famous pianist, under his performer alias, Tomokusa Sou

characters.name: Yanagi Touwa
characters.description: Touwa is the second-in-charge of the school's Theatre Club. Almost nothing like his loud and attention-seeking childhood friend, Sei'ichiro, Touwa is antisocial, blunt, stoic and somewhat of a sadist. His father is a well-respected director working for the Stella Theatre, where Jun Hikari performs. [spoiler]After high school, Touwa goes on to become a theatre director at the Stella Theatre.

characters.name: Azuma Seiichirou
characters.description: The president of the Theatre Club, although he passes on most of the administrative duties to Touwa. From a wealthy family, Seiichirou is somewhat spoiled, though not unpleasantly arrogant. Proud of his family's traditional Japanese roots, his likes and interests are all associated as such- e.g., Kabuki theatre, his preference for wearing Hakama (kimono for men) as opposed to western clothing (outside of school), and even commuting to school via a human-drawn carriage. [Spoiler]After high school, Seiichirou becomes a famous Kabuki actor, as well as a popular personality on a national quiz television show. His older cousin works alongside Jun Hikari as her Senpai

characters.name: Yuki
characters.description: A member of the Theatre Club, Yuki is energetic, friendly and positive, in direct contrast to most of its members. He openly shows his affection for Satsuki, though never laciviously. In spite of his child-like cheer, Yuki is surprisingly perceptive of everything that goes on around him. Since he works part time in the props department at the Stella Theatre during the day, he attends and studies at school in the evening. As a result, he can't attend the club as often as he'd like. He is self-conscious of his short height, and is quick to redeem himself as the physically strongest of the club. [Spoiler]Yuki suffered from memory loss, and was found by his current guardian. He later discovers that he is a partial entity of Misumi Kei, a scripwriter who is in a coma. characters.name: Kusakabe Haru
characters.description: Haru is a long-time member of the Theatre Club, and also Satsuki's classmate. Meek, quiet and very shy, Haru is a pacifist and tries to avoid directly stating his point of view- especially when Touwa and Sei'ichirou argue (though he finds himself getting involved anyway). He is the gentlest and kindest towards Satsuki and never orders her around. Haru enjoys creative writing, and does so at any spare moment he gets. Though from a vastly wealthy family, Haru has almost no interest in money or material possessions. In spite of his docile nature, everyone is careful not to overly upset Haru, as he is heavily hinted to be scary when he finally loses his patience. [Spoiler]After high school, Haru becomes a successful professional author. Beneath his gentle exterior lies a dark nature- deep down, Haru is dangerously possessive. His sexual desires are somewhat dark too, as he confesses to imagi

characters.name: Jun Hikari
characters.description: The handsome actress that inspired Satsuki to love theatre. Hikari is brave, confident and strong, but gentle and kind. Her popularity and rising talent threatens her senior acting peers, and as a result, Hikari is subject to their bullying. In spite of this, she remains strong and loves her job. [Spoiler]Her true name is Izumi Hikari. She intially enlists Satsuki to be her fan manager, but after Satsuki got her dream job of being in the costumes department, Hikari eventually re-enlists her as her stylist.

description: The best people will lead the best nation! I propose to give them the treatment they deserve. A huge nationwide selection competition is launched. In other words, the curtain rises on the National Student Body President Contest. This tournament to determine the true president, the "King of the Association"... The "Kaiou Battle" became known as the "Battle of the Kaious". There was a high school that won the "Kaiou Battle" for the first time in a row. St. Marduk Academy was created to produce the elites who would lead the true Japan. Among the fierce fighters who excelled in both literary and military arts gathered at this school from all over the country, there was one who was the first to win the "Kaiou Battle". Kanzaki Reika reached the pinnacle of student body president as a first-year student. However, the glory she had achieved through her personal power was lost upon her graduation. Then, an eccentric coach is assigned to the school. With the election of the student body president just around the corner, the coach immediately announces the members to be selected. "Wow, I'm going to be fighting against my sister?!" Tsurumi Mayu, whose guts and physical toughness seem to be her only merit, is assigned to the team. Do you have what it takes to defeat Kanzaki Reika and represent your school? Tsurumi, go for the king! The coach's passionate words call for a miracle!

description: War has broken out all across the world, and for the hapless residents of a small American town, they don't have a clue what's going on. Bombs are raining down everyday, their town is sealed off, communications aren't working, and all they can wait for is a confusing and merciless death. Until one day, two strangers arrive on a motorbike, offering a chance not only for escape, but for salvation. Twenty year old Rachel, however, has other problems to worry about. title: Plain
description: Riley is a completely unremarkable woman, if you were to ask her. A plane ride towards a job that could change her destiny ends in disaster when there's a critical engine failure during flight. It would be the end for Riley too, were it not for a remarkable woman who claims to be from the year 2065. Yup, it's a time travel story folks. [From Itch.io]

characters.name: Riley
characters.description: Riley was a sous chef for years, mistreated and underappreciated in the kitchen. The very day she was going to interview for a position as head chef at a fancy restaurant, she was in a plane crash and died. Or she would have been if she wasn't brought to the future. But in this world, cooking is a dying art, and she's the only one who can revive it. She decides to attempt being a professional chef again in an attempt to prove she can make a significant contribution to society. If she can't, however, the consequences could be far more severe than just having to go back to school.

characters.name: Max
characters.description: A historian from the year 2065. Her job is to travel back in time and investigate events that happened in the past without disrupting the future. She's a fun-loving woman who knows what she wants, and isn't afraid to go after it. Finding Riley has made no significant contributions to society, she decides to bring her into the future to allow her a second chance after hitting it off on the plane.

characters.name: Cecilia
characters.description: The head historian and a very strict, serious woman. She doesn't appreciate Max's nonsense and if the woman wasn't so good at her job Cecilia would have fired her long ago. She respects confidence and intelligence. Her outwardly frigid demeanor might make it hard for people to get a read on her, but Cecilia isn't afraid to speak her mind and make her thoughts known.

title: Entropic Float: This World Will Decay and Disappear
description: Entropic Float is a visual novel regarding the experiences of fourteen people who've been trapped inside a magical construct known as the Anomalous Clocktower. Missing memories of how they came to be there, certain aspects of their past life, and of course, every loop but the current one, can those who awakened inside the Anomaly find a way out? Step into the shoes of Rashmi Jamil, Kanatsun, and Amelie Macon at different times of day as you seek a resolution. In each loop, you'll also be challenged to make the right decisions to overcome Entropy, in the hopes that the protagonists' memories might make it through to another version of themselves if the loop doesn't end in tragedy. After finding all eighteen common endings, will the path to truth finally open before you?

characters.name: Amelie Maçon
characters.description: The Childhood Friend, a friendly and pretty standard heroine-type who seems very accommodating. Amelie is one of three playable protagonists in Entropic Float. She gives off a fairly typical vibe, but players will quickly come to understand that her 'girl next door' persona is riddled with holes.

characters.name: Kanatsune Ame
characters.description: An adult with an eclectic sense of style and a willingness to do whatever he needs for success. Kanatsun is one of three playable protagonists in Entropic Float. His role is that of the 'over-informed', the one character who has more information than all of the others. Unfortunately, this information won't quite prove to be enough...

characters.name: Rashmi Jamil
characters.description: A nonbinary young adult who is easily startled, but not perpetually afraid and actually quite prone to starting arguments. Rashmi is one of three playable protagonists in Entropic Float. They're rather cagey about their personal life, and seem intent on convincing everybody else that they're a flawless genius.

characters.name: Loam Arnault
characters.description: An enigmatic and friendly youth who wants the best for everybody stuck in the Clocktower. Works part-time as a hotel concierge.

characters.name: Malcolm Shingle
characters.description: A self-proclaimed has-been artist who spends his days doing whatever keeps him from getting bored in his middle age.

characters.name: Peri Dubois
characters.description: A sweet young girl, but she seems to view other people as ‘friends’ or ‘foes’ exclusively. If you can get through her shell, prepare for her to get attached.

characters.name: Stephanie McGermanotta
characters.description: A gloomy young woman who shows compassion to everybody but herself. She has a strange connection to the Anomaly, often able to predict things that haven't happened yet.

characters.name: Jasper Jasmine Jekyll
characters.description: A flamboyant young adult who likes to tease others and stir up drama. She doesn't seem altogether bothered about the situation, using the opportunity to work on her sociology thesis.

characters.name: Abel Moreau
characters.description: A boy of sophisticated heredity who tries his best not to behave like a wealthy jerk. Caught between the worlds of being raised as the 'perfect heir', wanting to be a kind person, and wanting to hold onto his his childhood interests.

characters.name: Touko Nozomi
characters.description: A devoted schoolgirl with no real direction. Her main goal is to ‘get a good job’, with no care to what field she might get it in. She's been searching for somebody dear to her, and as a result, hasn't spent much time developing interests.

characters.name: True Whitman
characters.description: A middle-aged person who seeks out oddities, and tries not to let on the fact that he’s fairly odd himself. Failed step one.

characters.name: JJ McGermanotta
characters.description: A quiet and awkward person who likes video games and sports. At least, if he doesn't trust you. When he does trust you, he becomes rather harsh and overconfident instead...

characters.name: Madeline Nenohara
characters.description: Your run-of-the-mill Office Lady, except for her obsession with rollercoasters and other high-adrenaline activities. She wears sneakers to work so that she's always ready to run!

characters.name: Shinjiro Nozomi
characters.description: An odd young man who believes his personal moral compass to be an objective truth. Considered by many to be the perfect cross between a bad boy and a pathetic little meow meow.
