description: "Down the moor, there's a cursed place. Don't wander there if you cherish your life." You've come to the town - a little unnamed thing - in the first train you’ve managed to catch, with naught a plan to follow. In a hurry, you’ve severed all ties with your past, carrying the remnants of your old life in a portable suitcase. On the station, right where the horse carriages wait for the passengers, you found a note. "Opaline Manor is looking for aides: maid, servants, pages. Promised good pay, lodging, and weekly leave." Despite the rumors surrounding the manor, you took the note, and headed down the moor. [From Itch.io]

description: You are the chosen one of the deity of love, family and motherhood, dispensing blessings in her name. But you’re hardly blessed yourself. title: Dungeons and Don't Do It
description: Dungeons and Don't Do It is a DnD parody, or satire about DnD... Namely, how players always find a way to do something stupid and mess up the DM's world. (For those of you not familiar, DnD is a role-playing game, where players take on the role of an adventurer on a quest, and have great flexibility in choices while the DM- "Dungeon Master" creates the story for them.) While it is possible to play through this game seriously, it isn't the point! There are plenty of silly options and random generated results to go along with the theme and lead your character through a wacky adventure. Beware about the RNG, though! Some options are much more difficult to pass than others. [Edited from Itch.io]

title: Save The World
description: A thrilling sci-fi story about Ekiya, a young woman living in London who's struggling to make ends meet with her roommate, Sarah, in a world where all that matters is how much money you make. After a break-up and recent job change, Ekiya's life takes an even more drastic turn when she's kidnapped by aliens. Their leader introduces themself as Xen and explains that they are space travelers with the objective of saving the worlds they encounter. Xen asks Ekiya about the problems on Earth and all Ekiya does is answer seemingly innocent questions about the world including the uneven distribution of wealth. Little does she know, her answers will soon influence the fate of the entire world. The following day, Xen makes a proclamation: every day a progressively increasing number of the wealthiest individuals on Earth would be killed. At first, there are attempts to fight back. However, the superiority of the aliens' technology quickly becomes clear. The world is completely at their mercy-- and perhaps, Ekiya's. Xen seems to trust her judgement and continues listening to Ekiya's advice. Can Ekiya change Xen's mind? Convince them to leave? Or, if it comes to it, can Ekiya discover a way to destroy Xen and the rest of the aliens? This is exactly what Agent Castillo from MI6 asks her to do. As Ekiya, you must decide what to do. Do you prioritize humanity or will you look for a more peaceful way to settle things? Maybe this is your chance to better the world. Instead of destroying the aliens, perhaps you can use your influence to inact even more radical changes-- changes that will potentially help more than yourself and your roommate. After all, what have the rich ever done for you besides ignore your suffering? [From Steam]

The tales of the past had transformed into a kind of fable. Almost a myth. From her birth, Nueli had a serious flaw – a weak aptitude for magic, an extraordinarily rare occurrence for her people. Unable to use magic, she could see more than others – the very threads magic was woven from. And since her very childhood, she began to see darkness. A darkness dotted with eyes, watching over her… yet nobody could see these gloomy shadows besides her. Nueli is set to unravel the mysteries of her visions, learn more about the history of her people, become part of a conspiracy, find herself at the very center of the confrontation between divine entities... Or not. Everything is in your hands. [From Steam]

title: High Times
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: In a world where you can literally eat your feelings, you work at The Hotbox, a special donut shop where every donut is infused with mood enhancers that can change your customers’ emotions. But people don’t always know what they need, so from flavors that give them courage to ones that lift their spirits, it’s up to you to choose the right mood and help each troubled customer. Listen to their stories, offer advice in the form of donuts, and help mend broken relationships. [From Steam]

characters.name: MJ Hayes
characters.description: Make way for rock prodigy, MJ! She's got the charm, she's got the talent, and she's got several charges of arson under her name! Her guitar solos are gonna burn down the house—literally.

characters.name: Lucy Dee
characters.description: Some people's first loves turn into distant, nostalgic memories, never to be heard from again. Then there's Lucy — loud, quirky, very much back in her childhood sweetheart's life, and unashamed of her... wilder interests.

characters.name: Emmette Meine
characters.description: Two, four, six, eight, who do we appreciate? It's Emmette, of course leading her team towards the path to greatness! Fueled by fifteen shots of espresso and a box of Coca Crumble donuts, SHE. IS. UNSTOPPABLE!!

characters.name: Stacy Ortiz
characters.description: As the number 1 influencer on Pentagram, Stacy's job is pretty simple: to wow the crowd and be the life of every party. With her radiant smile and charming personality, that shouldn't be too hard... right?

characters.name: Harry Yen
characters.description: Harry's an ambitious fresh grad with a rigid life plan... unless his brother isn't looking. Smartass by day and aspiring Mood Confectioner by night, he's here to live it up until he figures out what he wants to do with his life.

characters.name: Connor Collins
characters.description: The very definition of a 'mom friend': Connor is level-headed, responsible, and passionate about mommies. He's always there for his loved ones... but is that what Connor really wants? (Not the passion for mommies, though. He's got that figured out.)

characters.name: Emma Meine
characters.description: A cheerleader with a deep and dark secret. Well, it's not actually that deep. Or dark. But she's ready to POM-POM POUND her enemies in the wrestling ring!

characters.name: Tumblrina
characters.description: Unemployed and overqualified for entry level jobs, Thumblerina does not dream of labor. She does her best in the meantime, knowing that someday someone will appreciate her a/b/o au pwp fic... And then! She'll show everyone!

characters.name: Kyle Hill
characters.description: Picture the most charismatic and attractive guy that ever graced the earth. Now let him keep the self-assurance and attitude but without the charisma and attractiveness: that's pretty much Kyle Hill. But he's got something going for him right? Well, he's rich, if that helps.

characters.name: Zoe Belladona
characters.description: Hey, chat! It's the up and coming streamer Zoey Bee! Quadra-kill extraordinaire, master of cat noises, and grand theft auto of hearts! But what's she really like when the webcams aren't rolling? Like and subscribe to find out!

characters.name: Jojo
characters.description: He lifts, he's the sweetest guy you'll ever meet, and he's... got a mysterious relationship. Jojo's that guy who's just sooo close to being a 10/10. But hey, nobody's perfect.

characters.name: Riri
characters.description: A pilgrim from a foreign land, visiting San Mazo to pay her respects to her beloved chickens. Riri is here to see the sights, expand her already encyclopaedic knowledge of chickens, and shout at the sun at the break of dawn!

characters.name: Sally Divine
characters.description: As a celebrated web comic artist with a solid (if not intense) fanbase, Sally has got it made. At least, that's what she wants people to think. After all, who would trust a romance writer with no experience in love?

characters.name: Dexie Dean
characters.description: She's got pom-poms in onehand and the biggest stack of college textbooks in the other. Just when you think you've seen it all, she brings out her manga collection. That's Dexie Dean for you

characters.name: Cody Yen
characters.description: Successful, confident, and well-loved-- he's everything his little brother wishes to be, though a reputation like that comes with a price. You think Harry's a handful? Wait till you've got Cody on your case.

characters.name: Adam Lachance
characters.description: A free-spirited dreamer with a propensity for verbosity, Adam is Stacy's other half in the blinding world of internet fame. Don't let his fancy words intimidate you-- there is never a dull moment with him around.

characters.name: Zone Hayes
characters.description: Zone is a tough bouncer and an even tougher older sister. No one messes with the "Velvet Devil" of San Mazo... maybe except for MJ.

characters.name: Debora Santoro
characters.description: Debora is not for everyone: she's a lady who knows what she wants and will do whatever is needed to get it. Good thing she seems to enjoy your donuts... Just make sure not to make too many mistakes.

characters.name: Nova
characters.description: Punk-ass Skateboarder by night, Mysterious Graffiti artist by... even later night. Brace yourselves, cos she's itching to give the San Mazo streets a taste of her art! But what lies behind all that angst? A softer side? A dark past? MORE ANGST? Probably a mix of all three! Originally a character from the game Crush Crush.

characters.name: Detective Fox
characters.description: When it comes to solving hard-boiled cases, no one does it better than Detective Fox. Right now, he's close to solving one of the biggest cases of his life - the hard-boiled case of the Donut Thief.

title: TELLURICENE
description: Welcome, Researcher, As you may know, an emerging species is taking root—preternatural, highly intelligent, and swiftly spreading. Classified as the Vivus glomerorum, these new lifeforms threaten to infiltrate our resilient nation. It’s up to our bravest and brightest minds—like you—to investigate and decide: friend or foe? You have been selected to conduct objective scientific research (sensory testing, radiation resistance trials, developmental studies, and more) to piece together the truth behind the Vivus glomerorum. In the wake of a looming Telluricene, you will have an intensive two weeks to decide whether this new era comes to fruition... or is forever halted. Your great nation thanks you for volunteering in Project Sporesight. [From itch.io]

characters.name: Vivus Glomerorum
characters.description: Considered highly dangerous, subject VG-71122 demonstrates extreme adaptive intelligence and cunning. It seems to refine its behavior in direct response to your presence. Whether it intends to harm or simply understand you is still unclear. What answers will you find? [From Steam]

characters.name: Darío Vincelli
characters.description: Exhibiting sharp intuition, EPPA-98152 approaches everyone with a combative temperament. His true intentions are tightly guarded. He reveals little beyond what he chooses to show. His judgements are swift and often defensive, shaped by suspicion as much as observation. How far can you push before he lashes out? [From Steam]

title: Dear Pianissimo
description: Shu works at a pizza restaurant. When he is on his way to deliver, he sees Nagi, who wants to be a voice actress, practicing at a riverside. When he is on his way back to the restaurant, he sees Nagi again but they get involved in a truck accident and lose their lives... They come to a school located between this world and that world called "Conservatory". They wake up and find out the fact that there is a way to go back to this world. It is necessary to win a music contest done one-on-one. This means a winner can go back and a loser can't. Ironically, Shu is going to have a one-on-one match against Nagi, who is actually tone-deaf... Shu suggests that they practice together until the contest day... [From Himeya Shop] Beside the adventure parts that makes most of the game, Dear Pianissimo includes musical sequences. In which the player is required to press keys on the keyboard in correct timing to accompany the current song. These sequences can be turned to automatic if the player doesn't wish to participate.

characters.description: A high school student who aims to become a voice actress. After dying in the accident together with Shuu, and ending up in "Conservatory", it is found out that Nagi is actually tone-deaf.

characters.name: The Fairy of Sound, Piano
characters.description: A fairy Shuu met at the school which they attend in Conservatory.

characters.name: Hanayamada Jasmine
characters.description: The teacher of Shuu and Nagi in the Conservatory. She is actually an angel.

title: Alluna and Brie
description: Play as Brie, a spunky pink haired girl who recently gained the ability to magically summon cheese sandwiches out of thin air. Everyone thinks Brie's magical girl powers are a joke, but the Magical Response Unit is in desperate need of her help. [From Steam]

characters.name: Lorilynn
characters.description: Hailing from the neighbouring town of Siren's Point, Lorilynn is a geneticist who was transferred to Magical Response Unit due to her experience in dealing with magical based threats. Oh, and did we mention that she's also a mermaid?

characters.name: Brie
characters.description: After failing to take a magical entity seriously, Brie sarcastically asked to be able to summon cheese sandwiches out of thin air. She could have asked for heat vision or the ability to fly or any other awesome power, but she thought the whole thing was a joke and now she's stuck with quite possibly the worst power set ever invented. Brie feels understandably ripped off about the whole situation, especially considering she can't even summon different types of sandwiches, they specifically have to be grilled cheese. She's still committed to fighting evil and saving the world, but she's going to need a hell of a lot of help if she's even going to stand a chance against these invading octopus girls.

characters.name: Alluna
characters.description: Alluna was a bit luckier in the powers department, and she was blessed with the power of the moon. She fights with divine based abilities, and can do everything from punching enemies with staggering force to leaping across the room in an instant. She's a damned good fighter too, which just makes Brie feel even more useless. Even though there's a massive difference in their skill levels, the two girls are great friends, and have been ever since they went to highschool together. But fighting tentacle monsters is stressful work, and there's bound to be some bumps in the road. Especially when there's guys involved...

title: Paper Roses
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
Protagonist's Childhood Friend as a Hero
description: In a world with kings and queens, and eyes that change colour when they meet their soulmate pair... to put it simply, Kira was just about average. She worked as an average artisan, boring grey eyes, never been in love and worked tirelessly on a valueless trade of selling paper engagement roses. The one thing that remained interesting in her life is her best friend, Robin. When everything she cares about is about to be stripped away, Kira is left to decide whether her own happiness is worth it at others' expense.

characters.name: Kira Brookheart
characters.description: Though sweet on the surface Kira can be rather sarcastic at times, especially to those she's comfortable around. Kira seems to be rather shy at first glance, usually due to her positive nature. When she turned eighteen, Kira took over her mother's papersmithing workshop and spends her days between crafting and selling her works. Living alone with her bird, Loveless, Kira spends a lot of time at her best friend's house or at her workshop. [From in-game]

characters.name: Robin Akiba
characters.description: Aside from being Kira's best friend, Robin makes an unbelievable latte. Robin works at the coffee brewery, and visits Kira on a daily basis. Robin is confident and playful but also cares deeply for his friends and family. After becoming friends many years prior, it can be said that Kira's feelings toward Robin may not be as simple as platonic connection. [From itch.io]

characters.name: Iris Aria
characters.description: Iris can be summed up as a spoiled princess any way you try to swing it. She's cares very little for those who are under her in class, and demands for things to happen her way. Iris is incredibly unexposed to the world, often proving to lack common knowledge like how to cook or pour tea. [From itch.io]

characters.name: Creed Akiba
characters.description: Creed is something of a scary looking 22 year old. As Robin's little brother, Creed starts living with him in order to start his life as an alchemist--as terrible as he may be. Creed appears to be cold, but happens to be afraid of everything--especially animal-shaped lanterns. [From itch.io]

characters.name: Luvina Jupiter
characters.description: Luvina is a seer that was sold to princess Iris at a young age. Luvina takes the world for what it is, and doesn't have much creativity or imagination. While not a love interest, Luvina is very invested in helping Kira to understand that they are more alike than they want to believe. [From itch.io]

title: Zhenshi Huanxiang
description: Started with a sneak shot accident, the university campus which is supposed to be a place for education has been being involved in a series of cases. As a journalist, you will use your superpower to find out the truths behind the conspiracy, for justice and for your dream. In order to collect news materials, you need to change your disguise by playing the dress-changing mini-game. With all the dangers ahead and the big responsibility on you, it is only your abilities and wisdom that can take you forward. Could you become the light that breaks through the smog surrounding all the complicated cases one linked with another? It’s all up to you. [From Steam]

description: In this visual novel, Ruby Rose is the long-lost princess of the Kingdom of Vale, and heir to the titular Summer Rose Court. She is discovered and pulled from her peaceful life in the desert, back to the kingdom’s capital of Beacon, where she must prepare for a war against the creatures of Grimm. Along the way she must recruit new allies, including Knight Commander Ser Weiss Schnee, mysterious faunus rebel Blake Belladonna, dragon tamer Yang Xiao Long, young and inexperienced soldier Jaune Arc, the warrior priestess Pyrrha Nikos, the acolyte Lie Ren, and the fearless sailor Nora Valkyrie. [From itch.io]

description: It's court or be courted when you learn you're one of the most eligible heiresses in England! Does true love await you at the grand Edgewater Estate? [From Choices Wikia]

characters.name: Yusuf Konevi
characters.description: Yusuf Konevi is a member of the ton, making his first appearance in Book 1, Chapter 6. You first meet Mr. Konevi at your London debut in Mr. Sinclaire’s townhouse. He is polite and pleasant, and you see him teasing Mr. Chambers. It isn't until Book 1, Chapter 15 that you two are formally introduced to each other. [spoiler]If you decide to employ him as a barrister into your estate, you will also see him in Book 2. Prince Hamid says he has insight about the inner workings of London society. Mr. Konevi tells you how to sway Miss Bowman, Miss Holloway, and Mr. Chambers' opinions about you. [Edited from the Wiki]

characters.name: Theresa Sutton
characters.description: Theresa Sutton is [spoiler]Harry Foredale's wife as of Book 3, Chapter 18. She is first seen in Book 1, Chapter 2. Theresa is very talkative and bubbly. She is known to be a gossip, preferring to talk about superficial subjects. She is a bit insecure about this tendency to chatter, mentioning that her mother told her to be quiet during her debut, only for her to ruin it as she usually does by talking too much. She is often ditzy and tends to behave inappropriately, such as talking loudly about Mr. Sinclaire's late wife at his dinner party. Occasionally she says or believes silly things, once convincing herself that Edgewater was haunted when she heard voices; this was later revealed to be Your Character and Annabelle Parsons speaking down the hall. [spoiler]In Book 3, Chapter 18, her name changes to Viscountess Theresa to reflect her marriage to Harry. [Edited from the Wiki]

characters.name: Cordelia Parsons
characters.description: Cordelia Parsons is one of the ladies of Hazelvale and one of Annabelle Parsons's younger sisters. Although she is mentioned along with Annabelle's other sisters in earlier chapters, she is first seen in Book 3, Chapter 4. While Constance appears to be the more responsible twin, Cordelia comes off as more coquettish and lighthearted. Because Annabelle speaks frequently about Your Character, Cordelia and Constance immediately like Your Character and ask that she attend their upcoming birthday party. [spoiler]In Book 2, Chapter 6, when the Dowager Countess of Edgewater is forced to release Luke Harper from employment, Annabelle convinces her family to hire him as a manservant. From that point, Mr. Harper becomes acquainted with Miss Cordelia. characters.name: Felicity Holloway
characters.description: Felicity Holloway is a rival debutante. She is first seen in Book 1, Chapter 6. Felicity is a proud and competitive woman. Even though she is the daughter of a viscount, she doesn't set her marriage prospects higher than Ernest Sinclaire. She pays compliments to Duke Richards and scolds Viscount Westonly for stepping on her foot, but doesn't pursue them aggressively. As soon as Your Character meets Felicity upon entering Mr. Sinclaire's London townhouse, she looks down on Your Character's being Vincent Foredale's natural daughter. If the player chooses to wear any premium dresses during the season, she will be envious and either mutter a compliment or try to criticize it (the second usually embarrasses herself in front of Your Character's grandmother). title: Wicked Willow
description: You're Willow, a wicked witch, trying to make her way in the world in 1993. Who is Willow? She's a judgy vegan. An Atheist who says she wears a cross "ironically." A sad soul with a tragic past. A brush with death has awakened Willow's powers, but don't expect her attitude to improve. Along for the journey is Avery, Willow's environmentalist best friend, Xarsi, a nun-turned-succubus, Tanya, a self-appointed mentor with a secret past, and Lydia, an Evangelical Christian whose cheery attitude puts her on Willow's bad side. Also, there's a talking cat named Shadow. He never shuts up.

characters.name: Willow
characters.description: Who is Willow? She's a judgy Vegan. An Atheist who says she wears a cross "ironically". A gifted student who barely bothers to show up to class. A sad soul with a tragic past. A brush with death awakens Willow's powers. But don't expect them to improve her attitude. [From the Kickstarter campaign].

characters.name: Tanya
characters.description: Transforming people without their knowledge? Messing with their memories? Turning back time? Willow's self-appointed mentor will do it and more if it means she can finally accomplish her grand plan. What is the plan? She's... not ready to tell you just yet. Try again tomorrow. [From the Kickstarter campaign].

characters.name: Xarsi
characters.description: What? Why are you looking at me like that? Do you think I'm sort kind of devilish monster? I'll have you know, I used to be a nun! But after a little taste of sin, well... let's say I converted. What's wrong with leading people down a path of temptation? Temptation leads to wonderful things. I don't eat people's souls. I set them free. [From the Kickstarter campaign].

plot_tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
full_description: You're Willow, a wicked witch, trying to make her way in the world in 1993. Who is Willow? She's a judgy vegan. An Atheist who says she wears a cross "ironically." A sad soul with a tragic past. A brush with death has awakened Willow's powers, but don't expect her attitude to improve. Along for the journey is Avery, Willow's environmentalist best friend, Xarsi, a nun-turned-succubus, Tanya, a self-appointed mentor with a secret past, and Lydia, an Evangelical Christian whose cheery attitude puts her on Willow's bad side. Also, there's a talking cat named Shadow. He never shuts up.

title: Luoxuan Yuanwuqu
tags: Past Setting in a Fictional World
description: As the adopted girl of a family fallen from grace, you now have a chance to make your mark on high society. Through ballroom dancing and clever romancing, gather the information you need to restore your family’s name.

characters.name: Juven Sakan
characters.description: Viscount Juven Sakan is the head of the Sakan family. Besides being adept in the games of politics, he also authored the book "Finsel's Beauty", which tells about the flower shop girl, the Merc Corps, and even the stories that happened deep within the walls of the church nunnery... Somehow, he knows about all of these.

characters.name: Zoe Olineaux
characters.description: Zoe Olineaux is the Duke of the Olineaux family. He is known as the kindest of the four dukes, and since Hugh took control of the Amber Knights, Duke Olineaux has one less thing to worry about.

characters.name: Bai Xing
characters.description: Asteria is Finsel's strongest elf mage at the moment. She belongs to the Sakan family. People call her the Stars' Children due to her cosmic power, which is a great honor as elvish culture is known for the worship of stars. Although powerful, she is actually very gentle, and even a bit shy.

characters.name: Gonzalo Jorcastle
characters.description: Gonzalo is the second son of the Jorcastle family, and a popular guy in the Finsel social circles. At the request of his family, he studied to become a mage, but his interest in battle is almost nonexistent. Despite this, he is often seen fighting along side with Finsel's guardsmen. Perhaps there is someone in the guardsmen he wishes to protect?

characters.name: Alan
characters.description: Alan's family has lived in Finsel for a long time. The guardsmen call him a reliable captain, strict supervisor, and good friend. Besides that, he is also a poor civil servant, a beloved brother and an naive boy. His most shining point is a strong sense of justice--but he is not sure if it could count as a good trait.

characters.name: Magda Ellenstein
characters.description: The protagonist was born to common citizen parents from the Slum. After a fire killed her family, Eliza Ellenstein and Duke Sakan picked her out for her beauty and, after introducing herself, she was told to forget her name and was renamed Magda Ellenstein. [From Helix Waltz Wiki]

characters.name: Eliza Ellenstein
characters.description: Eliza Ellenstein was once a socialite herself in her youth until her family fell into disgrace. Ten years prior to the events of the game, Eliza took the protagonist out of the Slum after a great fire left Magda orphaned. Eliza renamed her newly adopted daughter Magda, and raised her to be a refined young lady with the help of Duke Sakan. Despite adopting her daughter for the purpose of re-establishing the Ellenstein family in the Senate, she loves and worries about her dearly. [From Helix Waltz Wiki]

characters.name: Lynna Jorcastle
characters.description: Illegitimate daughter of the Duke of Jorcastle, she was brought back to the declining family after her father's death. She has never been taken seriously by any of her relatives, so she started a life of luxury. Her character is domineering and she seems to see Magda as her imaginary enemy. [From Helix Waltz Wiki]

characters.name: Lawrence
characters.description: Servant to the Jorcastle family and loyal attendant to Miss Lynna. He accompanies Miss Lynna to wherever she may go. Any person who tries to do Miss Lynna harm will automatically become his enemy. Is there a possibility of befriending him? [From Helix Waltz Wiki]

characters.name: Nyx Bavlenka
characters.description: Nyx is the youngest daughter of Grand Duke Bavlenka. Although she is adopted, she has gained her father's favor. The duke wants her to be active in the social circles however, this shy bookish girl seems to have no clue about it. [From Helix Waltz Wiki]

characters.name: Demi
characters.description: Diane is a tailor who creates knock-off version of gowns of famous brands and serves the not-so-rich civilians. She is a very talented imitator.

characters.name: Barbara Sakan
characters.description: Barbara Sakan is the youngest member of the family. Her mother died a long time ago, and her father has been travelling the world ever since, so she has always been close with her brother, who is 7 years older than her. Barbara is about to turn 17 and is beginning to enter the social circles, but she isn't looking forward to it. She'd rather stay free to attack Sulla with her brother. Up until now, Barbara has chased away six suitors with her archery skills taught by her brother. Her marriage has become a big concern within the Sakan family. [From Helix Waltz Wiki]

title: Yonder World: Interview with the Void
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: Yonder World follows the story of Vellus, a young angel who has recently received her dream job in Heavens. After a series of disappointing and unfortunate events, she finds herself in a strange world, perpetually drenched in midnight moonlight, whose inhabitants consist of a singular mysterious and infinitely powerful entity, and her few "visitors". Help Vellus navigate a world full of lurking dangers and filled with melancholy, in her quest to find her way home. Perhaps along the way, she will learn to undo the knots in her heart and even others'. Or perhaps you will play a hand in plucking her fledgling wings and breaking her halo. [From Itch.io]

characters.name: Dethiral
characters.description: "You may allude to me as an Eldritch Being, for there is no explanation for my being that you might comprehend." Dethiral is the Mistress of Yonder World, or so you would come to understand. A literary enthusiast with a seemingly insatiable thirst for knowledge, the dark entity rules over an empty castle under a perpetual midnight. Alluring and terrifying, Dethiral possesses undeniable charms, yet exudes an air of melancholy in the melodic timbre of her voice. [From Itch.io]

characters.name: Aksan
characters.description: "I have lived a very long life. I have seen many start and complete their journey. You will just be another face, ultimately forgotten in the stream of Time." The Wandering Queen, Aksan, comes and goes from Yonder World for several purposes, one of which is to deliver new literary works to Dethiral. Glamorous, dangerous and resourceful, she carries many secrets in her confident strides. Aksan is a mystery that draws people's eyes, and a knife in the dark where none is looking. [From Itch.io]

characters.name: Cassius
characters.description: "It's cute you want to know me, but you should be careful who you let close. I'm a demon after all, there's a reason people fear us." Cassius, known as the Gilded Blade, seems no stranger to violence and dirty deeds. Still, this arrogant demon appears to have a scholarly side to him, as his visits to Yonder World are often spent alone in the laboratory. A sense of danger and intrigue lay behind Cassius' devilish smirk. [From Itch.io]

characters.name: Vellus
characters.description: "Me? I'm just your average angel, doing my part. I do love stories though... Don't tell anyone, but I'd love to write my own someday." Vellus is young for an angel, and has worked hard to prove herself and earn a high position amongst her kind. Still, an emptiness haunts her as she attempts to conform to the heavy expectations laid out for her. Sweet, naive Vellus, perpetually trapped in one way or another. [From Itch.io]

title: Tales Of Aravorn: An Elven Marriage
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: A few years after the events of Loren The Amazon Princess, a marriage is arranged between the princess of the moon elves, Lydia, and High Cleric Marian of Paqwana. The marriage is to be the first of its kind after many years, uniting an elf with a member of the Human Empire. Naturally, such an important marriage has the potential to attract enemies among the elves and within the Empire. But there are others who'd also like to see the marriage fail such as the succubus, Jul, and the Death Knight, Zeal. Concerned about the risks involved, the Council of Grimoire asks Apolimesho to once again seek out the help of Elenor/Saren and put them in charge of escorting Lydia on her journey to Triberg. It'll be their responsibility to make sure that she arrives there safely so that the marriage can proceed without issue. [From Steam]

description: After getting dumped and dropping out of university, Mia moves into a studio apartment with her best friend, Pawnathan the cat. At night, she becomes trapped in a cycle of dead-end work within a liminal dream mall. Can Mia escape with her new work friends, or is she just there to replace them? [From Itch.io]

characters.name: Mia
characters.description: Mia is a loveable loser, a well meaning mess, and a bit too neurotic for her own good. Is she all too much, or not enough? [From itch.io]

characters.name: Pawnathan
characters.description: The sweetest of beans, the fluffiest of friends, and Mia’s furry old, old man. [From Itch.io]

characters.name: Cynthia
characters.description: Cynthia manages Glitch 256, the Infinimall’s arcade. Blunt and to the point, she can come across as cold, but there’s passion behind her fiery eyes. [From itch.io]

characters.name: Oliver
characters.description: Oliver is the head of Plant and Plethora Management at the Infinimall. He’s a kind and compassionate listener, and an absolute pushover. For Oli, it’s easier to help than be helped. [From itch.io]

Take care and plan for his/her daily schedules, which range from studying science, poetry, arts, wizardry, and alchemy to adventuring, dating or taking a vacation. You have so many possibilities to raise your child and influence the how the story play out. An inspiring Japanese love and otome game that allows you to: - train your child with various schooling activities - explore all game scenes and collect hundreds of high quality CGs - multiple storylines and ending adventure - dressup and customize your prince or princess of dream Anime Story - Simulated Dating and Otome Game [From Google Play]

characters.name: Sebastian
characters.description: The protagonist's butler. A mysterious man hiding a huge secret. One of the primary love interests for the male and female protagonists. [spoiler] He is in fact Lucifer, the main enemy Linsu was fighting against.

title: summer haze/glory days
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: Return to the Summer of 2007... Once somewhat of a local legend in their hometown, Mallory turned down a record deal in favour of a scholarship a decade ago. To say that they felt a bit of regret would be an understatement; they spent the bulk of their university years watching their former band mates sell out shows and records, stewing in bitterness the whole time. After several years of rejection and struggling, they've finally gotten a second chance in their grasp — only to question whether it's something they even want anymore. [From Steam]

characters.name: Mallory Law
characters.description: After years of hard work, Mal has finally gotten everything they've always dreamed of: their band, No Prospects, landed a coveted spot on the 2007 Friends and Foes summer tour, and their latest single has been picked up by some big radio stations. So they should be happy, right? [From Steam]

characters.name: Emerson
characters.description: The bassist of The Fractured — the current band that's on the playlist of everyone who's in-the-know. Most would consider Emerson's quiet and withdrawn nature ill-suited for the spotlight, so it's fortunate that he seems to get overshadowed by the rest of his group. [From Steam]

characters.name: Di
characters.description: Mallory’s best friend from university who was dragged into No Prospects largely against her will. Despite her initial reluctance, ever-critical Di has since given her all in every single performance – and won’t hesitate to point out anyone she believes to be dead weight. [From Steam]

characters.name: Beckett
characters.description: An old friend of Mallory's from their teenage basement show years. Having spent the past decade turning down permanent positions in favour of juggling odd jobs with occasional freelance session work, Beckett surprised everyone when he joined No Prospects. [From Steam]

characters.name: Lucas
characters.description: A last minute addition to No Prospects after the abrupt departure of their previous guitarist, Lucas struggles to keep his head above water in a sea full of industry veterans. What he lacks in technical skill, he more than makes up for in pure enthusiasm. [From Steam]

title: Coalesce
description: "At the end of the day, I always blamed my weak body for it. There wasn't a single day where I didn't resent it." Asa Argyris woke up finding herself in a snow white room with nothing but a bed. All she remembered was her name and a man's death. There were scientists looking over her, watchful eyes constantly observing her every movement. She also found out that she couldn’t exactly die. That there was something planted inside of Asa. Whatever it was, it could prevent her from death. How exactly did she get herself into this predicament, Asa wondered. Nobody around her was trustworthy. The only thing she could safely rely on was herself and her lost memories. [From itch.io]

description: It starts with a magical competition mentioned in original Little Witch Parfait. Now from Reinette point of view. [From vndbreview]

characters.name: Parfait Sucreal
characters.original: パルフェ・シュクレール
characters.description: A witch apprentice who inherited the "Black Cat Magic Shop" from her deceased mother. She is a third-year high school student at Flor Hermos Magic Academy, but she is taking a leave of absence to concentrate on running the store. Parfait's father was a court mage, but her died when Parfait was just one year old. Despite that, Parfait has a cheerful disposition. She is clumsy and prefers to do things at her own pace. Her catchphrase is "Hamyu". [Translated from Wikipedia.]

characters.name: Sakemasu
characters.description: A male black cat who acts as a familiar of Parfait. He can understand and speak human language, but he can be rude sometimes. Sakemasu's hair is tinged with magic, so from time to time it is used as a material of the store's products. [Translated from Wikipedia.]

characters.name: Flore Milfia
characters.original: フローレ・ミルフィア
characters.description: Parfait and Reinette's classmate, though Flore is a best friends with Parfait. Flore has a gentle personality with a strong core. Her body is naturally weak, but she possesses a mysterious ability to talk to plants. Her dream is to run a flower shop in the future. [Translated from Wikipedia]

characters.name: Cocotte Kirshe
characters.description: Reinette's younger sister, a high school freshman in the Magic Academy. She runs the Smile magic store on behalf of her sister, when the latter is busy collecting and blending ingredients. Unlike her sister, Cocotte has a cheerful and straightforward personality, and she seems to have more emotions towards Parfait than to her sister's friends. Cocotte's hobby is reading shoujo manga. [Translated from Wikipedia]

characters.name: Reinette Kirsche
characters.description: Self-proclaimed genius mage studying at the Flor Hermos Magic Academy, as a 3rd grade student from the advanced course (high school). Reinette runs "Smile Magic Store" and has a strong sense of opposition to Parfait, who owns the rivaling "Black Cat Magic Store". Reinette's attitude and tone are always confident and straightforward, although sometimes she says words that are contrary to her true intentions. Her mother died at an early age, but she has a younger sister named Cocotte and a father who is the court mage. The latter is a very busy man, so he rarely comes home. [Translated from Wikipedia]

full_description: It starts with a magical competition mentioned in original Little Witch Parfait. Now from Reinette point of view. [From vndbreview]

title: Ma ga Uta Tsukai
description: Shiratori travels to the United States to translate and publish a new best-seller "MUSE" for their company. The famous but anonymous author of Muse "M" appears in front of Shiratori and asks this: "Will you please lead the story I'm about to tell into a tragic conclusion?" Than M begins to tell a tale, a strange love story involving a king, a slave girl, and a poet imprisoned in a tower.

characters.name: Shiratori Chiaki
characters.description: Older twin brother of Chifuyu. Currently serving as the Managing Director of "Shiratori" publishing. This is the player character, it's not a real protagonist; you can choose either him or his twin sister to become the listener of M's story. [Translated from the official website]

characters.name: Shiratori Chifuyu
characters.description: Younger twin sister of Chiaki. Currently serving as the Managing Director of "Shiratori" publishing. This is the player character, it's not a real protagonist; you can choose either her or her twin brother to become the listener of M's story. [Translated from the official website]

characters.name: M
characters.description: Author of the bestseller "MUSE" which became a social phenomenon in the United States. His/her age, gender and history is shrouded in mystery, (s)he is a masked writer. [Translated from the official website]

characters.description: President of "TD", the company which publishes the book "MUSE". [Translated from the official website]

characters.description: The king who imprisoned the immortal poet who goes by the name of Ma Ga Uta Tsukai. His kingdom and military force stand unrivaled, and his commands are passed throughout his whole peninsula country. [Translated from the official website]

characters.name: Ma Ga Uta Tsukai
characters.description: An immortal poet who is trapped in the tower of the palace after being imprisoned by the king. His/her age, gender or history are unknown. [Translated from the official website]

characters.name: Lala
characters.description: Enslaved girl who is mute from birth. Bought by the king As to protect and defend the tower where Ma Ga Uta Tsukai is imprisoned. [Translated from the official website]

title: Cross Ange - Tenshi to Ryuu no Rondo tr.
title_original: クロスアンジュ 天使と竜の輪舞tr.
tags: Future Setting in a Fictional World
description: An original story of the series with a new protagonist called Naomi and which is divided into 10 chapters. The game follows the beginning of the anime but then drifts into an alternative story. The game consists of two parts: Drama and Action. In Drama, you watch the story and events unfold while pursuing one of the heroines, and in Action, you fight against the DRAGONs and other enemies who come in the way. There is also a mode where you can touch the heroines.

characters.name: Naomi
characters.description: A rookie ParaMail rider who has been assigned to the First Unit. She is Miranda's childhood friend. Due to her debts, she runs around day and night in Arzenal to pay them off. In order to survive, she trusts her companions and believes that teamwork can help people survive for longer. Due to this, Naomi is known as the peacemaker within her team.

characters.name: Angelise Ikaruga Misurugi
characters.original: アンジュリーゼ・斑鳩・ミスルギ
characters.description: Nicknamed and widely known as "Ange" in Arzenal, she is the first daughter and princess of the Misurugi Empire. However, on the day she was supposed to inherit the throne, her brother sold her out and revealed that she's actually a Norma. Right after the same event, Ange was stripped of her fame, honor and title and thrown into Arzenal. Due to her status as a former princess, Ange is very prideful and stubborn, and tends to get often into fights with the other members.

characters.name: Hilda
characters.description: The First Unit's second-in-command after Zola, her lover and the ex-captain, was killed and one of the "veteran" ParaMail riders. She acts quite hostile towards Ange and displays a cynical view of the world. However, according to the others, Hilda used to have the same personality as Ange when she first came into Arzenal.

characters.name: Chris
characters.description: A veteran ParaMail rider of the First Unit. Despite her blunt personality, she is also quite shy and negative. Chris is also always hiding behind her two best friends, Hilda and Rosalie, who also happen to be her childhood friends as well. Chris is also very dependant of her friends and starts feeling lonely when she's left alone.

characters.name: Vivian
characters.description: A ParaMail rider of the First Unit who has extraordinarily good combat abilities. Vivian is a naturally cheerful and airheaded girl whose hobby is suddenly making up quizzes and then asking her friends about them. Unlike the rest of the unit, she's also very friendly toward everybody. She is always shown eating lollipops.

characters.name: Salia
characters.description: A ParaMail rider of the First Unit and its captain after Zola's death. A very serious and hardworking soldier who is very skilled, but acts like a complete textbook example of one. She has a secret hobby of cosplaying as a magical girl from the books she reads during her free time.

characters.name: Rosalie
characters.description: One of the "veteran" ParaMail riders and a light artillery member of the First Unit. A childhood friend of Hilda and Chris, Rosalie is always tagging alongside them. She isn't very skilled, but has survived up until now by tagging along with someone who has power, and is shown to love money. After Zola's death, Rosalie shows a grudge against Ange.

characters.name: Ersha
characters.description: A heavy artillery member and one of the "veteran" ParaMail riders of the First Unit. Her cooking skills are better than her combat skills, and she is also rather motherly, acting as the motherly figure of Arzenal and taking care of Vivian. She also takes care of the children living in Arzenal who mean everything to her. When offended or angered, Ersha turns into a very scary person, which is something that the members of Arzenal are always avoiding.

characters.name: Tusk
characters.description: A young man Ange met in the forest under Arzenal. He has some kind of connection with Villikiss, Ange's ParaMail. His parents used to be ParaMail riders who were killed years before the events of the series. He is also knowledgeable about repairing ParaMails.

characters.name: Momoka Oginome
characters.description: Ange's loyal and extraordinarily skilled maid who follows her everywhere. She has served Ange ever since her childhood and was shown to be the one who used Mana instead, hiding the fact that Ange is actually a Norma.

characters.name: Mei
characters.description: A young mechanic who serves as the First Unit's ParaMail management team's leader. Despite her young appearance, Mei is very knowledgeable about machines and ParaMails in general. She claims to be able to somewhat understand the feelings the ParaMail's pilot when she does maintenance on them.

characters.name: Coco
characters.description: A new cadet who was assigned at the same time as Miranda. A dreamy girl who loves daydreams, pudding and picture books. Admires Ange who is just like a beautiful, smart and strong character straight out of a picture book or fairy tale.

characters.name: Miranda
characters.description: A new cadet who was assigned at the same time as Coco. A serious but hardworking girl who strives to become as good as captain Zola. She sees people like Ange as major trouble.

characters.name: Sylvia Ikaruga Misurugi
characters.original: シルヴィア・斑鳩・ミスルギ
characters.description: The youngest daughter of the Misurugi royal empire's family and Ange and Julio's younger sister. She used to admire her sister until she was revealed to be a Norma. Due to her being a paraplegic, she uses a mana powered floating chair to move around.

characters.name: Jill
characters.description: The strict but very competent supreme commander of Arzenal. Due to her rough personality, she is feared by many. Her right arm is mechanical due to a past accident.

characters.name: Julio Asuka Misurugi
characters.original: ジュリオ・飛鳥・ミスルギ
characters.description: Ange's older brother who acts like a kind, easygoing brother, but is actually a sadist and very arrogant. He is the one responsible for getting Ange exiled from the empire and sent to Arzenal. He dislikes anything that is dirty, or in other words, Norma.

characters.name: Salamandinay
characters.description: A miko, princess and DRAGON from another world, the "real Earth" which is 500 years into the future. She is quite popular with many people due to her endearing and proactive personality. Also nicknamed "Salako" by Ange, she wishes to return Aura, the original DRAGON, back to their world.

characters.name: Zola
characters.description: The captain of the First Unit and one of the veteran ParaMail riders. She has escaped death many times in the past, and is a woman who enjoys having sex with new cadets, despite being Hilda's lover. Her right eye is also artificial.

characters.name: Naga
characters.description: A member of Sala's entourage, a swordswoman and DRAGON. She pilots the mecha called Ryu-Shing-Ki Soryugo. She respects and is deeply in love with Salamandinay, to the point where she will become hostile if somebody tries to do something to her dear Sala.

characters.name: Kaname
characters.description: A member of Sala's entourage and a DRAGON. The pilot of the mecha Ryu-Shing-Ki Hekiryugo. She has been serving Salamandinay since she was young alongside Naga, who is her close friend. She is also the staff officer of Sala, a discreet person who has the capacity to see the big picture.

characters.name: Embryo
characters.description: A man who is completely shrouded in mystery who owns lost technology, ancient weapons and techniques from the ancient times. Embryo resents the world from a position which is one step higher than that of the administrators. For some reason, Jill has very bitter feelings towards him.

characters.name: Emma Bronson
characters.description: The only Mana user in Arzenal and second in-command who was sent to monitor the Norma. She looks down on the Norma and tries to manage the girls with her strict training, and takes rules very seriously.

characters.name: Jasmine
characters.description: A retired ParaMail rider who is also Jill's friend. She is the owner of the huge market place in Arzenal called "Jasmine Mall" which sells all kinds of goods she manages to get her hands into. She is also a shrewd businesswoman who takes full advantage of her business monopoly in the island.

characters.name: Maggy
characters.description: The medical officer of Arzenal and the cybernetics repair expert who is also Jill's long-time friend. She is bad-mouthed and a tad cruel as she enjoys the sight of blood. However, her skills are worthy of her name: she has saved the lives of very many Normas.

title: Subete no Koi ni, Hanataba o.
description: Nagisa Seishuu has returned from the city to her hometown in the countryside after two years. Feeling at odds with the boring monotony that her life has become, she thinks that perhaps it would be best to simply become a hermit. But then an unexpected encounter changes things. She meets three other girls who are more than what they seem: they're spirits. And, curiously enough, only Nagisa can see or interact with them. None of them, including Nagisa herself, know what love is like. But perhaps they can learn. In an unknown town, an unfamiliar miracle has begun to search a corner of the world for a tiny flame of happiness. [From ANN]

title: Pure Affection
description: The story is about Giorgia, a eighteen year-old girl, dog person, victim of a bully at school, which knows her secret. But when she meets Daniela, a 24-year-old guitarist, cappuccino-addicted and extremely disordered waitress, her life may change. For better or for worse? It's up to you (and your choices)! A tender story of friendship, secrets and sacrifices (and love for dogs too)!

characters.name: Giorgia
characters.description: She is the main character. An extremely shy girl, and a dog person. She has a secret that haunts her.

characters.name: Daniela
characters.description: She is a young woman who moved to Ireland to look for a job. She plays guitar, is addicted to cappuccino and is extremely messy.

characters.name: Claudio
characters.description: A bully who annoys Giorgia. In the outside, he seems like a kind person, but hides a dark side, which shows only to Giorgia. He and Daniela have a bond...

characters.name: Petra
characters.description: Giorgia's older sister, and Daniela's friend. White collar lady. She seems like a very serious person, and she takes care of Giorgia when their parents are away. She secretly reads Yaoi manga.

characters.name: Alain
characters.description: A weird guy, hanging around the school.
He just wants a family...

characters.name: Teresa
characters.description: A girl who goes to the same school as Giorgia. Once they were best friends.

characters.name: Hana Lee
characters.description: Hana Lee is one of the suitors to Liam Rys and one of Your Character's love interests. Hana is a kind-hearted girl with an endearing personality, although she is often shy, timid, and self-deprecating. [spoiler]As she matures and discovers her own interests outside of her family's, she becomes more confident and her own person. She can be very competitive when given the chance. Your Character first meets Hana in Chapter 2 at the boutique where Your Character is looking for a dress for the Masquerade Ball. She walks in and accidentally sees Hana in her underwear; depending on what the player chooses, Your Character can gain relationship or romance points with her. During Book 1 the two become friends, although the extent of the friendship is dependent on the player's choices. She helps Your Character navigate through courtly decorum and procedures, admitting in Chapter 7's premium scene t

characters.name: Liam
characters.description: The Prince of Cordonia.

characters.name: Madeleine
characters.description: One of the suitors to the prince. Raised and bred for courtly life, Madeleine is the epitome of prim and proper; she shows little emotion, having good control of her feelings, and thus behaves accordingly to the situation at hand. Ambitious and power-hungry, Madeleine will trample anyone to become the Queen of Cordonia.

characters.name: Drake Walker
characters.description: Drake Walker is Liam Rys's best friend and one of Your Character's love interests. Drake is the down-to-earth, realistic "commoner" in his circle of friends. To most, he comes off as snarky, sarcastic and generally closed-off. He holds a cynical view of society, specifically the court of Cordonia and the "back-stabbing" politics that goes with it. His friendship with Liam appears mismatched, as he did not have the lineage to be introduced into the Prince's circle of friends. However, he is not ashamed of his background and prides himself in being self-sufficient. [spoiler]Once he opens up, Your Character begins to notice that he is observant, caring, and very loyal to his friends. If romanced, he is also self-deprecating, insecure, and vulnerable around Your Character. [Edited from the Wiki]

characters.name: Rashad
characters.description: Rashad is the legal representative of Sloan Enterprises and William Sloan's business partner. While he makes his first appearance in Book 2 of Rules of Engagement, he only appears in subsequent books if Katie is engaged to William. Upon meeting Katie, his dislike of her is quite apparent; he wants William to have no distractions from their work. Years before, Rashad's fiancée at the time felt neglected and shoved aside as his company was growing, forcing her to leave him. He has not forgotten how miserable the annulment of his engagement made him and so wants to prevent William from potentially experiencing the same thing at Katie's hands. [spoiler]Due to his family's nobility, he is the heir to Duchy Domvallier and becomes Hana Lee's suitor in Book 2 of The Royal Romance. title: Sheltering With You
description: A difficult journey to the East awaits Helena, an orphan, and Aya, a former brothel worker. At the same time, a certain Monster attacks the villages, and Helena sees strange dreams. On the way, the girls meet a daughter of the northern lord Liana, who is forced to hide under a wing of a flower seller and be under the strict supervision of her companion Rahl. Will Helena agree to join their company or will she continue her adventure with Aya? What kind of unusual life stories do the main characters keep in their hearts? Will Helena respond to the call of her dreams, or will she find happiness in big love? It all depends on the player! [From Steam]

title: For the Love of Gods
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: You have the opportunity to be the Deity of Love, and live amongst the Gods in the city of Eonia. But first, you must complete four trials with six romanceable immortals who are there to help you, and sometimes lovingly distract you... Pass Eonia’s trials to face your destiny and win eternal life in paradise. [From Itch.io]

characters.name: Astrellio
characters.description: God of the Moon. Brooding, sincere, and a creature of the night. When he is not busy governing the tides and charting the cosmos, Astrellio seeks beauty and love to ground him.

characters.name: Aurelia
characters.description: Goddess of the Sun. Beneath her soothing exterior is a burning desire to protect those that she loves. Aurelia's undying optimism and achievements in Eonia are all at once inspiring, contagious, and at times, dangerous.

characters.name: Eeri
characters.description: Deity of Wisdom. Eeri holds so much knowledge in their mind that they sometimes neglect their heart. But if they ever pause in geeking out over their latest discovery, this deity will seek help in their slow and steady explorations of love.

characters.name: Vidas
characters.description: Deity of Intellect. A walking computer and an explosion of charm, Vidas is a witty immortal with a love for play. The only code they have yet to crack is how to truly wear their heart on their sleeve.

characters.name: Calysta
characters.description: Goddess of Strength. While this goddess has wielded all the strength in the realms for eons, she has no need to prove it. Her prowess is solid, unparalleled, and wildly sexy. Calysta is a rock for all who know her. She believes in everyone's potential for greatness.

characters.name: Dalia
characters.description: Eonia's oracle and reader of the Fates, Dalia is the all-knowing guide for deities in the pantheon. Despite her great power to see the future, she is nurturing and helpful, if you can manage to impress her.

characters.name: Leonidas
characters.description: God of Stamina. Leonidas can do just about anything forever, and his sights are set on adding love to that list. Beneath his confidence is a jubilant spirit that drives his infinite energy and zest for life.

title: Love Notes
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: Waking up in an abandoned building, you have no memory of what transpired the night before. Adding to this mystery, you find your band is in shambles as most members split or leave. Set in the same world as Love Bites, Love Notes lets you play as Rachel or Jesse, two musicians of the band Spectral Howl. As time passes, they'll start to feel strange, their bodies changing into something different after their night of amnesia. Long teeth, unnatural thirst, and a sluggishness during the day. Someone did this to them. But who, and why? Try to solve the mystery of what happened that night, and who are they changing into. [From official website]

description: It's just before 9 PM and the classroom is dark. A month ago, Mayumi started receiving alarming anonymous letters. She teaches at a school for high-class ladies, and suspects the culprit is a student as well — but the contents of the letters are both strange and obscene, detailing dissolute, promiscuous lesbian sex and an unmistakeable, base interest in Mayumi herself entirely unfitting for such ladies. Determined to set the writer straight — or at least get them to leave her alone, as she is quite put upon by the barrage of letters — Mayumi sets out to confront the writer. She has summoned them to the classroom; all that remains is to wait for them to arrive, if they dare.

description: Could you survive an alien world? Change your genetics and wander the wasteland for answers, all the while aided by your AI companion. Trigaea is an epic 272,000-word piece of interactive fiction. It's a combination of a sci-fi novel and an RPG adventure game, where you are in control of the story. Game Highlights: - Augment yourself with animal, robot or alien parts. - Decide the fate of a planet. Deal with interesting moral dilemmas! - Fifteen different endings to unlock. Over 12 hours of gameplay. - Deal with enemies by talking, subduing, scaring, or fighting them. - Scrounge for microchips to unlock your memories and discover your past. - Play as male/female/non-binary or straight/bi/gay/ace. - Stunning alien landscapes from a range of professional sci-fi artists. [From Itch.io]

Instead, your short career ended with your death. Your achievements and past were buried under the wreckage, somewhere on a plot of barren land called the Crossroads. Death, however, wasn’t your end. It’s only the beginning. Now, stifled under the thumb of Mastravisch Azvael Ories - the supreme ruler of the Overshadow realm, where ghosts and demons run rampant - you are bound by a life contract - that for an undead means eternal servitude. Just when you begin to settle into your new life, building some semblance of normalcy, you are betrayed, left to perish. Though weakened, but with a body that finally belongs to you alone, you vow to get revenge on both your almost-destroyer and the damned tyrant that once held your leash. [From Itch.io]

This has not gone down well with their partner Ember, a fire elemental who usually solves problems by chucking a fireball at it and cleaning up the mess afterwards. If workplace drama wasn't enough, the city has become embroiled in a massive conspiracy involving corrupt government officials, a cult of mysterious witches and an army of militarised pirates who want nothing more than to reduce the city to a smoking pile of ash. Oh, and Hunter also appears to be slowly transforming into a mermaid! Will Hunter be able to work out what's going on with their transformation before it's too late and they wind up stuck as a woman forever? Probably not, but maybe they'll find a way back to their old self! There's a first time for everything, you never know! [Edited from Steam]

title: Codename: TYPHOON
tags: Modern Day Setting in a Fictional World
description: [i][b]Moscow, USSR, 2017. When the Cold War flashed hot at the end of 1953, the United States nuked China and Korea, and the Soviet Union took New York City off the map. But now, even after the psychic revolution of the 1980s, the imperial fortunes of the great powers are waning, and the Cold War is running cold indeed. The USSR, hoping to regain some of its long-lost glory, plans a May Day celebration commemorating one-hundred years of Soviet communism. But the US has its own plans... Agent Angelica Gropius Rhythmic Triad Typhoon is a psychic secret agent, working for the CIA’s secretive spirituality division, codename: The Goatmen. Her mission is to smuggle a nuclear weapon into Moscow and detonate it at the height of celebrations, killing all the Kremlin’s top brass in one fell swoop. However, Agent Typhoon is captured in the course of her mission, and brought to a KGB black site. There, she faces an unexpected enemy: a turncoat Goatmen agent, and her own mentor. Now going by the name of Psycho Soldier Number Seven, she seeks to defeat her former student with her psychic powers. Four hours until the bomb goes off. Can Agent Typhoon make it out? [From itch.io]

title: Toiro Komachi ~Kurenai ni Somaru Sono Toki made~
title_original: といろ小町～紅に染まるそのときまで～
description: Toiromachi is a small mountainous town by the sea that's slightly distanced from the big city. The story begins in a long-standing restaurant in the heart of its shopping district called "Murasaki", which serves eel dishes. The restaurant is flourishing thanks to the happily married couple that run it; the proprietress is popular in the neighborhood while the skills of the restaurant owner, who is also her husband, are well-regarded. Their only daughter and this story's protagonist is a normal university student you'd find anywhere. She doesn't have anything in particular she wants to do and is spending her summer holidays mulling over what to do for her next part-time job. One day however, her hardworking mother collapses and the protagonist becomes Murasaki's substitute proprietress! In the middle of summer, a highly profitable period, she's made to manage the shop while it's understaffed. Though she's only be covering until her mother is discharged from hospital, a lifestyle completely different from the one she's lead so far has begun! On top of that, she accidentally finds a single letter addressed to her mother... "That child... That girl I gave birth to... I wonder if she has been well?" "I'm not Mom and Dad's child?!" Confused and bawling her eyes out, a boy suddenly flies down from the sky and appears before her... As hectic and busy days go by, all of the mysteries gradually unravel. Followed by a strange boy as she navigates the complicated interpersonal relationships between her peers, will this otherwise normal proprietress and student be able to solve the mysteries of her life? [Translation of official website story summary.]

characters.name: Futaai Akane
characters.description: Akane is a university student studying history. She was hoping to relax during the summer holidays, but after her mother collapsed at work, Akane decides to help her family business until her mother gets better. Everything was normal until she discovers a letter addressed to her mother, which revealed that Akane is actually adopted. Shocked, Akane is torn between finding out the whole truth and the fear of finding out things that would be better left untouched. Sully claims that she summoned him, but Akane has no knowledge of doing so. At first, working in place of her mother is tiring and stressful, but she adjusts before she knows it. Her kind, caring and hardworking nature makes her well suited to her post.

characters.name: Cabalef Stanislafmader Sullivan
characters.original: カバレフ・スタニスラフマダー・サリィヴァン
characters.description: Nicknamed Sully, he is an angel prince that was (supposedly) summoned from the moon by Akane. Sully was tasked by his father, the king, to help Akane resolve what is currently bothering her (the truth about her real parents) by the next full moon. Though he is 20, he often gets mistaken as a child, if not, a mid-teenager (Akane described him as "looking around 15-years-old). Not wanting to make Akane's peers suspicious, Sully had somebody from the moon world alter their memories, so he could better carry out his task. Because of this, those close to Akane are arranged to think that Sully is a distant relative of Akane's. Despite his complex and somewhat dignified method of speech, Sully is quite childish and slightly spoiled. However, Sully can be surprisingly obedient at times. He too, ends up helping out the eel restaurant as a waiter and delivery boy as part of his guise.

characters.name: Aoyama Shuichi
characters.description: Shuichi is a new addition to the eel restaurant, making him Akane and Atsunori's kouhai. He decided to work part time for the first time in his life, as he wanted to have more experiences before school starts again. Shuichi is an interior design student at a specialist college. He's cheerful, outgoing and polite, but is sometimes hard to read. Shuichi is quite sharp, and picks up on his surroundings with little effort. He apparently went to the same high school as Akane, but she doesn't remember.

characters.name: Suga Atsunori
characters.description: Atsunori has been working as a chef for the restaurant for five years. He's very laidback, friendly and cheerful. Because of his dedication to his job and the restaurant, he's well-liked by Akane's parents and is even treated like family a lot of the time. He's also the go-to guy when Makoto is away- his juniors trust in and find him to be reliable. In spite of his extroversion, Akane catches him losing his cheer every now and then, and has no idea what's bothering him. Atsunori doesn't think highly of Yuusuke, and seems to know him from before the restaurant workers' first meeting with him.

characters.name: Fujisaki Yuusuke
characters.description: Yuusuke is a businessman that recently moved into the town of Toiro for work purposes. He eventually becomes a regular at the Osaki eel restaurant. Yuusuke has a refreshing personality, which alongside with his friendliness and polite charm, helps him leave excellent impressions upon everyone he meets. Even so, Yuusuke can be surprisingly argumentative. Quick-witted, he never loses in a verbal argument. As well as Atsunori, Moe also has a bad impression of Yuusuke; becoming much ruder than she usually is.

characters.name: Kakitsubata Gorou
characters.description: Very refined, polite and mild-mannered, Gorou is a traditionalist gentleman. He has known Akane's parents for a while; tasked with managing the floral displays of the restaurant. Gorou seems to especially get along with Miyoko. He's very calm and relaxed, and seems to calm those around him as well. Gorou sometimes makes some unexpected observations or statements, which makes Akane occasionally describe him as a "strange man". When he's not busy taking care of the restaurant's flowers, he works as a Kadou (flower arrangement art) teacher.

characters.name: Yamabuki Aoi
characters.description: Aoi is Akane's senpai since their high school days, though they've only recently reconnected. He was her senior in their high school's Japanese archery club. Additionally, Aoi and Akane are childhood friends. Akane used to have a crush on him, but eventually her feelings fizzled out. Now a university student, Aoi is studying to become a vet, and as a result, is frequently busy with his studies, even during the summer holidays. He is the older brother of Moe, the local shrine's miko (shrine maiden). Aoi has a very calm, docile and kind personality, which made him popular with the girls during his school days. He goes about his everyday activities at his own distinctive pace. Maybe because of these traits, Aoi has a tendency to think too hard about even the simplest things. He lacks strong opinions, so he often finds himself going with the flow.

characters.name: Yamabuki Moe
characters.description: She is the same age as Akane, and they went to the same primary school together. Moe is Aoi's younger sister, and works at her family's shrine as its maiden (miko) since she graduated high school. Despite playing together in their childhood, Moe is now cold and rude towards Akane. In fact, her coldness and rudeness isn't limited to Akane- the only person she seems to be amicable with is Aoi.

characters.name: Futaai Makoto
characters.description: Akane's father, and the owner of the Osaki eel restaurant. Though a strict boss, Makoto is personable and kind.

characters.name: Futaai Miyoko
characters.description: Akane's youthful mother. Miyoko is the proprietress of Osaki eel restaurant, alongside her husband Makoto, its owner. She is well-liked by her colleagues due to her cheery and positive attitude. After collapsing from exhaustion during work, Miyoko is hospitalised, but remains in a stable condition- her collapse wasn't a sign of anything life-threatening. [CV: SaRara (friend of the developer's, not a professional voice actress)]

title: Leave You Behind
description: Corin and Von are the latest in the line of the endlessly reincarnated lovers, Galaxia and Prince Xer. Traditionally, the two incarnates will meet, fall in love, and ultimately defeat the similarly reincarnated Lord Velt. Such is their destiny. Corin and Von are less than interested in each other though. They're best friends of course, but romance is a complete non-interest. Fate as a way of sticking them together at very possible turn in hopes of forcing their love to form. Unfortunately for Corin and Von, they are approaching the time in their incarnate lives where Galaxia and Xer first confess their love so the pull of destiny is especially strong. This also happens to be the night of their school's Homecoming dance. It's up to you as Corin to make it through Homecoming without bending to will of destiny. Hey, maybe they could actually go with the people they actually like. [From Itch.io]

title: One Hell of a Week
description: One strangely average morning you hear a knock on the door. You open it to find an envelope on the floor. It’s a ticket to Hawaii, and your name's on it baby! But what? When?? Who??? Where?!?! WHO CARES! You take this definitely real, totally not shady gift and get your sweet ass to the airport. The ticket works. You take your seat. Everything is gravy. That is until you're approached by none other than the King of Demons, Satan himself! He reveals that he left you the ticket, and by accepting the trip you activated his trap card! (AKA a non-negotiable contract) The price you must pay is... marriage! That's right, you must find the love of your life and marry her! Otherwise the devil gets your soul! Of course you could always buy your way out with a million big ones, but we all know you can't afford that. The rules are simple: * Don't tell them about your situation * Make sure she's head over heels for you * Oh, and you've only got a week. Have fun in paradise! [From Kickstarter]

title: Ghost#Dialer
description: In response to the oppressive system around them, two high-schoolers create a space for themselves. A secret after-school club where they can explore and express themselves without judgment. Sharing sunsets together, playing JRPGs, and falling in love. Until they realize that they're ensnared in a tangled web of self-hatred, woven by the venomous adults around them. A mysterious number reveals to Kite, our protagonist, the path that they need to break free. Kite isn't sure who they can trust, only knowing that they have to move forward. A proclamation of love leading into a dangerous adventure against unknown forces. Ghost#Dialer is a supernatural mystery about discovering our truths, and discovering the power we all possess inside of us. How we can manifest our truest selves and wield that power against those that would deny our humanity. [From itch.io]

description: It’s like every bachelorette party you’ve ever been to... chasing strippers through casinos, grand larceny, occasional encounters with the mafia, oh and COCKTAILS! [From Choices Wikia]

characters.name: Diana
characters.description: Diana is one of Main Character's best friends from college and first seen in Chapter 1. She is bookish and conservative mainly because it is what is expected of her, especially by her fiancé. Attending cotillion classes has made her well-versed in polite society and etiquette; [spoiler]however, when she drinks more than two shots of tequila, she turns into “Diana the Destroyer” and becomes a metaphorical wrecking ball, eventually dissolving into a blubbering mess. Diana has multiple insecurities, including never finding someone as good as Skip, disappointing her parents, and not being smart enough. [Edited from the Wiki]

characters.name: Courtney Van Ness
characters.description: Courtney Van Ness is one of Main Character's best friends from college. She is first seen in Chapter 1. Courtney is bubbly, outgoing, and flirty. She appears to be adventurous as there is little she cannot be dared into doing, and she has no problems throwing out suggestions (especially of an intimate nature) if that is the way to get things done or gain an advantage. She also appears to be easy to manipulate or hypnotize. If the player takes the premium scene to play as her in Chapter 11, [spoiler]she hallucinates an animated version of herself called "Court-Toon" and Fifi the Friendship Fox. Both of them proceed to chastise her for being irresponsible, not having a job, and not knowing necessary skills like cooking her own food. The dialogue also implies she comes from a wealthy family. [Edited from the Wiki]

characters.name: Cecil Romano IV
characters.description: Cecil Romano IV (aka The Baron) is a crime lord, vampire, and the leader of Clan Baron. He is the youngest member of The Council, having been born in 1882. Much of his power and influence was gained during the American Prohibition Era, leading to him becoming "the single most powerful mobster in New York City" by 1919. He has little interest in Your Character's affairs, unless they affect his own, and refers to her as "Adrian's little tart."

title: Deus Ex Machina
description: In 2010 humanity is wiped out by the Araburugami, hostile deities manifesting as giant monsters. Only one survivor remains in Tokyo, a city converted into an automated military fortress — warrant officer Aoki Itona, pilot of the 100 meter tall anti-deity robot Shinuchi Mark V, a Deus Ex Machina. Itona enjoys the loneliness, but one day she meets a fellow pilot and the last survivor from another region, Kurenai Touka. Itona's introverted personality keeps clashing with the upbeat and teasing Touka as they grow closer and join hands to fight against the wheels of fate.

Itona's introverted personality keeps clashing with the upbeat and teasing Touka as they grow closer and join hands to fight against the wheels of fate.
