title: Breathless Winds
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: Set in the lush and magical Two Elk Island, Poppy has long been recovering from an incident that left her bedridden, but her life changes when she finds herself at a crossroads between four branching paths. Will Poppy follow her family’s legacy as a sailor with help from her childhood friend, reunite with a former bully turned healer, prevent a calamity that threatens their island with a mysterious witch, or help the crown prince of the powerful Castle Island with a quest to save the king’s life? [From Itch.io]

characters.name: Poppy
characters.description: Poppy's parents were both legendary sailors who disappeared one day years ago, never to be seen again. Hoping to fulfill their legacy, Poppy became a sailor, herself, until an incident left her bedridden. After a long recovery, Poppy finds that Two Elk Island has changed in her absence. She finds herself at a crossroads when Gallardia, Lantana, Rue, and Prince Valerian all ask for her assistance.

characters.name: Gallardia
characters.description: Gallardia is our heroine's childhood friend, a proud big brother to three younger siblings, and a beloved sailor of Two Elk Island. His 'boy next door' charm and hardworking demeanor have made him popular on Two Elk Island - by contrast, Poppy feels almost invisible. But, thanks to his warm attitude, she never feels left behind.

characters.name: Rue
characters.description: Rue appeared one day in the Forest of Crows - "raised from the dead", rumors said - and established herself as the island's resident witch. Delving deep into a forgotten dark magic, she allegedly uses her powers for the good of Two Elk Island, keeping its spirits in harmony and protecting nature against the growing storms.

characters.name: Valerian
characters.description: Valerian is a household name - everyone knows the prince of the illustrious Castle Island, the "crown jewel of the sea." Despite his renown, however, he's been unable to find the help he needs to complete his critical quest to save the king's life. When he meets Poppy, he promises her great wealth if she assists him: countless jewels, priceless relics, and most importantly, the privilege of working by his side.

characters.name: Lantana
characters.description: Lantana used to bully Poppy when they were kids, landing Poppy with the nickname 'mudshoes' after an infamous incident. Poppy was relieved at first when Lantana stopped showing up to school, but then grew worried for her as her absence continued. Search parties combed every part of the island, but came up with nothing - it was as if she vanished into thin air. So when Lantana returned without explanation years later, a changed person and the village's new healer, Poppy found herself drawn to her despite initial hesitation.

title: The Beastmaster Princess
description: The Beastmaster Princess is a fantasy visual novel featuring a diverse cast, branching plot and several different endings. It takes place in the fantasy world of Aravorn, already seen in games like Loren The Amazon Princess and Cursed Lands. This is the story of Kunya, the child of Chief Goro, leader of the Desert Snakes tribe. Kunya is a formidable warrior and a future warchief. But even the most formidable need allies. Kunya can count on Luna's motherly cures. There isn't a single thing the shaman can't fix with her potions. On the battlefield, there's no better ally than Takara. Brave and hot-headed, she's always looking to gain more fame and recognition so that her name will be remembered by future generations. Though older than the others, Manila is no less dangerous in a fight. She may be a lone wolf, but she's always willing to share her wisdom and experience. With Lyara about to marry an elven prince, the tribe is in disorder. As a half-elf abandoned in the desert as a child, she has always struggled to fit in with the other nomads despite being adopted as Goro's daughter. Perhaps this marriage can return her to her elven roots. Unfortunately, events conspire against this union. As Prince Merril travels to meet Lyara, his caravan is assaulted by dark elves and he is nowhere to be found in the aftermath. Now it's up to Kunya and the others to track him down. They'll face numerous dangers, using force and cunning to overcome them. In doing so, perhaps Kunya will discover love along with the hidden power of Lyara, the beastmaster princess. [From Steam]

title: Hroniki Izabelly
description: Chronicles of Isabella is a visual novel about how, in the span of a single day, your whole life can turn into hell. Isabella, a young and hot sorceress, comes to visit her best friend to spend some cold December evenings with her. Play snowballs, drink mulled wine, sit by the fireplace and confess your love - all the things that childhood friends usually do together. But Isabella is met not only by her best friend Maria, but also by the already middle-aged Baron von Krautz, who also aims to take the heart of a young lady. Isabella is not the most restrained sorceress in the world - she never reaches into her pocket for a word and does not allow herself to be offended. This is the beginning of the end for their relationship, and a deadly strike to the heart of the unfortunate Isabella. [From Itch.io] Chronicles of Isabella is also a prequel to another game, "Wanderer".

title: Star-Crosst
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: War is rough. Rebuilding isn’t easy. But we all start somewhere. The year is 2323. Thirteen years ago, the Earth was attacked by an invasive alien species. They used a superweapon that altered the Earth’s atmosphere, causing intense weather changes in the space of hours, creating hurricanes in jungles and blizzards in deserts. They made no attempts to communicate. Humans had taken to calling them ‘riklid.’ And today, the humans won. The riklid retreat after being dealt a decisive blow. You play as Ezra Foy, a young twenty-something coming out of their senior year at university. For Ezra, it feels like time had stopped: the war effort was all anyone could focus on, and now that peace has finally been won again, the time for revelry and relationships has begun. Choose between three love interests, each with their own deep branching storylines and hundreds of lines of dialogue; enjoy a futuristic setting involving people and places of all different walks of life, including a friendly lizard-like alien species known as the Ghians; and decide what the best course of action should be living in a post-war era, and what we as individuals can do for our future. (from Steam)

You said you'd keep her secret safe, but she hasn't been making it easy. As the years flew by, her secret grew bigger, until you found yourself snarled in a web of lies and questionable choices. With your biggest hurdle looming over the horizon, you've got a stressful three days ahead of you. How far will you go to fulfil your promise? [From itch.io]

title: Mistwinter Bay
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: You are the sovereign of a town called Mistwinter Bay. The sovereign you create decides the fate of the town and everyone in it. Decide which buildings to build – and who gets to live in town. Interact with your townsfolk by sending them on missions or hang out one-on-one. Each character is unique, with their own profession, personal history and strengths and weaknesses. Deal with international politics by befriending or becoming enemies with powerful foreign leaders. Watch the seasons pass as you are faced with a unique, random event every month. The way you decide to handle an event not only affects the ending of the event itself, but the entire town. Will you become a sovereign loved by all or will you adapt your choices to please someone in town – or perhaps someone across the sea? [From Itch.io]

title: Dirty Little Secrets
description: You've moved onto the idyllic Vermillion Lane, but this street hides some sinister secrets, and a sexy neighbor with a mystery of their own. [From Choices Wikia]

characters.name: Vincent Zhang
characters.description: Vince Zhang is a student, Sadie Hotchmitch's pool boy, and one of her flings. He is friendly and laid-back and does not seem concerned with neighborhood politics. He's quite popular among his fellow college students, as evidenced by the fact that his frat brothers and cheerleader friends agreed to help him with Sadie's car wash for free. [From the Wiki]

characters.name: Kelsey
characters.description: Kelsey is one of Your Character's Downstreet neighbors. Despite claiming otherwise, she likes to gossip and is not above accusing her neighbors of nefarious deeds. While she is relatively friendly towards Your Character, she is hesitant to associate with them due to Sadie Hotchmitch claiming they murdered Valerie Wright. She has eight children whose ages range from infant to adult; there are rumors her youngest child was consummated outside of her marriage.

characters.name: Valerie Wright
characters.description: Valerie Wright is one of Your Character's Upstreet neighbors, the president of the neighborhood Homeowners Association and whose murder Your Character is investigating. Her only appearance alive is in Chapter 1, although she is mentioned in almost every chapter after that. She is the wife of Oak Valley's mayor, Benjamin Wright, and is quite a cheapskate despite being considerably wealthy. Sadie Hotchmitch is unsubtle about her dislike of her and immediately takes over the Homeowners Association following Valerie's death.

characters.name: Mari
characters.description: Mari is one of Your Character's Downstreet neighbors. Unlike Sadie Hotchmitch, she is fairly friendly despite Your Character being seen as an outsider. Her kleptomania spurs her to steal things from her neighbors' homes, then brazenly lie about the item's origins when someone questions her. However, she is only able to lie convincingly if she believes the other person has no idea that she stole it. Outside of her theft, Mari is liked among her neighbors for being an excellent cook, although she refuses to share her recipes. [spoiler]This is because she has none: it is discovered in Chapter 14 that not only is Mari a terrible cook, but she has no cooking ingredients in her home at all.

Modern Day United States of America
description: Welcome to Belvoire University, New Girl. Do you have what it takes to steal Queen Bee’s crown? Let the games begin <3? [From Choices Wikia]

characters.name: Chloe St. James
characters.description: Chloe is abrasive and rude to those she feels are beneath her. Because she is ranked #2 in the student list, she believes she is entitled to the same preferential treatment as Poppy Min-Sinclair and considers herself to be second-in-command after Poppy. [spoiler]Chloe is the middle child in her family and, as such, feels constantly overlooked by others. She feels confident in her dancing, and was captain of her high school cheerleading squad as well as three-time national champion; however, Poppy's ego and her desire to be the star of the Zeta dance team have allowed Chloe little time in the team's spotlight. [Edited from the Wiki]

characters.name: Professor Kingsley
characters.description: Professor Kingsley is a professor at Belvoire University and one of Your Character's love interests. They are first seen in Book 1, Chapter 1. Kingsley is a private individual, projecting an air of mystery and unattainability to most people around them. They strive to be professional in their job. However, after meeting Your Character at a bar, they become rather enamored with her (particularly if they have sex). While they initially try to resist their feelings, Your Character can continually try to break down their walls and convince them to give in. [spoiler]If Your Character is not romancing Kingsley in any way, their behavior steadily becomes creepy and obsessive. Even if Your Character has told Kingsley she has no interest in them, they will constantly text her, show up at her dorm after they've been fired for being accused of fraternizing with a student (Your Character), and appea

characters.name: Benji Knoll
characters.description: Benji Knoll is a Belvoire University student and the resident advisor of the Winfrey dorm complex. He makes his first appearance in Book 1, Chapter 2. Unlike most students at Belvoire, Benji attends the university on a scholarship. In exchange for not having to pay tuition, Benji is required to work as an RA. This also means he must live in a dorm room that is quainter in comparison to the wealthier students' luxury suites. While he is visibly unhappy about this arrangement, Your Character's arrival on campus and subsequent challenging of the highest-ranked students has inspired him to improve himself. [spoiler]Unfortunately, his admiration rapidly morphs into obsession, to the point where he not only stalks Your Character, but builds a shrine to her consisting of food and various items he has stolen from her room. The rotting food making up the "Admiration Station," as he calls it, has

characters.name: Veronica Lombardi
characters.description: Veronica Lombardi is a Belvoire University student and a potential member of Your Character's Posse. While one of the highest-ranked students on campus, she comes off as significantly less rude about and obsessed with her popularity than other students the player meets. She is more focused on her massive social media presence, often streaming herself at important events talking excitedly to her followers. Once the camera shuts off, however, Veronica immediately reverts back to her normal, stoic self. While Veronica is not interested in being Your Character's closest friend, she will reciprocate flirting and even have a threesome with Your Character and Carter Jackson if the player chooses to do so. Additionally, she will occasionally provide Your Character with insight on how to achieve various goals, albeit usually to aid her thirst for drama.

title: W: Time Catcher
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: A witch who lived in the shadows finds her way into the magical community. She is about to face many dangers and mysteries, including a legend of a source of power and a conspiracy against the Church. From romance-club.fandom

characters.name: Nova
characters.description: Nova is a witch who lived in the shadows but finds her way into the magical community at the beginning of the book after being caught by the Magisterium of Preternatural Affairs for stealing. She is an uninitiated witch, so she doesn't have a brand. Nova chose this path to blend and not attract attention - until now, at least. She is a time catcher, that means she has an ability to break through veils time - as for now, only short periods. The state she enters when she looks into the past is called fata morgana. Nova has one of the extremely rare types of magic, and therefore it attracts the interest of those who become aware of it.

characters.name: Shen Zheng
characters.description: Shen is a powerful warlock Nova meets in the Vatican catacombs at the beginning of the book. He discovers that she is a time catcher, a rare witch, and realizes that this could help Others' cause, so he tells his ally and friend Vesper who is interested in meeting her.

characters.name: Onyx
characters.description: Onyx is an animamorph who is tasked with watching and protecting the main character before she can meet Vesper. The first time Nova sees them is as a black cat on the balcony of her previous home.

characters.name: Vesper
characters.description: Vesper is a prominent witch in the Others' society hiding in plain sight: posing as "Nina", an Ordinary woman. After Shen told her about the meeting with Nova, a time catcher, she decided to recruit the rare witch for The Incineration Alliance.

characters.name: Lucien Lanceret
characters.description: Lucien is a vampire who Nova meets at Nest. He belongs to Constantino's clan and does assignments for their patriarch.

characters.name: Renato Bernardi
characters.description: Renato is a priest who is assigned to help the main character in her mission.

title: Psi
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: In post-catastrophe New Paris, society is divided between the “pure” and the second-rate. Lou, a telekinetic girl from the slums, joins the Church-run psionic force, Assistant Corps, chasing the truth: is humanity determined by blood – or something more? [From romance-club.fandom]

characters.name: Ivo Martin
characters.description: Prior Ivo Martin is the head of the Inquisition, an arm of the Church of Unity. He first meets Lou Reed, the main character, when he offers her a pair of sunglasses after she passes a test for psionics.

characters.name: Kay Stone
characters.description: Kay is an empath who can read people’s emotion when he touches them. His Rank at the Assistance Corps (AC) is Acolyte. He works at the AC as "The Specialist", and currently is the partner of Lou Reed, the main character. Their first meeting happened in Platypus, a club in Termitary, where Lou and her friends frequent.

characters.name: Jonas Baer
characters.description: Jonas is a good friend of Lou and part of her social group. He is a healer and his psi power is the ability to take people’s pain and transfer it to himself. he is currently working as a nurse and studying to be a doctor.

characters.name: Danielle Weiss
characters.description: Danielle works for the Church of the United One as the personal secretary to the head of the Inquisition. She meets Lou Reed, the main character, during an investigation.

characters.name: Lou Reed
characters.description: Lou is a young woman with the fifth-stage psionic abilities, bordering on fourth-stage. Her power is telekinesis. She lives in Termitary, a part of New Paris, where only genetically unstable people live. After graduating from the co-ed boarding facility number two, she didn't get a job right away and for some time couldn't find one that would satisfy her. However, due to her poor financial situation, she decided to try to get into the Assistance Corps.

description: Get ready for romance, laughs, and wild choices in 'The Wedding,' an interactive game where your choices matter. Fake date, elope, or sabotage a wedding – your decisions will shape the story. This isn't your usual love story – it's for readers who love a good twist. In this game, you can take revenge on a bully, rekindle with an ex, fake date your business partner, neighbor, or the cute firefighter who is also your friend with benefits. And if you're up for it, you can even run away with the bride or groom if you can make them fall in love with you. [From Kickstarter]

title: Love's Young Dream
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: The Ashbrook family has always been born beneath an unfortunate star. They aren’t destined to lose their lives at sea, nor lose their fortunes to disaster, however. They are only doomed to lose their first loves to unrequited feelings. No Ashbrook to date has had the luck to prove that curse baseless superstition. Yet that doesn’t stop you, the youngest Ashbrook, from trying to defy that fate. Clearly other Ashbrooks of the past just haven’t tried hard enough. Having fallen in love for the first time, you’ve set yourself to the task of throwing aside a tradition of heartbreak and earning the affection of one Prof. Heron Renaude. With the help of your dearest attendant, and with the backdrop of the romantic Reedford Manor, your brother’s countryside home, surely you’ll prove yourself more powerful than fate. ...Won’t you? [From itch.io]

characters.name: Heron Renaude
characters.description: A professor of medicine, Heron is a forward thinking and intelligent man. He is, however, rather blunt, though friendly if one can withstand his acerbic wit. In other people, he celebrates honesty and integrity over intelligence. He is a friend of Taylor Ashbrook, the protagonist’s older brother, and it’s through him that the protagonist originally met Heron some time ago.

characters.name: Cyril Rollins
characters.description: One of Taylor’s friends, Cyril is the heir to a mercantile family that trades in high quality fabrics—Rollins Textiles. He’s rather clever, quite fashionable, and a touch on the bohemian side. As his family is tainted by trade, he’s generally looked down upon by nobility despite being much richer than them, but Taylor befriended him anyway some number of years ago. Taylor is Cyril’s closest friend, and Cyril would do just about anything for him (and, in fact, has done quite a number of things for the man without his knowing).

characters.name: George Leigh
characters.description: The protagonist’s lady’s maid/gentleman’s gentleman. They have served the protagonist for the past decade, indulging their every wish and whim to the best of their ability. They have harbored feelings for their master for some time now, though they’ve endeavored to keep them hidden. full_description: The Ashbrook family has always been born beneath an unfortunate star. They aren’t destined to lose their lives at sea, nor lose their fortunes to disaster, however. They are only doomed to lose their first loves to unrequited feelings. No Ashbrook to date has had the luck to prove that curse baseless superstition. Yet that doesn’t stop you, the youngest Ashbrook, from trying to defy that fate. Clearly other Ashbrooks of the past just haven’t tried hard enough. Having fallen in love for the first time, you’ve set yourself to the task of throwing aside a tradition of heartbreak and earning the affection of one Prof. Heron Renaude. With the help of your dearest attendant, and with the backdrop of the romantic Reedford Manor, your brother’s countryside home, surely you’ll prove yourself more powerful than fate. ...Won’t you? [From itch.io]

title: Summon a Sweetheart
description: This is a short visual novel-esque game about a depressed loser named Penelope. She gets so lonely… that she summons an eldritch monster to be her girlfriend. Unfortunately, she didn’t read the fine print. She needs a gift, and she needs one fast! Surely, her depression cave of a room should have something, right? I’m sure this won’t go wrong at all! In other words: give the monster lady gifts that suck, and have cruel and unusual things happen to you as a result. [Edited from itch.io]

characters.name: Penelope
characters.description: Penelope is intended to be an amalgamation of all the terrible coping skills, thoughts, and experiences one person could possibly go through, all at once. Condensed into a character that doesn't have the mental bandwidth to handle it, or do anything to fix the sorry state she's in. Thus, she accepts it- falling further and further into brokenness, where all she wants to do is alleviate some of the pain, without actually fixing the problem(s) that's causing it. She lives in a shitty, run down apartment, has hoards of trash all over the place, and can barely muster up the energy to eat something aside from liquid sugars. She flips and flops between wanting to erase herself from the world, and desperately wishing she had the desire to stay. characters.name: Galatea
characters.description: The eldritch monster, Galatea, named with the myth of Pygmalion and Galatea in mind- is meant to represent a toxic partner that people who are suffering often find themselves dating, or wed to. At some points, she is explosive and reactive, her anger sometimes makes no sense at all. Other times she takes everything personally, deeply offended by simple offerings. Sometimes she's unnaturally calm and lucid, seeming normal despite her volatile behavior. Most of all, she reads Penelope like a book. She is far too knowledgeable of what makes her tick, what gets her upset, and exactly what kind of bait she needs to put on the hook, in order to make her bite. Pygmalion had made Galatea perfect, exactly as he wanted. His "ideal woman," if you would. She, in a sense, is the same to the mythological Galatea in that way. tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: Sofia, the princess of S Kingdom is visiting Japan and intends to make the best of her remaining days as a single girl. In one month's time, she is to be married. She intends on using her remaining time having fun. Cain, the man that Sofia has been in love with since childhood has been sent to Japan at her wishes. He has been called to serve in the SP reserve forces for their country. On the other hand, there is another waiting for her in Japan, who is also in love with her: A girl thief. She had tried to steal the princess's ring during her last visit to Japan only to fail and fall madly in love with her. Hearing the rumor of the princess's upcoming wedding, the girl thief wants nothing more than to prevent it from happening. The girl thief hears that the princess always wears a certain necklace that will be necessary for the wedding. She vows to steal this necklace. Thievery on one side and protection on the other: Even though their circumstances are very different, they both love her. You will see the feelings of these two entwined with the expectations of surrounding people. The story begins... [From Gamelex]

title: Puppy Love 3: Wild West Side Story
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: A wild, gleefully implausible tale of the Old West, where tumbledawgs roll among sun-bleached bones, and two new heroes take the stage! A great steam train is winding its way across the scorching sands, carrying the entourage of a visiting foreign dignitary. In the lawless lands, such a procession can only attract the eyes of the vultures… Can the valiant lawmen protect young Princess Yunnie from scheming bandits? Or will a young outlaw be able to realize her dreams, and hit the big time? We follow the story of a new hero, Sovy Wildfoot and his rival - the beautiful and deadly Vedika Vandersmudge - on a train ride across the untamed deserts of the west. Sovy is all new to the Puppy Love games, but we've seen Vedika before when she premiered as the masked vigilante in Puppy Love I! Puppy Love III is a breakaway from the first games in that it features full point and click adventure mode! As both Sovy and Vedika you get to walk around the train and talk to other passengers, exploring the world of Puppy Love click by click, along with some of the old choice menus to spice things up as the action unfolds! There are even fetch quests? Aren't you excited?? Will Sovy save the princess? Get seduced by bandits? Will Vedika seduce the lawmen? Will the entire game get detrailed when the protagonist gets distracted by grumpmuscles? Will he become the manager of an all-singing all-dancing performance troop? Or will he save Vedika from herself? Unlock them all and you’ll be rewarded with a special minigame: Dress-Up Balthazar! [From official site]

description: The 'Vector Rider Series', launched simultaneously, "Shirou Hen" with the male protagonist and "Sayuri Hen" with the female protagonist. A self-raising style simulation game depicting the main characters' first year after entering the military academy. The system and game balance is a little hard, however the world building is very detailed and the story has many serious developments. Shirou Hen has gal game and shounen-ai elements. Sayuri Hen has otome and shoujo-ai elements. [Translated/Edited from Girl Game Wiki]

characters.name: Shirou Aizawa
characters.description: Born 7/25/2033 He lost his family at a young age in an attack by the ESSAR aliens and was raised in an orphanage in India. In order to give back to Professor Kalidasa who raised him he aims to become a highly paid 'Vector Rider'. The protagonist of Shirou Hen and a capturable character in Sayuri Hen.

characters.description: Born 12/03/2033 The daughter of the president of the global conglomerate 'Kuonji Group'. She joins the UFN army to rebel against her meddling arms dealer father. The protagonist of Sayuri Hen and a capturable character in Shirou Hen.

characters.name: Azzul Torleoni
characters.original: アスール・トレローニ
characters.description: Born 08/27/2033 A bright and honest, sociable guy. He can get pretty emotional sometimes. He loves rock music and plays the guitar when he's in the mood.

characters.name: Rang Primary
characters.description: Born 07/19/2033 A lively naive girl. A bit of an airhead, but she's the type of person that you just can't hate. She's excitable and even when she gets down it doesn't last long. A romanticist that likes gazing at the stars.

characters.name: Red Thrally
characters.description: Born 05/18/2033 A straightforward guy who is really good at moving his body. A reliable guy, but he's pushy and has no brakes even when it comes to women.

characters.name: Rouge Vinstage
characters.original: ルージュ・ヴァンスタージュ
characters.description: Born 04/10/2032 A big sisterly sexy lady. She loves rumors and is always poking her nose into talks about love. At her core she hates being alone. She's good at moving her body, especially her gun skills.

characters.name: Oak Azzrael
characters.original: オーク・アズラーウェル
characters.description: Born 05/28/2036 A genius boy who skipped grades. Farne's younger twin brother. He loves his camera and playing tricks on people. He can be surprisingly reliable however, and his outlook on love is pretty old-fashioned.

characters.name: Farne Azzrael
characters.original: ファン・アズラーウェル
characters.description: Born 05/28/2036 A genius girl who skipped grades. Oak's older twin sister. Usually a dainty intellectual girl, sometimes she disguises herself as Oak and cheekily performs tricks on people.

characters.name: Veer Mikhailobna
characters.original: ヴェール・ミハイロヴナ
characters.description: Born 02/11/2036 A 'Super Elite' boy who already graduated university with great grades. He's kind, but he doesn't open his heart easily. When he was younger his older brother died fighting in space.

characters.name: Ryeuie Sou
characters.description: Born 11/20/2036 A determined and brazen genius girl who skipped grades. She is especially good at piloting mecha. She looks down on people that aren't as smart as her so she isn't good at dealing with other people. Has a bit of a complex about her short height.

characters.name: Blau Meister
characters.description: An engineer that transfers in late in the year. A nihilistic guy who doesn't get influenced by other people easily. He's an excellent cadet, but he's full of mysteries and it feels like he's hiding something.

characters.name: Ssei Tkkana
characters.description: An engineer that transfers in late in the year.

characters.name: Xak Burgess
characters.description: A tactical officer. He's often practicing by himself in the control room. He used to be aiming to become a Vector Ride pilot but he had to give up because of his weak body.

characters.name: Acid Gurnie
characters.description: A mechanic stationed in the Dive Ride hanger. His nickname is Sid. He has an artist's temperament and is adored by the cadets. He used to be a Vector Ride pilot candidate in the past.

characters.original: コールマン・メイカー3世
characters.description: A nurse, called 'Doctor' by those around him. He's an old acquaintance of Acid. He used to be a much more serious guy but he got into an accident and lately he's always drinking alcohol at a sidewalk cafe.

characters.original: エアゾルバ・ガーランド
characters.description: A Quad Ride instructor and Public Morals advisor. He loves the gym. He can be pretty strict and has a bad mouth. Even though he's the 'public morals' advisor, that no shirt plus necktie combo is probably against the uniform rules.

characters.description: An Avio Ride instructor. His rank is lieutenant colonel. A crisply handsome man, but he's known as a strict devil instructor.

characters.original: ファミーユ・エンフォース
characters.description: A tactical officer. She's responsible for making announcements. She's often practicing by herself in the MM room.

characters.name: Kim Rayrien
characters.description: A mechanic stationed in the Quad Ride hanger. She has a bad mouth.

characters.original: ガブリエラ・ファイファー
characters.description: A nurse, she's stationed in the infirmary in place of the drunkard Coleman.

characters.description: A Dive Ride instructor. She hangs out in the teaching room.

title: Alice's Reverie
tags: Heroine Based on a Fictional Person
description: Alice’s Reverie is a visual novel following our protagonist, Alice. Alice grew tired of being compared to the protagonist of Alice's Adventures in Wonderland as a child. Now, as a twenty-year-old struggling student and a closeted lesbian, she envies the fictional Alice's carefree childhood days. But when Alice suddenly finds herself in her own bizarre version of Wonderland, will it be the magical adventure and fairy tale romance she's always dreamed of? [From itch.io]

characters.name: Morrigan
characters.description: Morrigan is a wise and demanding woman. She is the crown Princess of Wonderland and the rightful heir to the throne. While she is less cruel than her mother, she is not afraid to deal out punishments as needed. [From Itch.io]

characters.name: Reese
characters.description: Reese is an eccentric chatterbox who loves lolita fashion and hosting tea parties. When she isn't throwing a party, she can be found in her room tailoring clothes. She's a social butterfly who attempts to befriend everyone. [From Itch.io]

characters.name: Skylar
characters.description: Skylar is a tired and snarky individual. They spend most of their time either sleeping or looking after their flower garden. Skylar's humor is very dry, but showing appreciation for it is the one-way ticket to their heart. [From Itch.io]

characters.name: Lulu
characters.description: Lulu is a bright and cheery woman who has enough kindness to spare. She is known as the "mom friend" by her friends because of how hard she cares for their well-being. She will always lend a hand if someone needs one. [From Itch.io]

characters.name: Catherine
characters.description: Catherine is a clever, playful woman. She weans her way into people's hearts with her flirtatious and flattering comments, but she has no bad intentions. Her strong intuition lets her know everything about someone. [From Itch.io]

characters.name: Vee
characters.description: Vee is a calm and intellectual individual. She has a lot of walls put up, so she likes to be alone most of the time. But, she doesn't hate company. Most of her days are spent reading a book or keeping up her physique. [From Itch.io]

characters.name: Wendy
characters.description: Wendy is a careful and bashful person. She is completely devoted to her work and tries hard to make everything perfect. Even so, when she is faced with an unfamiliar situation, she gets nervous and stutters to the finish. [From Itch.io]

characters.name: Alice
characters.description: Alice is a kind and careful girl. She is able to adjust to whatever is thrown at her, even stumbling into an unfamiliar place. While she enjoys a bit of adventure every now and then, she also likes being at home with her sisters. [From Itch.io]

title: Head of the Class
description: Monsters lurk in every corner of the world. They work, they study and they live. In Echidna's School for Little Monsters, young monsters learn about the world around them and prepare for adulthood. It is one of the few local schools in the city and it needs more teachers. Class 5C is an average class of monsters facing the worst disaster any little monster has ever faced in school: being held back for a year. Their previous teachers have left them way behind in their studies. Anyone who doesn't meet the required minimum grades will be held back, a devastating blow to the souls of 11-to-13-year-old kids. Enter Caragh Dullahan, a new temporary teacher who comes highly recommended for her ability to swoop in and lead troubled classes to victory. Hopefully, the students of Class 5C will be saved from a situation not born of their own actions. It would be unfair for them to be punished for it. Caragh Dullahan, well-known expert in helping troubled students, is currently facing a crisis of her own; she's sick of constantly moving around. She may have forged a career but she has no home. When she takes the job at Echidna's School for Little Monsters, she finally sees her chance to have a stable life among its many inhabitants. What will she find in her quest? A place to belong to? Love? Friendship? Or will she be back on the road in a month? [From Itch.io]

tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: Young Serafina has spent her entire life alone in the jungle with only her guardian, a mysterious man named Arken, as company. When Arken is captured by a group of soldiers and carried away, Serafina must venture outside the forest to save him. On her journey to the heart of the kingdom, Serafina discovers a whole new world beyond the shadows of the jungle. As Serafina, you will mingle with noble warriors and salacious nobles to infiltrate the royalty of Castle Krondolee and save Arken. But in the process, you will become entangled in a wide web of relationships, schemes, and beliefs that may set you on a different path than the one you began. Learn the dark truth of Arken's past and thus Serafina's. Decide whom to trust, fight, or love. Your choice will change the fate of the entire kingdom. [From Woodsy Studio]

description: College student Misaki Kinosaki was looking for a part-time job that could only be done during winter vacation. She finds a job offer in her student affairs department. 『Recruitment of servants. Miscellaneous chores in the mansion. Handing over rewards Apply by mail』 Interested in the rarity of her work at her mansion, she applied immediately. The result was adoption. Her designated place of work is so deep in the mountains that it is impossible to get there without using a car, and the taxi driver who brought her is worried. While feeling a little uneasy, she was greeted by a beautiful young hostess named Suzue Fujikawa at the Western-style building. There is only one Suzue in this mansion. She employs only one servant, Misaki, and her work includes cleaning and cooking, but Misaki takes care of "Suzue-san". That was all. --A meaningful dream. --The hostess with many mysteries. --A creepy photo. In this mansion standing under the cloudy winter sky, mysterious things happen one after another. Even so, Misaki deepens her friendship with the owner of the mansion, Suzue Fujikawa...

description: You are a young adult adrift in life, suffocating under the yoke of your oppressive parents. Feeling out of sync with the rest of the world, you yearn for freedom and life beyond the bounds of your prison. You find it in the form of a ravishing stranger and a long lost city, calling out to you across space and time. Something is beckoning underneath the ancient city's glimmering white tiles, something old and powerful. Someone. Will you resist the call beyond the veil and the promise of belonging it brings, or will you let yourself go and embrace the path destiny has set before you? The choice is yours. Magnustor is waiting for you. [From itch.io] Set in the same universe as The Soul Stone War.

title: Larut
tags: Protagonist Based on a Mythological Character
description: Larut is a fictional work retelling of the Indonesian folklore and mythological figure, Nyi Roro Kidul. Having lost her home and her family's trust due to her stepmother’s schemes, Kandita finds herself struggling alone on the beach marking the edge of the South Sea. There, she meets her savior, the eternally kind and loving Queen of the Southern Sea who takes her in and grants her a position as the Queen’s lady-in-waiting. Eternally grateful for the Queen’s kindness and generosity, Kandita promises to devote her whole life to her savior. However, in this dog-eat-dog world society, a frail and naive lady like her must learn to adapt or lose everything yet again. [From itch.io]

There, she meets her savior, the eternally kind and loving Queen of the Southern Sea who takes her in and grants her a position as the Queen’s lady-in-waiting. Eternally grateful for the Queen’s kindness and generosity, Kandita promises to devote her whole life to her savior. However, in this dog-eat-dog world society, a frail and naive lady like her must learn to adapt or lose everything yet again. [From itch.io]

title: Monstrous Brew
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: Sprinkling sugar, flour, and a touch of magic; Mae's bakery is open for business! An average day, a mundane routine, all in the life of a simple witch! With delectable treats and heavenly pastries to *die* for, a humble dwelling to satiate anyone's sweet tooth! Surely nothing could go wrong, right? Right?! Oh, but how wrong she was. A midnight customer, and a midnight call—all came ominously, in the premonition of a single feather. And as it flutters into her hand, she knows just what it spells; A death foreboding, and this time, it was to be her head. "... Wh-whaaat?!" Realising just what that sign was, the witch became frantic! Just how could she preserve her life, when she knew death was coming so soon?! 'Oh, I-I know! A love potion!' Surely that'll do the trick! Something sweet, that'll *strike* that hunter's heart for good! However, if she were to make one before her doom, then all the time she had was... 24 hours on the clock?! Oh, for pete's sake—!! [From itch.io]

description: Frequently reminded about how she was rescued by faeries despite being a human, Lilika (renamable MC) has lived all her life repaying the faeries with her servitude — to cook, clean, and care for the heirs of an elite faerie family in the realm. When the family receives their annual invitation to an upcoming masquerade held by the High Court, Lilika is surprised to also receive an invitation letter, only to have her dreams crushed by the family’s objections. Lilika refuses to let go of her dreams of romance and dancing amongst the sparkling high court faeries. Her wishes are soon heard by a mysterious flower spirit in the garden and the spirit helps Eve get to the ball. Believing in the flower spirit, Lilika finds herself at the masquerade in a beautiful disguise and is able to put aside her human identity for a magical evening. But her night soon begins to unmask a stunning mystery - one that ties a clandestine prince, a grand magician, and a roguish knight to her destiny through passionate secrets and mysterious letters by moondusk. [From Steam]

title: Agatha's Agony: An Amor-less Adventure
description: Poor Agatha Molla just can't catch a break. After being struck by an ambulance, she wakes up as a patient in a psychiatric hospital with unfamiliar faces. Even worse, she's given experimental medication that makes her hornier and angrier than ever. Can Doctor Molla, the famous surgeon with a heart of ice, successfully woo these simpletons? Probably not, hence Agatha's Agony. [From Itch.io]

characters.name: Manson Moss
characters.description: Clark County Psytriatric Hospital's newest resident. Manson is a very sarcastic and mischievous man with early onset schizophrenia. He has often had trouble with his bizarre delusions that always got him into trouble, but nothing ever severe enough to land him in the loony bin. Manson believes himself to be independent and therefore should not remain in the ward. Because of this, he's quite unhappy with his current situation, but he's going to have some fun before his release. "Hey, is this chair flammable? I want to make s'mores!"

characters.name: Antonio Acevedo
characters.description: "Mr. Moss, will you please get that out of your mouth." A compassionate and intelligent man with absolutely zero flaws, Dr. Acevedo has recently taken the troublesome Manson under his care. He takes great pride in his job, but when not working, he'll always be found resting in his armchair listening to opera.

characters.name: Dorothy Smith
characters.description: "Oh my oh my oh my! Is everything alright, Manson?" A mysterious but rather pleasant woman who is Manson's roommate (Even though there's only one bed). She is so friendly, sweet, and kind it's impossible to get mad around her. No matter what happens, Dorothy will always be there for Manson. [From Itch.io] [Spoiler]Dorothy was constructed by Manson's subconscious to be his companion. While she was somewhat aware, she omitted this information for his mental health, leading to further disastrous results. In the Friendship ending, she disappears willingly, as there's no need for her anymore.

characters.name: Priscilla Harbinger
characters.description: "Gahahah! Look what the cat dragged in!" Priscilla is a wild, confident woman who is bored with her job as Manson is at his hospitalization. Because of how competitive they are, they're always getting into bets and fights. Don't underestimate her; She's five feet of fury and knows more than she lets on. [From Itch.io] [Spoiler]Kent's on/off again girlfriend, though she fails to mention this.

characters.name: Jones Carvey
characters.description: "Manson, Manson! What should we do today?" Jones is a shy, 7ft giant who thinks much more with his golden heart than his brain. He and Manson attend group therapy together, and his room is just down the hallway. When stressed or excited, he rocks in his chair and hums. [From Itch.io]

characters.name: Kent Goodman
characters.description: "Good morning Sir! I'm very sorry, but I have to deliver these papers. Perhaps later?" Kent is an overly kind and selfless psychiatric nurse who can't say no to any request. Because of this, many people take advantage of his hardworking nature, which often leaves him overworked and stressed. Kent manages Manson's and Jones' group therapy. [Edited from Itch.io]

characters.name: Randal Anderson
characters.description: "Hell if I know, heheh." Randal is a quiet, private security guard who is supposed to watch the camera feed and walk rounds, but sleeps and drinks in his office instead. Though he's solitary, he does appreciate company and talking about what Westerns he's seen. [From Itch.io]

characters.name: Lamp
characters.description: A hallucination that frequently torments Manson. She is part of the Furniture Women trio. [Spoiler]The trio were constructed by Manson's subconscious to be his friends, and are devoted to steering him the "right" path, even to the detriment of his mental health. In the best endings, Lamp vanishes. In Dorothy's route, she gains the name Tasha. In The Hole of Love, [spoiler]she calls herself Father Lamp. She attempts to wed Manson and Sharpay before being thwarted. Unfortunately, she marries Dorothy and Manson in Dorothy's route.

characters.name: Mother
characters.description: She refuses to accept the brutal death of her son and continues to care for him as if he were still alive, locking herself into a macabre illusion. In the April Fools' game Agatha's Agony, Mother is a patient at Clark County Psych Ward. [Spoiler]She is currently separated from Father and oblivious to Agatha's efforts to seduce her husband. Once Agatha is successfully rejected by all male suitors, Mother offers herself as a romantic option. Her real name, Ruth, is only revealed in this game.

characters.name: Father
characters.description: A wealthy man who is very concerned about appearances. When he accidentally causes the death of his son, he will do anything to cover it up. In the April Fools' game Agatha's Agony, Father is a romanceable character and a patient in Clark County Psych Ward. [Spoiler]He is currently separated from Mother but continues to cheat with other women, and eventually with men if Agatha does not intervene. His real name, Harold, is only revealed in this game.

characters.name: Daughter
characters.description: She was deeply shocked by the brutal death of her brother and is disturbed by her mother's behaviour of pretending that he is still alive. She is forced to live with her brother's corpse and watch him decompose as her mother plunges deeper and deeper into madness. Her real name is [spoiler]Gloria. [Spoiler]In Ending 2 of Agatha's Agony, Gloria's parents overcome their delusions. They pick her up from the orphanage and live happily ever after.

characters.name: Son
characters.description: He died, hit by a car driven by his father. His head was literally crushed. His mother, refusing his death, replaced his head with a pumpkin from the garden and continues to take care of him, claiming he is still alive. Concerned about appearances, his father pretends that nothing has happened. [Spoiler]In Ending 2 of Agatha's Agony, his name is revealed to be Jack. His parents overcome their delusions and give him a proper funeral.

characters.name: Sharpay Rauser
characters.description: A literal pencil sharpener, hallucinated into corporality by Manson. She plans to marry him and then "consummate" the marriage. Returns as a minor role in the April Fools' game Agatha's Agony where she has sex with [Spoiler]Father and Sylvester.

characters.name: Agatha Molla
characters.description: A talented and intelligent surgeon who will stop at nothing to treat her patients.

characters.name: Willow
characters.description: A fellow patient in the Ward and a good friend to Barry. She has Huntington's Disease. While sexually uninvolved in Object Ward, she engages with [Spoiler]Father in the April Fools' game Agatha's Agony.

characters.name: Barry Gardens
characters.description: A fellow patient in the Ward. He suffers from anterograde amnesia, preventing him from remembering any recent events. In Agatha's Agony, it is revealed to been caused by a tractor injury.

characters.name: Inspector
characters.description: A building inspector who visits the Ward during the Friendship route. He gives the cast three months to clean up their act or he shuts the asylum down.

characters.name: Schwartz
characters.description: A former army psychiatist turned Ward psychiatrist.

characters.name: Heiko
characters.description: A fellow patient in the Ward. Marcellus' roommate and [spoiler]boyfriend.

characters.name: Marcellus
characters.description: A fellow patient in the Ward. Deeply dislikes Manson for his antics and wants nothing to do with him. Marcellus suffers from anger issues, specifically Intermittent Explosive Disorder, exacerbated by his gambling addition. [Spoiler]Despite him being abrasive towards Manson and Kent's sexuality, Marcellus is in a relationship with Heiko.

characters.name: Bella Yu
characters.description: A nurse at the Ward. Rather oblivious to everything. While sexually uninvolved in Object Ward, she engages with [Spoiler]Father in the April Fools' game Agatha's Agony.

characters.name: Angie the Angel
characters.description: The female heavyweight champion of the world.

characters.description: A hallucination who begs Manson not to take his medication.

characters.description: A hallucination found in the trash.

characters.description: An annoying security guard in the Ward. Disliked by Randal and Manson.

characters.description: A deliveryman who thwarted Manson's escape.

characters.name: Diamond
characters.description: An overly friendly to the point of invasive woman that Acevedo and Manson meet.

characters.name: Momma
characters.description: Jones' mother. First mentioned in Object Ward, but visually appears in [spoiler]Agatha's Agony. He loves her, but is terrified of her. She sees him as a burden.

characters.name: Muse
characters.description: Originally a woman from a pornographic magazine, her hallucinated form looks eerily similar to Agatha.

characters.name: Girlfriend
characters.description: Luke's girlfriend. In Agatha's Agony, her name is revealed to be [Spoiler]Suzy. They love each other, with Luke thinking of proposing one day.

characters.name: Madeline Moss
characters.description: The alternative universe version of Manson. Currently dating Kandice. For some reason, likes to drink menstruation.

characters.name: Dante Smith
characters.description: The alternative universe version of Dorothy. First debuted in Lesbian Ward, but makes a cameo in [spoiler]Object Ward as a fantasy.

characters.name: Sylvester
characters.description: An aggressive, cantankerous hallucination, constructed by Manson's subconscious. While sexually uninvolved in Object Ward, he engages with [Spoiler]Sharpay and Father in Agatha's Agony. Formerly Manson's blanket.

title: Princess of Worlds End
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: Play as Princess, a high-maintenance 21-year-old girl who earned the nickname through her bratty behavior. After running away from home at 16, she worked dead-end job after dead-end job in order to survive and manage her addiction to a pain pill called Numb-X. The story begins with her waking up in a forest late at night during a rainstorm after getting knocked unconscious and robbed of all her belongings. Through a strange series of events, she unlocks a new power that will change her life forever. You will help guide Princess to get her life together, manage her relationships and, most importantly, prevent the end of the world. [From Steam]

characters.name: Princess
characters.description: She/Her Friends call her by the nickname "Princess" sarcastically because of her bad attitude. Works as a barista and usually hangs out around the EDM scene in town. Is a frequent user of a recreational drug called Numb X, which is a medicine used for pain. Even though life is not easy for her currently, everything changes when she awakens a strange new power within her. [From Kickstarter]

characters.name: Xavier
characters.description: He/Him Works at the coffee shop part time while going to the nearby University of Jefferson. He is the youngest of the 3 core coffee shop employees but is the best at his job out of all of them. He is a very selfless person and cares deeply about the people around him. He is a hard worker, maintains strong morals, and will not use drugs or drink. [From Steam]

characters.name: Jane
characters.description: She/Her Princess' childhood friend in Thomasville, but lost connection with her when Princess dropped out of high school. Jane recently graduated from Virginia University and has a job as a junior environmental scientist. She works very hard to support her mother who is battling breast cancer. Her dad left instead of supporting her mom, so the weight of that responsibility falls on her. [From Steam]

characters.name: Felix
characters.description: He/Him Works as a bartender at Jeffersonville Pub. He is cool, charismatic and appears happy on the surface, but has a nasty addiction to Numb-X. Deep down he is suffering with addiction and depression but you would never know it at a glance. He has a hard time trusting people and opening up about these feelings, and instead chooses to ignore them and smile though the pain. [From Steam]

characters.name: Cassandra
characters.description: She/Her She is bright and cheerful at heart, but is also prone to dozing off. She began working at the coffee shop while going to university and living with her parents, but she dropped out of college, so her temporary barista gig became her full-time job. She's trying to save up money to move out of her parents' house, but is bad about spending, especially on booze and pills. [From Steam]

characters.name: Kusano-hime
characters.description: She/They/Any Kusano-hime is a goddess who lives in an alternate world that Princess visits sometimes and is her main guide/mentor for her to master her new powers and use them to prevent the end of the world. Her personality is a bit bratty and short-tempered, but they're very intelligent and an expert strategist. [From Steam]

title: Sonagiga Naerineun Gonggan
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
Protagonist's Childhood Friend as a Hero
description: “Everyone hides something.” But when the silence ties to survival, the truth begins to shake. 'A Place Where Summer Rain Falls' is a story-driven visual novel set in a rainy school, where hidden memories and quiet emotions unfold. The truth isn't always loud — sometimes, it's silent. [From itch.io]

characters.name: Yoon Hae-ju
characters.description: Always smiling, he's the mood-maker who lightens the atmosphere of the class. People often say he's far from being 'serious', but it's undeniable that things feel brighter when he's around. That touch of carelessness—combined with his charm—creates a gap that makes him all the more intriguing.

characters.name: Bicheon
characters.description: Calm and composed, Bicheon has the kind of sharp presence, that makes others hesitate before speaking out of turn. Often seen as the reliable one in any group, her cool-headed judgments tend to ground the people around her.

characters.name: On Minhyeok
characters.description: He prefers action over words, and reserved nature often makes him seem distant. Still, there's a quiet strength to his presence—when he does speak up, people listen. His steady, grounded demeanor hides subtle hints of care that surface when you least expect them.

characters.name: Han Liwon
characters.description: The protagonist's childhood friend, and the very first character you meet in the story. At school, he's recognized by everyone as a model student, but beneath that polished exterior lies a playful side. That little bit of clumsiness, combined with his composed demeanor, makes the contrast all the more charming.

title: Laugh Track
description: You're now the lead writer for Juno's World, a perfectly normal sitcom in which nothing strange or horrible happens, ever! We're so happy you've chosen permanent employment. Management has infinite faith in your ability to steer our production team towards our mysterious and important endgame. You'll be guiding four teenagers -- Juno, Cat, Daniel, and Remy -- through the trials and travails of high school life. Using our patented "Ratings(tm)" system, you'll make decisions that keep them entertainingly unhappy! But not too unhappy, or they'll break. But also not too relaxed, or they'll fight back. We can't have that, no! How will we ever reach syndication if the entire project collapses? [From Steam]

title: The Missing Ingredient
description: Mavis Neela Berry is a baker in a small town. Nearly a year after breaking up with her last boyfriend, she’s given up on possibility of love. Instead, she sets her sights on winning the town’s country fair pie competition with her family recipe of blueberry pie. However, when a mysterious person shows up in her chicken coop, she recruits them as a new farm hand. Who are they, what is their story, and why do they act so strangely every time there’s a full moon in the sky? [From itch.io]

characters.name: Shawn/Shauna
characters.description: Shawn/Shauna is happy to help around the farm and eager to please. They are even more eager to try all of Mavis’ delicious baked creations. They enjoy keeping to themselves, and hold a lot of their past close to their chest. Are they ‘The One’ that Mavis has been waiting for, or will the secrets they carry prove too much to overcome? [From itch.io]

tags: Protagonist's Brother as a Support Character
Protagonist's Sister as a Support Character
description: Marina and Marcello Forlani are the sibling design team behind the fashion label Forlani. But after their 2025 Milan collection is torn apart by critics, they’re in desperate need of a break. Luckily, an old friend offers the perfect escape: a stay at the luxurious Bibi Resort on the dreamy island of Fuente Grande. Sun, style, and plenty of romance await. Between poolside cocktails, glittering soirées, and quiet walks along the beach, Marina and Marcello will meet an array of captivating women; each with her own charm, secrets, and stories. Play as Marina (a lesbian woman) or Marcello (a straight man) as you explore paradise and chase the possibility of love. Will you find your perfect match in the island breeze? [Edited from Steam]

title: Feyhearth: the Art of Handling Extraordinary Clientele
tags: Protagonist's Childhood Friend as a Hero
Protagonist's Childhood Friend as a Heroine
description: You've taken over a tavern that's existed for centuries now, one whose every owner must agree to an accord: four nights in a month, the tavernkeep must play host to a group of extraordinary clientele. They always arrive at dusk, they don't give out their names freely, and they expect to be entertained. Easy enough, right? Up until the party is crashed by your childhood best friend who can't ever learn the truth. So, tavernkeep, keep the drinks flowing, do your best to keep your friend in the dark, and—most importantly—don't make deals lightly. [From itch.io]

title: Heathcliff
tags: Protagonist's Brother as a Support Character
description: You grew up with everything money could buy. Everything except the one person you actually wanted. Years ago, your father brought home Emery Heathcliff after a business trip, and you fell hard for the rough-edged kid from a world you'd never seen. The two of you planned to marry the second you came of age. Then your father died unexpectedly and your brother inherited everything. He threw Emery out and forbade you from ever seeing each other again, and you spent years mourning what could have been. Now Emery's back as a wealthy and successful CEO. Except this version of Emery is darker and more dangerous, with an affection for you that borders on obsession. You don't know what they did to get this rich, and you're not sure you want to know. But when you're together, sneaking moments under your brother's nose, all that matters is how much you need them.

title: Even Lovers Drown
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
description: Even in the thoroughly modern era of the 1920s, one meets all sorts of characters while traveling the vaudeville circuit. Lark (gender selectable) has seen acts enough—and cons enough—to place very little stock in either magic or fairytales. That is, until two beings straight from myth turn Lark's world topsy-turvy. Entangled in a selkie's daring heist and stuck ferrying a stolen siren prince back to sea, the question is no longer whether magic exists—but whether Lark can survive without it. Because where magic is not a mere act, forces beyond reckoning loom in the shadows, and the monsters of old are neither phony, nor dead: rather, they are much closer—and much more dangerous!—than Lark has ever dared to imagine them. [From itch.io]

title: Endless Summer: First Tide
tags: Both Male and Female Love Interests
Brother & Sister Siblings as Love Interests
description: It's the summer of 1977, and you're supposed to be having the time of your life vacationing with your high school friends before you all go your separate ways for college. Then the storm hits, capsizing your yacht and stranding you on a wild, uncharted island that isn't on any map, with a handful of mismatched teens and no way home. As you weld your fractured group into a found family—building shelter, surviving a paradise that's as dangerous as it is beautiful, and falling for at least one of your four magnetic companions—the island begins to reveal impossible wonders. Flying seahorses. Lights that bend time. A wedding frozen mid-celebration for fifty years. And a chaperone whose obsession with the island's secrets may be the most dangerous thing of all.

characters.name: Michele
characters.description: In "Fuyu no Himegimi -Winter Princess-": Princess that governs "winter" of the four seasons. Although she is the leading candidate for the Queen, the she has no motivation at all. Everyday she sorrows and cries because her first love broke her heart. In "Owaranai Natsu wo Kimi to ~Endless Summer~": The original, but now former, Winter Princess. She is supposed to go to live on earth and become human, but in response to the courtship from The Summer Prince, she has remained in the world of spirits. She now is between commandments and her own struggle with love. In "Joou Heika ni Chuusei wo -Mission from Queen-": Governs as the Princess of the Four Seasons. She had reigned as a princess for a 100 years, which is quite unusual. She is expressionless, cool and collected. Her personal life is shrouded in darkness. [Translated from the official website, from here, here and here.]

description: In a huge mansion live a gentle boy and an ambitious poor girl who won't be discouraged by her circumstances. You can choose between these two contrasting characters to interact with the various individual spirits in this raising simulation game. Man and woman, two girls, and two guys combinations are possible, but there are no love developments, to the end it stays a game about friendship. [Translated from Girl Game Wiki]

characters.name: Ira
characters.description: "...you know how miserable poverty is! I want to win at life!" A strong-willed and active girl who knows how to navigate the world. Because she lost her parents, she now lives alone. From her poor life so far, she knows the weakness and misery of not having money, so she is determined to save money and rise to the upper class. What she likes is money, and what she hates is poverty. Her hobby is saving money, and she works hard every day to earn coins. [Translated from official website]

characters.name: Catan
characters.description: "I envy you all.... Because I'm just a fake. How can I become human...?" Although he looks human, he's actually a "living doll" created by a talented inventor. Having spent solitary time reading books in a large mansion, he is unfamiliar with the outside world and has a slightly timid and gentle personality. However, thanks to the collection of books, he has quite a bit of knowledge. He lacks emotional ups and downs, but longs for strong emotions. He wishes to become human someday. [Translated from official website]

characters.name: Flash
characters.description: A spirit that controls lightning.

characters.name: Ash
characters.description: A spirit that controls fire.

characters.name: Luciel
characters.description: A spirit that controls ice.

characters.name: Pia
characters.description: A spirit that controls flowers. The princess of the spirit world.

characters.name: Meril
characters.description: A spirit that controls greenery.

characters.name: Ilumina
characters.description: A spirit that controls the moon.

characters.name: Fay
characters.description: "I know it's an important mission, but it's not for me to be troublesome like that~" A wind spirit who is in a good mood when the wind blows, in a bad mood when it's raining, gets upset when angry, and smiles when something is funny. A girl who expresses honestly without covering up. Although she is impulsive, capricious, and lacks concentration, she has a refreshing personality like a broken bamboo. Even when she's angry, she doesn't hold much root. She easily can talk to anyone and quickly become friends with them, but she is not good with people who are not friendly. [Translated from the official website]
